intro:
# Granite Manager — User Manual (Feature Map)

This document is a high-level map of what the application offers, organized by user role and navigation area. It is derived from the app’s routes, sidebar navigation, and page components.

Granite Manager is an AI-powered CRM and inventory platform built for countertop and stone fabrication shops. It connects customer relationships, deal pipelines, stone/slab inventory, communications, and back-office operations in one system.

---

sections.content:
## Admin Automations (Email Templates, SMS Templates, Follow-up Flows, Sale on a win, Jobs to Unscheduled)

**Automations** holds the company's reusable messages and the rules that send them on their own: email templates, SMS templates, and multi-step follow-up flows. Pipeline lists (stages) and questionnaires are not here; they stay on the **Deals** board **Menu**.

**Where to find it:** switch to **Admin**, then sidebar **CRM > Automations**. The page has two tabs. **Messages** (the default) has three cards: **Email Templates**, **SMS Templates** and **Follow-up Flows**. Click one (or its **Open** link) to open that manager in a dialog over the page. **Sales** has two switches: **Sale on a win** and **Jobs to Unscheduled** (see below).

**Who can use it:** only users with Admin access. Employees cannot open this page. They use the company templates and flows while working (email composer, SMS composer, deal **Project** tab), and can build their own personal flows from **Manage flows** (see below).

---

### The Automations page

On the **Messages** tab, three short steps explain the idea:

1. **Write the message**: email and SMS templates hold the wording, with variables like the customer's first name.
2. **Pick the trigger**: give a template a deal list and a delay. When a lead lands on that list, it sends on its own.
3. **Or run a flow**: follow-up flows keep texting or emailing a customer in steps until they reply.

Each card shows counts:

| Card | Counts shown |
|------|--------------|
| **Email Templates** | number of templates, and how many are **automated** (have a trigger list) |
| **SMS Templates** | number of company SMS templates, and how many are **automated** |
| **Follow-up Flows** | number of **company flows** |

If the company has no SMS provider, the SMS Templates and Follow-up Flows cards show: *Connect CloudTalk or RingCentral in Company settings to use SMS.*

---

### Sale on a win

The **Sale on a win** card, on the **Sales** tab, has an **On** / **Off** switch. It is **Off** for every company until a manager turns it on. Only users with the **Manager** position can switch it; anyone else gets an error message.

When it is **On**:

- **Won** on a deal's **Project** tab opens the **Sell Slab** form before going back to the board.
- **Mark as Sold** on a quote opens the same form right after the quote is sold.

The form comes filled in: the customer, the deal, the seller (the quote's salesperson, else the deal owner) and the project address from the quote. Each area drawn on the quote becomes a room, with its square feet (counters, splash, waterfalls and miters), its backsplash, and the stone of its color when a stone with that name is in **Stones**. Area names with *bath*, *vanity* or *powder* become **Bathroom**, *island* becomes **Island**, *outdoor*, *patio* or *grill* become **Outdoor**, and anything else **Kitchen**. Sinks and faucets are not copied. Pick the slabs (and sinks or faucets), then **Submit**.

From a deal, the form uses the customer's sold quote for that deal, else an accepted one. With no such quote it opens with one empty room.

- Closing the form without submitting keeps the win: the deal stays **Won** and the quote **Sold**. The sale can still be made later from **Stones**.
- The form does not open when the deal already has a sale (an unsold sale does not count).
- A contract the customer signs marks the quote sold and the deal won, but does not open the form, since nobody is on the page at that moment.

### Jobs to Unscheduled

The **Jobs to Unscheduled** card, on the **Sales** tab, has an **On** / **Off** switch. It is **Off** for every company until a manager turns it on. Only users with the **Manager** position can switch it; anyone else gets an error message.

When it is **On**, **Mark as Sold** on a quote (or a contract the customer signs online) adds two jobs to the schedule's **Unscheduled** list: one on the **Templates** calendar and one on the **Installations** calendar, named after the customer, at the customer's address, with status **Not ready**. The template job goes to the company's only template maker when there is just one. A quote adds its jobs once: selling it again after **Undo sale** adds nothing. When it is **Off**, selling a quote adds no jobs.

---

### Email templates

Click **Email Templates** to open **Manage Email Templates**.

- **Search templates...** filters by template name.
- **Add New Template** opens the add form.
- Table columns: **Name**, **Automation** (the trigger as *Group / List · 4h*, or **—** when the template is not automated), **Created On**.
- Each row has a pencil (**edit**) and a red trash can (**delete**).

These are **company** templates: every rep sees them in the email composer's template picker (marked **Company**). Reps cannot edit or delete company templates; they can only manage their own personal templates from the composer.

#### Adding or editing an email template

1. Click **Add New Template** (or the pencil on a row). The dialog is **Add New Email Template** or **Edit Email Template**.
2. Fill in:
   - **Template Name** (required).
   - **Template Subject** (required): the email subject line.
   - **Template Body** (required): rich text. Use **Insert Variable** to add auto-filled details (see *Template variables*); the blue box under it lists the **Predefined variables** (auto-filled for the employee).
   - **Trigger list**: **No automation** (default) or a deal list shown as *Group / List*. Picking a list makes the template send automatically.
   - **Send after (hours)**: enabled only after you pick a trigger list. Whole hours, 0 to 8760.
   - **For deals of** (shown once a trigger list is picked): **All sales reps** (the default) or the sales reps whose deals get this automatic email. Pick one or more reps to limit it to their deals only.
3. Optional: click the paperclip to attach files (**Upload from computer**, **From Stones**, **From Images**, **From Documents**). Attachments are added when a rep inserts the template into an email.
4. Optional: **Generate Template** opens **Generate Template with AI**. Describe the email you want and click **Generate**; the AI fills in name, subject and body using the available variables. Review before saving.
5. Click **Save Template**. When editing, the button stays disabled until something changes.

Toasts: **Email template created** or **Email template updated**. Form errors you may see: *Template name is required*, *Template subject is required*, *Template body is required*, *Invalid template body format. Check for unclosed {{ or }}.*, *Set how many hours to wait before sending.*, *Delay must be between 0 and 8760 hours.*, *Another email template already uses this list and delay.*

#### Deleting an email template

Click the trash can, then **Confirm** in **Delete Email Template** (*This action cannot be undone*). Toast: **Email template deleted**. Any automatic sends still waiting for that template are cancelled.

---

### SMS templates

Click **SMS Templates** to open **Company SMS Templates** (*Shared with everyone in your company*). SMS must be set up first: the company needs CloudTalk or RingCentral connected.

- Each row shows the name, a preview of the text, and the trigger (*Group / List · 4h*, or **—**).
- Pencil = edit, trash = delete (a browser prompt asks *Delete "name"? This cannot be undone.*).
- **New company template** at the bottom opens the form.

#### Adding or editing an SMS template

1. Click **New company template** (or the pencil).
2. Fill in **Name** (up to 255 characters) and **Message**. Use **Insert Variable** above the message box.
3. The counter under the message shows characters used out of **1600**. It turns amber past 160 characters (one text segment) and red past 1600.
4. Optional: choose a **Trigger list** (*Send this text by itself when a deal enters a list.*). Then:
   - **Send after** — hours (0 to 8760) and minutes (0 to 59).
   - **Send to customers from** — the customer sources it goes to (chips, **Leads** picked to start; add **Walk-in**, **Call-in** or your own sources).
   - **For deals of** — **All sales reps** (the default) or only the picked reps' deals.
   - The note under them sums it up: *Sends 4h after a deal enters the list…*
5. Click **Create** (new) or **Save** (edit).

Errors: *Template name is required*, *Template body is required*, *Template body must be at most 1600 characters*, *Set how many hours to wait before sending.*, *Delay must be between 0 and 8760 hours.*, *Another SMS template already uses this list and delay.*

Reps can also keep personal SMS templates from the SMS composer's **Use Template** picker; only admins create company ones.

---

### Automatic sending when a deal enters a list

A template with a **Trigger list** sends itself:

- When a deal **enters the selected list**, the template is scheduled to send after the **Send after (hours)** delay.
- An email template only sends if the customer is a **lead** (customer **Source** = Leads); an SMS template sends to the sources ticked in **Send to customers from** (Leads unless changed). The deal must have an owner, and when **For deals of** names reps, the owner must be one of them. If the customer's source changes to one not picked before the send time, the send is cancelled.
- A **brand-new deal** for a customer who already has another deal does not start automatic messages.
- Each template goes to the same customer only once.
- **Moving the deal to another list** cancels its pending automatic emails and texts, and starts the new list's templates.
- **Sequences:** put several templates on the same list with different delays (for example 0, 24 and 72 hours). Two templates of the same kind cannot share the same list and delay.
- **Send times (Eastern time):** automatic emails go out between 8:30 AM and 7:00 PM; automatic texts between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM. A message due outside those hours waits for the next morning. Nothing goes out on New Year's Day, July 4, Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve or Christmas Day.
- **Emails** are sent from the deal owner's email address. They are saved to the customer's email history on the deal. Only the subject and body are sent: files attached to the template are not included in automatic emails.
- **Texts** are sent from the deal owner's SMS line. They fail if the rep has no linked SMS line or number, if SMS is not enabled, or if the customer has no phone number. An email fails if the customer has no email address.

**Turning an automation off:** edit the template and set **Trigger list** to **No automation**, then save. Pending automatic sends of that template are cancelled. The template stays available for manual use. Deleting the template also stops it.

**Reps are told about changes:** when an admin turns on, changes or turns off an automatic email or text, or creates, changes or deletes a company follow-up flow, everyone with the **Sales Rep** position gets an email from *"[Company] automations"* describing what customers will now receive.

---

### Template variables

Click **Insert Variable** in a template editor. The menu (*Filled in automatically when the message is sent.*) lists each variable with an example. A variable is stored as text in double braces, for example `{{customer.first_name}}`.

| Group | Variables |
|-------|-----------|
| **Customer** | Customer first name, Customer last name, Customer full name, Customer email, Customer phone, Customer address, Customer inventory page (link to your showroom stones page) |
| **Employee** | Employee first name, Employee last name, Employee full name, Employee email, Employee phone number |
| **Company** | Company name, Company address, Hours of operation |
| **Date** | Current day and month (e.g. *October 14*) |
| **Deal** | Deal name, Deal amount. **Email templates only**, and only filled when sent from a deal that has a name or amount. Otherwise sending warns **Deal details missing** (*… could not be filled: send from a deal that has a name and amount, or replace them before sending.*). |

- **Employee** variables are the person sending. For automatic sends, that is the deal owner.
- **SMS templates** offer every group except **Deal**.
- **Custom variables:** type `{{Your Text}}` yourself for a blank the rep must fill in by hand before sending. Don't use custom variables in automated templates or flows: nobody is there to fill them in.
- A body with an unclosed `{{` or `}}`, an empty `{{}}`, or a brace inside a variable cannot be saved.
- Quote email templates (with quote variables such as the quote link and total) are separate. They live on **Admin > Quotes**, **Email Templates** tab.

---

### Follow-up flows

A flow sends a sequence of messages to one customer, each after a delay you set, and stops when the customer replies.

Click **Follow-up Flows** on the Automations page. The **Follow-up Flows** dialog has a **Mine** / **Company** switch:

- **Company**: *Shared with everyone in your company*. Only admins, from **Admin > CRM > Automations**, can create, edit or delete these. Every rep can start them.
- **Mine**: *Only visible to you*. Your personal flows.

Each flow shows its name, a mail or chat icon per step, and a summary (for example *3 steps · 2d 4h*). Pencil = edit, trash = delete.

#### Creating or editing a flow

1. Click **New company flow** (Company) or **New flow** (Mine).
2. Enter **Flow name** (required, e.g. *New lead follow-up*).
3. Click **Add step**. When SMS is available you pick **What kind of step?**: **Email** or **SMS**. Otherwise steps are email only.
4. For each step, choose the message:
   - **Templates**: a saved email or SMS template. Company flows can only use company templates.
   - **AI personalize at send time**: when the step is due, AI writes the message from the customer's SMS and email history, notes, company templates and follow-up instructions.
   - **Custom message**: type the text (email steps also have **Subject (optional)**).
5. Set the delay in **Days**, **Hours** and **Minutes**. The first step counts *Since the flow starts*; later steps count *Since the previous step's send*. Each step shows when it will send (*sends ~2d after the flow starts*). The longest delay for one step is 30 days.
6. Reorder with **Move step up** / **Move step down**; remove with the trash icon. A flow can have up to 20 steps.
7. Click **Create** (new) or **Save** (edit). Toast: **Flow created** or **Flow updated**.

Closing with unsaved changes asks **Discard this flow?** (*Your changes have not been saved.* **Keep editing** / **Discard**). Steps cannot use custom `{{placeholders}}` or **Deal** variables. A template step that contains one shows a warning that the step will fail to send.

**Send times (Eastern time):** flow emails go out between 8:30 AM and 7:00 PM, and flow texts between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM. The note under the steps says texts go until 7:00 PM, but they stop at 6:00 PM. A step due outside those hours waits until the next morning, and nothing goes out on the same holidays as above. Later steps count from when the previous message actually went out.

**Deleting a flow:** trash icon, then **Delete** in **Delete flow**. Customers currently in that flow stop getting its follow-ups. This cannot be undone.

#### SMS steps: who can add them

- SMS steps need the company to have CloudTalk or RingCentral.
- In **Admin > CRM > Automations**, admins can add SMS steps even without their own SMS line.
- Elsewhere, a user needs their own SMS line (CloudTalk agent ID and phone number, or a RingCentral extension and number on their account). Without one, flows are email only, and flows containing SMS steps are hidden from their list.

---

### Starting and stopping a flow for a customer

- **Deal Project tab:** **Automated Follow-up** button on the phone row, if you have an SMS line. Otherwise there is a lightning button next to the customer's email (tooltip **Follow-up flow**; disabled with *No email address on file*).
- **Email thread with a customer:** the lightning button in the header (companies without CloudTalk).
- **SMS conversation:** the lightning button **Follow-up Flows** in the conversation header, which opens the **Start a flow** panel. See the SMS section.

The picker lists **Company flows** and **Your flows**, plus an AI follow-ups row (**Generate with AI**). Click a flow to preview its steps, then **Start flow**. Toast: **Follow-up started** (*"name" is running.*). A customer can have only one running flow. While one runs, the lightning button turns yellow, and **Stop** ends it (*This cannot be undone*). **Manage flows** at the bottom of the picker opens your own flows (**Mine**) for editing.

---

### Common questions

- **I don't see Automations.** It is only in the **Admin** sidebar under **CRM**. Employees don't have it.
- **My automated email never went out.** Check that the customer's **Source** is **Leads**, that the deal is still on the trigger list, that the customer has an email address, and that it isn't outside 8:30 AM–7:00 PM Eastern or a holiday. A new deal for a customer who already had a deal does not trigger automations.
- **Automated texts fail.** The deal owner needs an SMS line and number, and the customer needs a phone number.
- **Can a rep edit a company template?** No. Only admins, here.
- **How do I pause an automation?** Set **Trigger list** to **No automation**. Pending sends are cancelled.
- **Can I send an email 30 minutes after a deal enters a list?** Templates use whole hours. Use a flow for minute-level delays.
- **The SMS card says to connect CloudTalk or RingCentral.** A manager sets this up in **Company settings**. Until then, SMS templates and SMS flow steps are unavailable.

## Company Integrations: RingCentral, CloudTalk & Users' Texting Lines

How a company connects its phone/SMS provider (RingCentral or CloudTalk) and QuickBooks, and how each user's texting line is set up (**CloudTalk agent ID**, **CloudTalk phone number**, **RingCentral phone number**).

**Where to find it:**
- Company connections: **Admin > Company settings > Company** — the **RingCentral** card and the **QuickBooks** card on the right of the page.
- A user's line: **Admin > Company settings > Users** → **⋯** on the row → **Edit**, or the user's own **My Account** (Employee view, **Phone lines** section).

**Who can see it:** the Company and Users pages need **Admin** access plus the **Manager** position (platform superusers always). Any employee can fill in their own line on **My Account**.

---

### RingCentral card (Company page)

Connects your company's RingCentral account so staff can call and text from the CRM.

| Card state | Text / buttons |
|-----------|----------------|
| Not available yet | *RingCentral connect isn't set up yet. Ask a superuser to enable it for all companies.* |
| Not connected | *Click below and log in with your RingCentral account to connect it. No API keys needed.* — **Connect RingCentral** |
| Connected | *Connected. Each person adds their own RingCentral phone number on My Account to call and text from the CRM.* — **Reconnect**, **Disconnect** |
| Connected, couldn't check | Same, plus *RingCentral didn't answer just now, so this couldn't be checked.* |
| Disconnected by RingCentral | Red: *Disconnected. RingCentral ended this connection, for example after the app's settings changed. Calls, texts and contact sync stop until you reconnect.* — **Reconnect**, **Disconnect** |

**Connect RingCentral:**

1. **Admin > Company settings > Company** → **RingCentral** card → **Connect RingCentral**.
2. Sign in to RingCentral and approve access.
3. You come back to the Company page with the toast **RingCentral connected successfully**. Possible errors: *RingCentral connection was cancelled.*, *RingCentral connection expired. Please try again.*, *Could not finish the RingCentral connection. Try again.*
4. Each person enters their **RingCentral phone number** on **My Account** (or a Manager sets it in **Users > Edit**).

After connecting, the Users table shows **RingCentral Extension** and **RingCentral Phone** columns, and **RingCentral phone number** appears on **Edit** and **My Account**.

**Disconnect:** click **Disconnect** on the card. Toast: **RingCentral disconnected**. Use **Reconnect** to sign in again (for example after the red *Disconnected* message).

### QuickBooks card (Company page)

Shown only when QuickBooks is turned on for your company.

- Not set up: *QuickBooks connect isn't set up yet. Ask a superuser to enable it for all companies.*
- Not connected: *Click below and log in with your QuickBooks Online account to connect it.* — **Connect QuickBooks**.
- Connected: *Connected. Everyone in this company can see QuickBooks invoices on customer info.* — **Reconnect**, **Disconnect** (toast **QuickBooks disconnected**).

After signing in to QuickBooks you return to the Company page with **Quickbooks connected successfully**. What syncs is explained in **QuickBooks Online**.

### CloudTalk (company)

There is no CloudTalk card or connect button. CloudTalk is set up for your company by the Granite Manager team (a platform superuser enters the CloudTalk keys on the company). Once it is on:

- The Users table shows **CloudTalk Agent ID** and **CloudTalk Phone** columns.
- **CloudTalk agent ID** and **CloudTalk phone number** appear on **Users > Edit** and on **My Account**.

---

### Set up a user's CloudTalk line

CloudTalk uses two separate fields:

| Field | What it does | Rules |
|-------|-------------|-------|
| **CloudTalk agent ID** | Matches CloudTalk calls and texts to the CRM user. Needed for **CRM > SMS** and for **Made a call / Received a call / Missed a call** rows in **Admin > Users Activity** | Numbers only (*CloudTalk agent ID must be numbers only*) |
| **CloudTalk phone number** | The CloudTalk line used as the sender when this user texts. Also needed for the Phone button | Numbers only, at least 10 digits (*CloudTalk phone must include at least 10 digits*) |

**1. Get the Agent ID on CloudTalk** (needs a **CloudTalk Admin** login — otherwise ask your company's CloudTalk Admin):

1. Sign in at cloudtalk.io with a CloudTalk Admin account.
2. Open **Users** (older versions: **Agents**) and search for the person by name or email.
3. Click the user to open their edit page. The **Agent ID** is the number at the very end of the browser address.

**2. Get the CloudTalk phone number:** in the CloudTalk Dashboard open **Numbers** (or look at the agent's assigned numbers under **Users → Edit user**) and copy the full number including the country code.

**3. Enter them in Granite Manager** — either:

- **Admin > Company settings > Users** → **⋯** → **Edit** → paste **CloudTalk agent ID** and **CloudTalk phone number** → **Save** (toast **User updated**). Help text under the agent ID: *Set this to enable sending SMS from the CRM. Find the value in CloudTalk → Users → Edit user → Agent ID will be in the URL.*
- Or the user opens **My Account** (Employee view) → **Phone lines** → **CloudTalk agent ID** (placeholder *From CloudTalk (optional)*) and **CloudTalk phone number** (placeholder *Your CloudTalk line (optional)*) → **Save Changes** (toast *Your account was updated*).

### Set up a user's RingCentral line

RingCentral needs only **RingCentral phone number** (the company must be connected first — see above).

1. **Users > ⋯ > Edit** (or the user's **My Account → Phone lines**).
2. Enter the person's RingCentral number in **RingCentral phone number** (numbers only, at least 10 digits).
3. **Save** (on **My Account**: **Save Changes**).

When you save, Granite Manager looks the number up in RingCentral and fills the **RingCentral Extension** column. If it stays blank, the number doesn't match a RingCentral user's number — check it in RingCentral.

The shop **My Account** page has no CloudTalk or RingCentral fields.

### Company texts sent from the Office Manager's line

Automatic customer texts — post-install survey links, in-home estimate confirmations and reminders, and schedule notification texts — are sent from the line of a user with the **Office Manager** position. That user needs a complete line: **CloudTalk agent ID** + **CloudTalk phone number**, or a **RingCentral phone number** whose extension was found. Without one, those texts aren't sent by SMS.

---

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **I don't see the CloudTalk or RingCentral fields.** The provider isn't set up for the company. RingCentral: a Manager clicks **Connect RingCentral** on the Company page. CloudTalk: ask the Granite Manager team.
- **The RingCentral card says it isn't set up yet.** Connecting isn't available on the server yet — ask the Granite Manager team.
- **A rep can't see CRM > SMS (CloudTalk).** Their **CloudTalk agent ID** is missing.
- **SMS shows but the Phone button doesn't (CloudTalk).** The **CloudTalk phone number** is missing.
- **Users Activity shows no calls for a rep.** Set their **CloudTalk agent ID**.
- **"CloudTalk phone must include at least 10 digits".** Enter the whole number with area code (digits only).
- **RingCentral Extension stays empty.** The RingCentral number entered doesn't belong to an enabled RingCentral user; correct the number and save again.
- **Survey or estimate texts aren't going out.** Make sure someone has the **Office Manager** position and a complete CloudTalk or RingCentral line.
- **Calls and texts stopped after RingCentral showed "Disconnected".** Click **Reconnect** on the RingCentral card.

## Admin Company Settings & Users

Use these pages to set up your company profile (name, address, logo, sales tax), connect RingCentral and QuickBooks, and manage staff accounts (add, edit, rename, assign positions, delete).

**Where to find it:** switch to the **Admin** view, then open the collapsible **Company settings** section in the sidebar (building icon). It holds:

| Sidebar item | What it is | Route |
|--------------|-----------|-------|
| **Company settings > Users** | Staff accounts, positions, Admin access, texting lines | `/admin/users` |
| **Company settings > Company** | Company name, address, logo, sales tax, RingCentral / QuickBooks cards | `/admin/company` |
| **Company settings > Billing** | Granite Manager subscription (see **Billing**) | `/admin/billing` |

To switch to the Admin view: on a computer click **Admin** in the top header (it reads **Employee** while you're in Admin); on a phone it's the button at the top of the sidebar menu.

**Who can see it:** users with **Admin** access **and** the **Manager** position in the company, plus platform superusers (Granite Manager staff). The **Super Admin** position alone is not enough — a Super Admin also needs Manager, which only applies in their home company. Admins without Manager don't see **Users** or **Company** in the sidebar, and if they open the address directly the page never loads. (**Billing** needs only the Manager position and also shows in the Employee sidebar.)

---

### Company page (**Admin > Company settings > Company**)

Page title: **Company**. The left card is the company form; on the right are the **QuickBooks** card (only when QuickBooks is turned on for your company) and the **RingCentral** card.

#### Company form fields

| Field | Required? | Notes |
|-------|-----------|-------|
| **Company name** | Yes | Error if empty: *Company name is required*. Shown in the app and in customer emails/texts. |
| **Company address** | No | Address autocomplete. Leave blank to clear it. |
| **Logo** | No | Preview, **Logo height** slider and a file chooser (see below). |
| **Sales Tax (%)** | No | Placeholder **7**. A number from 0 to 100; blank clears it. Used by **Special Order** and other pricing. |
| **Company ID : {number}** | Read-only | Your company's ID number. |

Click **Save**. Toast: **Company settings saved**. If something is wrong you get an **Error** toast with the reason (fallback *Could not save the company settings*).

#### Add or change the company logo

1. Go to **Admin > Company settings > Company**.
2. In the **Logo** section, click the file chooser and pick an image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG). Large images are shrunk automatically before upload.
3. A preview appears in the dashed box.
4. Optional: drag the **Logo height** slider (32px to 192px, steps of 4; default 48px). The label shows the current height, e.g. **48px**.
5. Click **Save**. Toast: **Company settings saved**.

The logo shows in the app header at the chosen height. To change only the height, move the slider and **Save** without choosing a file — the current logo is kept. There is no "remove logo" button and no separate branding page.

**Not the company logo:** stone photos are set per stone in **Admin > Inventory > Stones**.

#### Change the sales tax rate

1. **Admin > Company settings > Company**.
2. Type the percent in **Sales Tax (%)** (e.g. `7` or `7.25`).
3. **Save**.

Only users with the **Manager** position and Admin access can change it. It's the rate **Special Order** uses.

#### Request Bearer (API token)

Users who hold the **Manager** position in this company see a **Request Bearer** button under **Company ID**. It emails the Granite Manager API bearer token (for developers connecting other software):

1. Click **Request Bearer**.
2. In the **Request Bearer** dialog, enter an **Email**.
3. Click **Send Bearer** (or **Close** to cancel).
4. Success message: *The bearer token was sent to your email.* The email's subject is **Granite Manager API bearer token**. Keep it private.

Platform superusers without the Manager position don't see this button.

#### Setup checklist shortcuts

The Dashboard setup checklist rows **Add logo**, **Add sales tax** and **Connect QuickBooks** open this page and highlight the matching field or card. **Add a sales rep** and **Add an installer** open the **Add user** dialog with that position highlighted. (Company rows show only to admins.)

---

### Integrations on the Company page

- **RingCentral** card — **Connect RingCentral** links your company's RingCentral account so staff can call and text from the CRM (toast **RingCentral connected successfully**); when connected it shows **Reconnect** and **Disconnect** (toast **RingCentral disconnected**).
- **QuickBooks** card — only when QuickBooks is turned on for your company: **Connect QuickBooks**, or **Reconnect** / **Disconnect** when connected (*Connected. Everyone in this company can see QuickBooks invoices on customer info.*).
- **CloudTalk** has no card here; the Granite Manager team sets it up for the company.

Card states, error messages and each user's line setup are in **Company Integrations: RingCentral, CloudTalk & Users' Texting Lines**; QuickBooks details are in **QuickBooks Online**.

The **ⓘ** next to **Administrator** (*About Administrator*) explains it: *Opens the Admin portal for this company. Pair with Manager to add and edit users and to edit company profile settings.*

### Position access (Inventory Manager and Scheduling Manager)

The **Position access** card at the bottom of the Company page: *What someone with only these positions can open. My Account always stays. Sales Rep, Sales Manager or Manager beside them gives the whole app.* One row per limited position (**Inventory Manager**, **Scheduling Manager**), each with a checkbox per section: **Dashboard**, **Inventory**, **Inventory (admin)**, **Customers**, **Deals**, **Quotes**, **Emails**, **SMS**, **Schedule**, **Schedule (admin)**, **Transactions**, **Samples**, **Special Order**, **Checklists** and **Suppliers, Supports, Documents, Images, Instructions**. ### Add a user

You enter only the person's **email** and **positions**. They get an email invite and fill in their own **name**, **phone number** and **password**.

2. The **Add user** dialog opens. Enter the **Email**.
3. Turn on the positions the person needs, and **Admin** if they need the Admin portal.
4. Click **Send invite**. The dialog changes to **Invite sent**: *We emailed … a link to enter their name, phone number and password.* The link is shown too (the copy button, *Copy invite link*, turns into *Invite link copied*), with **Copy**, so you can also text it to them. Click **Done**.
5. The person appears in the list with **Invite pending**. They open the link, set up their account (see **Setting up your account from an invite** in Sign-in & passwords) and are signed in. Until then they can't sign in.

- Employee access is set automatically: everyone gets it except users whose only positions are **Marketing** and/or **Shop Worker**. There is no Employee switch.

To fix a mistyped email, change **Email**, click **Save**, then open **Edit** again and click **Resend invite** — until you save, the dialog says *Save the new email, then resend the invite.* You can still change their positions here before they set up.

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **Why can't I see Company settings?** **Users** and **Company** need Admin access and the **Manager** position; **Billing** needs only the **Manager** position.
- **I don't see Company settings / Users / Company.** You need **Admin** access plus the **Manager** position in this company. Ask someone who already has both to turn on **Manager** for you in **Users > Edit**.
- **There's no Edit or Delete menu on someone's row.** They are a platform superuser or have the **Super Admin** position; only a platform superuser can change them.
- **How do I reset a user's password?** Admins can't set it. The user clicks **Forgot password?** on the sign-in page (a reset link is emailed) or changes it on **My Account**.
- **I can't find the Delete option.** You need **Admin** access and the **Manager** position. Platform superusers and **Super Admin** users have no **⋯** menu for others.
- **A new user can only see the checklist / shop / walk-in / leads page.** One of their positions locks the login into that portal (Installer, Shop Worker, Walk-in, Marketing, Template Guy). Remove that position if they need the CRM.
- **Can't save: "A user can't be both Sales Representative and Shop Worker."** Turn one of them off.
- **I don't see CloudTalk or RingCentral fields.** They show only when that provider is set up for the company: RingCentral via **Connect RingCentral** on the Company page; CloudTalk by the Granite Manager team.
- **SMS from the CRM doesn't work for a rep.** Check **CloudTalk agent ID** and **CloudTalk phone number** (or **RingCentral phone number**) on their account.
- **Survey/estimate texts aren't being sent.** Give someone the **Office Manager** position and set their CloudTalk agent ID + phone, or their RingCentral phone number.
- **The logo didn't change.** Make sure you picked a file and clicked **Save**; then refresh the page.
- **Where do I change the tax rate Special Order uses?** **Sales Tax (%)** on **Admin > Company settings > Company**.

**Where to find it:** Admin portal → sidebar **CRM > Deals**.

**Who sees it:** users with **Admin** access. Employees work their own deals at **CRM > Deals** in the Employee portal (see Employee Deals).

| Sales rep on cards | Not shown | Rep's name in the card's top-right corner |
| Drag between stages | Yes | No |
| **Add Deal** | Yes | No |
| Edit amount / activity deadline on the card | Yes | No |
| Red overdue icon in **Group** | Yes | No |

| Open a deal and change it | Yes | Yes (fewer buttons on **Project**, see below) |

### Toolbar

1. **Sales Rep**: **All**, or one sales rep (users with the Sales Rep position).
2. **Group**: which pipeline to show.
3. **Status**: **Active Deals**, **Won** or **Lost**.
4. **Menu** (☰):
   - **Status Filter**: **Active Deals**, **Won**, **Lost** (same as **Status**)
   - **Management**: **Manage Lists**, **Manage Questionnaires**
5. **Find Customer** (**Find customer or company**): click a name to highlight that customer's deal card. The board switches group and status if needed. The **pencil** opens the deal's **General** tab. The **trash** opens **Delete Deal**, which deletes the deal, not the customer.

Cards look like the employee board's (temperature dot, name, company, title, amount, next activity, deadline, lost reason, icons). Hover the list and note icons to read activities and notes. Click the customer name to open the deal.

### Opening a deal as an admin

The **Edit Deal** window has the same layout as for employees: the progress bar, tabs **Project**, **General**, **Files**, **Quotes**, and the activity panel on the right (**Activity** / **Notes**, **To Do**, **History**). **Project tab (admin)**

### Manage Lists (pipeline setup)

**Menu → Manage Lists** opens **Manage Deal Lists**. Every change saves at once and shows on all boards.

#### Groups (pipelines)

Each group is a separate board with its own columns (for example *Homeowners*, *Commercial*).

- **Add a group:** type a name in **New Group Name** (e.g. *Homeowners*) → **Add Group** (an empty name asks *Enter a group name*). The message **Group created successfully** appears. A new group starts with no lists.

- **Default / Assign leads here** switch: turn it on to make this group the company default. The message **Default group updated** appears. New deals that are created automatically (for example when a customer gets a sales rep and has no open deal) start in the first list of the default group. To change the default, turn the switch on for another group; you can't just turn it off.
- **Delete a group:** trash icon → **Delete group** ("Delete this group and its lists? This cannot be undone.") → **Delete**. The message **Group and its lists deleted successfully** appears.

The built-in starter group, marked **(Default)** after its name, is shared by every company. It can't be hidden or deleted, and its lists can't be added, reordered or deleted. You can still choose it as your default.

#### Lists (stages / columns)

- **Add:** type in **New list name...** → **Add List**. The list is added at the end. The message **List created successfully** appears.
- **Reorder:** drag a list by its grip handle. The order of columns on the boards follows this order.
- **Delete:** trash icon → **Delete list** (`Delete "…"?`) → **Delete**. The message **List deleted successfully** appears.

Groups and lists can't be renamed. To change a name, add a new list, then delete the old one.

**Careful:** deals in a deleted list (or in a deleted group's lists) no longer appear on any board. Move them first by having reps drag them to another column.

## Admin Instructions (Knowledge Base & Position Visibility)

Use **Instructions** to build your company's internal knowledge base: policies, pricing formulas, procedures, scripts and reference material. Admins create and organize the content; employees read what their **position** allows, and the **AI Chat** (default mode) uses it to answer questions.

**Where to find it (Admin):** Switch to the **Admin** view in the sidebar header → **Resources > Instructions**. Page title: **Instructions**.

**Where employees read it:** **Employee** view → **Resources > Instructions**.

**Who can add, edit, reorder and delete:** any user with **Admin** access (the Manager position is not needed). Employees without Admin access can only read.

---

### Company vs General instructions

| Library | What it is | Who manages it | Who reads it |
|---------|-----------|----------------|--------------|
| **Company instructions** | Your company's own instruction tree | Your admins | Your employees |
| **General instructions** | Shared instructions provided for every company on Granite Manager | Platform superusers only | Every employee (tab on the employee page) |

- On the **admin** page, the **Company instructions** / **General instructions** tabs appear only for platform superusers. Everyone else (including users with the **Super Admin** position) sees and edits only the company tree, without tabs.
- On the **employee** page, both tabs are always shown.
- **Visible to** limits apply in both libraries.

---

### The admin page

Admins always see the **full** tree — **Visible to** settings never hide anything here.

| Control | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| **Add Instruction** | Opens the **Add instruction** dialog |
| **Search instructions...** | Searches titles and text. Each match says **Found in title** or **Found in content**; **No instructions found** when nothing matches. Click a match to show only that instruction (with its sub-instructions); click **X** (**Clear search**) to see the whole tree again |
| Click a title | Expands or collapses its text and sub-instructions |
| **Grip handle** (**Drag to reorder**) | Drag to change the order of instructions at the same level (under the same parent). The new order saves automatically. Dragging is off while a search result is selected |
| **Pencil** (**Edit instruction**) | Opens **Edit Instruction** |
| **Trash** (**Delete instruction**) | Opens **Delete Instruction** |

With no instructions yet, the page shows **No instructions yet** and a **Create First Instruction** button.

---

### Adding an instruction

1. **Admin > Resources > Instructions** → **Add Instruction**.
2. In **Add instruction**, fill in:

| Field | Required? | Notes |
|-------|-----------|-------|
| **Title** | Yes | Placeholder **Name of the instruction**. Error if empty: **Title is required** |
| **Parent** | No | **Main** (default) = top level; or pick an existing instruction to put this one under it |
| **After** | No | **First** (default) = first under the chosen parent; or pick the sibling it should follow |
| **Visible to** | No | Which positions can read it (see below). Default **Everyone** |
| **Text** | No | Rich text: headings, bold/italic/underline/strikethrough, numbered and bulleted lists, text and highlight color, links, images, and clear formatting |

3. Click **Add Instruction**. Toast: **Instruction added** (on failure: **Could not add the instruction**). The dialog closes and the tree refreshes.

---

### Editing an instruction

1. Click the **pencil** on the instruction (use search first to find it).
2. In **Edit Instruction**, change **Title**, **Visible to** and/or **Text**.
3. Click **Save changes**. Toast: **Instruction updated** (on failure: **Could not save the instruction**).

The edit dialog has no **Parent** / **After** fields — the instruction keeps its place. To change the order, drag it with the grip handle. To move it under a different parent, add it again under the new parent and delete the old one.

---

### Deleting an instruction

1. Click the **trash** icon.
2. **Delete Instruction** asks: *Are you sure you want to delete [title]?*
3. Click **Delete Instruction** (close the dialog to cancel). Toast: **instruction Deleted**.

Deleting is permanent. Sub-instructions under it are **not** deleted — they move up to the top level.

---

### Setting position visibility (Visible to)

Each instruction has its own **Visible to** setting that limits which staff positions can read it.

**Where:** in **Add instruction** (below **Parent** / **After**, above **Text**) and **Edit Instruction** (below **Title**, above **Text**).

**How:**

1. Hover over (or tab to) the **Visible to** label. A panel of switches opens, one per position.
2. Turn **on** each position that should see the instruction.
3. Save (**Add Instruction** or **Save changes**).

The gray line under **Visible to** shows the result:

| Summary | Meaning |
|---------|---------|
| **Everyone** | No switches on — every employee can read it |
| A list of positions, e.g. `Sales Representative, Shop Worker` | Only users with **at least one** of those positions can read it |

**Switches in the panel:** **Sales Representative**, **Sales Manager**, **Shop Manager**, **Shop Worker**, **Manager**, **Installer**, **Marketing**, **Office Manager**, **Template Guy**. **Super Admin** and **Walk-in** are not in the panel. (**Template Guy** is the template technician position; besides **Visible to**, it sends that person's login to the template schedule portal.)

**How matching works:**

- Users' positions come from **Admin > Company settings > Users > Edit > Positions**, in the company they are working in.
- Each instruction has its own setting; sub-instructions do **not** copy the parent's setting, so set each one. But on the Instructions page, when a parent is hidden from a user, everything under it is hidden from them too.
- A restricted instruction disappears completely for users without a matching position — from the tree, the outline and search.

| Where | Filtered by Visible to? |
|-------|-------------------------|
| **Employee view > Resources > Instructions** (both tabs) | **Yes** |
| **AI Chat** (default mode) answers | **Yes** — the AI Chat only uses company instructions the signed-in user's positions allow, even for admins |
| **Teach Mode** quizzes | **No** — quizzes use their own **Visible to employees** setting (see **Teach Mode & Employee Progress**) |
| **Admin view > Resources > Instructions** | **No** — admins see everything to edit it |

---

### Employee Instructions page

**Employee** view → **Resources > Instructions**. Read-only.

| Feature | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| **Company instructions** / **General instructions** tabs | Switch libraries |
| Accordion | Click a title to open its text and sub-instructions |
| **Outline** panel (right side; hidden on phones) | The tree of titles; click one to open it and scroll to it, click again to close it |
| **Search...** (in the Outline) | Finds titles and text among the instructions you can see; results say **Found in Title** or **Found in Content**; **No results found** otherwise |

**Chat sources:** when the **AI Chat** (default mode) answers from an instruction, it lists it under **Source** / **Sources**. Clicking a source opens that instruction on the Instructions page.

---

### Typical workflows

**Restrict pricing procedures to sales staff**

1. **Admin > Resources > Instructions** → pencil on the pricing instruction (or **Add Instruction**).
2. Hover **Visible to** → turn on **Sales Representative** and **Sales Manager** only.
3. **Save changes**. Other positions no longer see it on their Instructions page or in AI Chat answers.

**Make an instruction visible to everyone again**

1. Open it with the pencil.
2. Under **Visible to**, turn **off** every switch so the summary reads **Everyone**.
3. **Save changes**.

**Give a new hire access to restricted instructions**

1. **Admin > Company settings > Users** → **Actions > Edit** → turn on the right position(s) → **Save**.
2. Instructions visible to those positions appear for them the next time they open Instructions.

---

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **Why can't I add or edit instructions?** You need **Admin** access and must be in the **Admin** view (sidebar header switch). The Employee view page is read-only.
- **An employee can't see an instruction.** Its **Visible to** list doesn't include any of their positions. Add one of their positions, or set it back to **Everyone**.
- **Admins see an item that employees don't.** Normal: the admin page ignores **Visible to**.
- **I don't see the General instructions tab as an admin.** On the admin page that tab is for platform superusers only; you can still read general instructions in the Employee view.
- **How do I move an instruction under another parent?** Edit can't change the parent. Add it again under the new parent (copy the text), then delete the old one. Use drag-and-drop for order within the same level.
- **I can't drag.** Clear the search first — dragging is off while one search result is shown.
- **I deleted a parent and its children moved.** Deleting only removes that one instruction; its sub-instructions move to the top level.
- **The AI Chat doesn't use an instruction.** In its default mode the AI Chat reads only your company instructions that your positions can see.

## Granite Phone (Telnyx): connecting Telnyx, the Phone page, porting and texting registration

**Granite Phone** is Granite Manager's own phone service, built on **Telnyx**: company phone numbers that ring in the **Granite Phone** app (iPhone and Android) and in the browser phone, texting from those numbers in **CRM > SMS**, call recording, moving (porting) your existing numbers to Telnyx, and the carriers' texting registration (10DLC). It is being rolled out, so the **Phone** page is not in most users' sidebars yet.

**Who connects Telnyx:** a Granite Manager **platform superuser**, in the company's **Telnyx** dialog on **Superuser Dashboard > Companies** (see *Connecting a company to Telnyx* below). ### Connecting a company to Telnyx (platform superusers)

1. Open **Superuser Dashboard > Companies**.
2. On the company's card, open the **⋯** menu and click **Telnyx**. The **Telnyx — <company>** dialog opens.
3. **Calling:** **Calling enabled** is the company's switch (*when off, the app can't make or receive calls*). Optional **Daily call limit per user** (outgoing calls one person places in a day) and **Minimum app version** (an older Granite Phone app must update before it can call); empty means **Server default**.
4. **Telnyx resources** — the ids from the Telnyx portal (*Leave a field empty when the resource does not exist yet*): **Credential connection ID**, **TeXML application ID**, **Outbound voice profile ID**, **Billing group ID**, **Telnyx account ID** (once set, a call request that names another Telnyx account, or none, is refused; empty: not checked), **AI Assistant ID** (takes messages on numbers set to AI; without one those calls go to voicemail), **Messaging profile ID** (texting from the company's numbers; empty = no texting through Telnyx) and **Fallback TeXML URL** (where Telnyx sends a call when Granite Manager's server fails; empty: the server default).
5. **Recording:** **Recording mode** — **Off: no calls are recorded**, **Incoming calls only**, or **Incoming and outgoing calls** (callers hear *This call may be recorded* before it rings), and the **Recording notice audio URL** played to customers who answer a recorded outgoing call. A user who turns off **Recording voice** on **My Account → Phone lines → Granite Manager** records their own outgoing calls without the notice.
6. **Business hours and holidays:** **Use business hours** (on: main lines ring only during the hours below; off: main lines ring at all hours), the time zone (for example *America/Indiana/Indianapolis*), the open and close time of each day (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday; a close time before the open time says *Closes before it opens*), and **Holidays** (dates as YYYY-MM-DD, separated by commas or one per line). Main lines ring during business hours; after hours and on holidays callers get the number's no-answer action.
7. Click **Save** (toast **Telnyx setup saved**). After the first save the dialog stays open and shows the **Webhooks**: **Inbound calls**, **Call status**, **Outbound calls** and **Texts**, each with **Copy** and where it goes in the Telnyx portal (TeXML application Voice URL and Status callback URL, credential connection Webhook URL, messaging profile Webhook URL). Paste them into the Telnyx portal. They carry the company's private token: keep them out of chats and tickets. Before the first save the dialog says *The webhook URLs appear here after the first save.*; after it, *Saved. Paste the webhook URLs above into Telnyx.*

The card's **⋯** menu also has **10DLC texting**, which opens the company's texting registration for the Granite Manager team; **Texting registrations (10DLC)** at the top of the page lists every company's registration.

### The Phone page (Admin > Company settings > Phone)

**Who can use it:** company admins, Super Admins and platform superusers. **Texting registration (10DLC)** on it is for users with the **Manager** position.

#### Status
Three tiles: **Calling** (**On** / **Off**), **Call recording** (**Off**, **Incoming calls**, **Incoming and outgoing calls**) and **Telnyx** (**Set up** / **Not set up**). *Telnyx isn't set up for this company yet. Ask a superuser.* means the company is not connected; *Calling is turned off for this company…* means a superuser switched calling off.

#### Numbers — who each number rings
1. Get the numbers: click **Buy a number** to buy a new local number (see *Buy a number* below), or **Import numbers from Telnyx** to bring in the numbers the company already has in Telnyx. Both work only once Telnyx is set up; before that the list says *Numbers show up here once Telnyx is set up for this company.* A company with none yet sees *No numbers yet. Buy one, or import the ones you have in Telnyx.*
2. The table shows **Number**, **Label**, **Kind** (**Direct**, **Shared**, **Main line**), **Rings**, **Can call from it**, **No answer** and **Active**.
3. To set a number up, open the row's **⋯** menu → **Edit**. In **Edit <number>**:
   - **Number:** **Label** (for example *Main line, Sales, Anna direct*), **Kind**, and **Active** (*Turn off to stop using this number in Granite Phone.*).
   - **When nobody answers:** **No-answer action** — **AI Assistant** (takes a message), **Voicemail** or **Forward to another number** (**Forward to**, a US or Canada number), and the **Voicemail greeting** read to callers before they leave a voicemail (empty: a standard greeting; example *Sorry we missed your call. Please leave a message after the tone.*).
   - **People:** for each user tick **Rings** (their phones ring for calls to this number) and **Can call from it** (they may use it as their caller ID). A company without users says *This company has no users yet.*
4. Click **Save** (toast **Number saved**).

A user who **can call from** a number gets a Granite Phone line: the **Phone** button in the sidebar footer (browser phone) and, when the company texts through Telnyx, **CRM > SMS** for that line. Their earlier texts come along: when they get the line (or the company starts texting through Telnyx), their CloudTalk and RingCentral texts (those they sent, those under their agent ID or extension, and those on their own numbers) are copied to Granite Phone, so **CRM > SMS** still shows them. A **Shared** or **Main line** stays with the line: its texts don't move with one person.

#### Buy a number — a new local number
**Price:** Granite Manager charges **$4.99 a month for each number** bought here (*A local US number for calls and texts. Each number costs $4.99 a month.*).

1. On the Phone page, click **Buy a number** (greyed out until Telnyx is set up for the company). The **Buy a number** dialog opens.
2. Type the **Area code** (three digits, for example *317* for Indianapolis) and click **Search** (or press Enter). Anything else says *Enter a three-digit area code, like 317.*
3. **Numbers for sale in <area code>** lists up to 12 local US numbers that can call and text, each with its town and state (for example *Indianapolis, IN*). *No numbers for sale in <area code>. Try a nearby area code.* means Telnyx has none there right now.
4. Pick a number. Its monthly price shows next to the buttons (for example *317-463-2626: $4.99 a month*). Click **Buy number**.
5. The toast says *Bought <number>. Open its Edit to choose who it rings.* The number joins the list as an active **Direct** line that rings nobody yet, with the **AI Assistant** when nobody answers. Open its **⋯** menu → **Edit** to give it a label and choose who it rings and who can call from it. When the company texts through Telnyx, the number is set up for texting too.

**When a number can't be bought:** *Telnyx could not sell that number. It may be taken: search again.* (someone else bought it first: search again and pick another), *That number is in Granite Manager already.*, *Calling is turned off for your company. Contact Granite Manager support.* (a superuser switched calling off), and *Your company has 25 numbers, the most it can buy here. Ask the Granite Manager team for more.* (a company can hold up to 25 active numbers; the Granite Manager team can add more).

#### Port numbers — moving your existing numbers to Telnyx
*Move your existing numbers from RingCentral, CloudTalk or another carrier to Telnyx. Keep your current service until a port completes.*

1. Click **Port numbers**. In **Port numbers to Telnyx** (*Step 1 of 2: the numbers to move*), type the **Numbers** (one per line, US and Canada only, at most 50 at a time; numbers on the same carrier account are best ported together) and an optional **Label** (*Label (optional)*: what the numbers are called on the Phone page once they arrive), then click **Check numbers**. An opened port is titled with its numbers (or *Port to Telnyx*).
2. *Step 2 of 2: what Telnyx says about each number*: **Can port**, **Can port (FastPort: same day)**, **Can't port: <reason>**, **Already on Telnyx** or **Already in a port** (*Every number can be ported.* when all can; *None of these numbers can be ported.* when none). Click **Start the port**: only the numbers that can port go in. *Port started*; when Telnyx splits the numbers into several orders (by carrier or type), finish each one.
3. Open the port from the list (**Continue** for a draft, **Open** otherwise). A port has two tabs, **Details** (the steps, while it can still change) and **Status**. *Copy these from your current carrier's bill exactly: Telnyx compares them with the carrier's records.*
   - **1. Business details** — **Account holder**: **Business name on the account**, **Authorized person** (who signs the LOA), **Billing number (BTN)** (the main number on the bill), **Account number**, **Port-out PIN** (ask your carrier for one; RingCentral and most wireless carriers need it; once saved, leave it empty to keep it). **Service address**: street, **Suite or floor (optional)**, city, state or province, ZIP, **Country** (United States or Canada). **Which numbers move**: *Are all the numbers on this account moving?* **Yes, every number (full port)** or **No, some stay (partial port)**; for a partial port, **The numbers that stay**: **Keep them in service** or **Disconnect them**, and the **New billing number** of the account that stays. **Save and continue**.
   - **2. Documents** — **Letter of Authorization (LOA)**: **Download the LOA to sign** (Telnyx's LOA filled in from the business details), have the authorized person sign it and upload it as **Signed LOA**. **Recent bill**: a bill from the current carrier from the last 30 days showing the account number and the numbers (PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 4 MB). Each shows **Not attached yet** until uploaded. **Continue**.
   - **3. Port date** — pick one of the dates and times Telnyx offers → **Save and continue**. *Could not load the dates Telnyx offers. Save the business details first.* means step 1 is not saved yet; *Telnyx offers no dates yet. Try again later.*
   - **4. Review & submit** — a checklist (business details from the current bill, service address, *Signed Letter of Authorization*, *Recent bill from the current carrier*, port date). **Submit the port** (**Submit again** after Telnyx sends it back) → *Submitted. Follow it on the Status tab.*
4. **Status** tab: **What Telnyx found** (problems Telnyx reported), the port date, the **Telnyx support key** (given once submitted; quote it to Telnyx), **Requirements** (each **To do**, **Being reviewed**, **Approved** or **Telnyx needs it again**, with an upload for the ones to redo), a **Timeline**, and **Comments with Telnyx**: *Telnyx's porting team writes here when they need something*; type in **Write to Telnyx's porting team** and send.
5. **Delete draft** (*Delete this draft? Nothing was sent to your carrier.* → **Yes, delete**) or **Cancel port** (*Cancel this port? The numbers stay with your current carrier.* → **Yes, cancel the port**) at the bottom, while Telnyx allows it.

**Port statuses:** **Draft** (not submitted), **In process**, **Submitted**, **Needs attention** (Telnyx sent it back: see **What Telnyx found** and **Requirements**, fix, **Submit again**), **Date confirmed** (Telnyx confirmed the port date), **Ported** (the numbers are on Telnyx), **Cancelling**, **Cancelled**, **Deleted**.

The list shows each port's **Numbers**, **Status**, **Port date** (*(requested)* until Telnyx confirms it, *Not set* before one is picked) and **Updated**. *No ports yet. Numbers can be ported once Telnyx is set up for this company.*

#### Texting registration (10DLC)
US carriers block business texts from local numbers until the business and how it texts are registered. Click **Fill it out** (later **Continue**, or **View**), fill in **Business**, **How you text** and **Review**, then **Mark as ready**; the Granite Manager team sends it to the carriers. Every field, the AI check and the statuses: see **Texting registration (10DLC)**.

Managers who are not admins fill it out on the **Texting registration** page (`/employee/texting-registration`), which is not in the sidebar during the rollout.

#### Phones — the Granite Phone app
*Phones signed in to the Granite Phone app in this company.* Each row shows the **Phone**, the **Person**, **Last seen** and **Signed in**. Click **Revoke** for a phone that was lost or stolen, or that belongs to someone who left. Each user can also sign out their own phones on **My Account** → **Signed-in devices**. Phones are also signed out on their own: 12 months after signing in, after 30 days unused, or when the user can no longer use Granite Phone (deleted, moved to another company, no longer an employee or admin, or the company deleted).

## Admin Quotes: extras catalog

**Extras** are items added to a quote besides the stone work: tear out, sealer, plumbing, delivery and so on. The company keeps one **catalog** of extras shared by every price list. Each price list offers every catalog extra at the catalog price unless the list switches it off or gives it its own price.

**Where to find it:**
- The catalog: **Admin** → sidebar **Quotes** → **Extras** tab.
- Per-list choices: **Admin** → **Quotes** → **Price Lists** → open a list → **Extras** section.

**Who:** users with Admin access. Salespeople add extras to a quote with **Add Other Item** (the **Item** list shows the extras the quote's price list offers).

---

### The Extras tab (catalog)

The **Extras** section: "Extras such as tear out, shared by every price list. A price list offers each one at the price set here, unless it switches it off or sets its own price (Price lists > Extras). Renaming an extra or an option here renames it everywhere."

Each extra is one line: name, tags (**Every new quote**, **Price hidden**, **Taxable**) and a price summary (e.g. "$150", "$100 – $300 · 3 options", "From $5/sq ft · 2 size tiers"). Unsaved changes show **Edited**. Click a line to open it for editing; click again to close it.

Extras are grouped by **category** (extras with no category are under **Uncategorized**).

#### Add an extra

1. Click **Add Extra**. **Add extra** opens.
2. **Name** — must be unique ("An item called "…" already exists.").
3. **Price** — choose:
   - **Fixed price (one price, or options to pick from)**
   - **Per unit (sq ft, lin ft, each…)**
4. **Category** — optional, e.g. "Tear out", "Plumbing" (pick an existing one or type a new one).
5. **Price lists** — untick any list that should not offer it (all are ticked).
6. Click **Save**. It is created right away ("Added "Name".") and opens so you can set its prices.

#### Edit an extra

Open it and change:

- **Name** (renames it on every price list).
- **Fixed price** extras: one row per option — option name (with a single option it is an optional description: *Description (optional)*), **$** price, and **Default** (which option is picked first). **Add Option** adds another; the trash icon removes one.
- **Per unit** extras: **Units:** (e.g. sq ft, lin ft, each) and size tiers — **Up to** (empty = **No limit**), **Price /ea** and **Price /unit**. **+ Size tier** adds a tier.
- Settings on the right:
  - **Editable on quote** — salespeople can change the price on a quote.
  - **Discountable** — quote discounts apply (*Quote discounts apply to this price*).
  - **Taxable** — taxed at the quote's tax rate.
  - **Hide price on quote** — the customer sees the line without its price.
  - **Add to every new quote** — added automatically to each new quote.
  - **Fill amount from area sq ft** (per-unit extras only) — on a quote the amount follows the area's fabrication sq ft and updates with the drawing.

Then click **Save changes** in the bar at the bottom right (**Saved** / **Extras saved.**). **Discard** undoes all unsaved edits. If saving fails, a red **Could not save** message appears.

#### Delete an extra

Open it → **Delete Item** → confirm "Delete "Name" from the catalog? Every price list stops offering it once you save. Quotes made with it keep their line." → **Save changes**.

#### Search, sort and reorder

- **Search extras…** filters by name, category or option name (Esc or the x clears it).
- **Sort** → **A to Z** / **Z to A** sorts the extras inside each category (categories keep their order).
- Drag an extra by its grip to move it inside its category; drag a category header (*Drag to reorder the … category*) to move the whole category. Reordering is off while searching.
- Then **Save changes**.

The order here is the order salespeople see.

#### "Price lists still have N extras of their own"

If older price lists still have their own extras, a yellow box offers **Move into the catalog**: "extras with the same name become one catalog extra, and each list keeps its own prices where they differ." Save or discard your changes first.

---

### The Extras section of a price list

Open a price list → **Extras**. It has a search box (**Search extras…**) and two parts.

#### Catalog extras

"Extras from Admin > Quotes > Extras, shared by every price list."

- **Checkbox** before the name — untick to stop offering the extra on quotes made with this list ("Not offered on quotes made with this price list."). Unticked extras move to a **Disabled** group at the bottom.
- Click the price summary to open the price table: **Option** (or **Tier**: *Up to N <unit>*, the last one *Over that*), **Catalog** price, **Price in this list**, **Result**. For each option or tier choose:
  - **Catalog** — follows the catalog price (changes when the catalog changes).
  - **Price** — this list's own fixed price.
  - **± $** / **± %** — the catalog price plus or minus dollars or a percent (follows catalog changes).
- An extra with its own prices shows an **Own price** badge.

If the catalog is empty: **No catalog extras yet. Add them in Admin > Quotes > Extras.**

#### Only in this price list

"Extras this list offers that are not in the catalog." **Add Other Item** → **Add other item** (Name, Price type, Category) → **Save**; then set prices the same way as catalog extras. **Reorder** shows up/down arrows for extras and categories; **Done** ends it. A category name can be renamed in place. **Delete Item** removes one ("It is gone once you save.").

Changes in a price list are stored only when you click the list's **Save changes**.

---

### Common questions

- **An extra doesn't show on a quote's Item list.** The quote's price list has it unticked (check **Price Lists** → list → **Extras**), or it was deleted.
- **I changed an extra's price but an old quote didn't change.** Quotes keep their prices; open the quote and click **Update prices** in the yellow banner.
- **An extra should be on every quote.** Tick **Add to every new quote** and **Save changes**. It is added to quotes created after that.
- **One price list needs a different price.** Open that list → **Extras** → open the extra → **Price** (or **± $** / **± %**) → **Save changes**.
- **Save error "Extra … has both options and a per-unit price; keep one."** An extra can be either fixed-price options or per-unit tiers, not both.

## Admin Quotes: quote forms and contract forms

**Forms** are the page layouts a quote is printed, emailed and signed with: the company header, quote info, the drawing, the price lines, totals, terms text and images. There are two kinds:

- **Quote Forms** — "Printed and emailed quote layouts."
- **Contract Forms** — "Contracts end with signature lines and are sent to the customer to sign from the Contract button on a quote."

**Where to find it:** **Admin** → sidebar **Quotes** → **Forms** tab.

**Who:** users with Admin access create and design forms. Salespeople only pick a form on a quote.

---

### Where forms are used on a quote

- **Print** → **Print Quote** → **Print quote using** — lists active quote forms, then active contract forms.
- Emailing a quote → **Form** — lists active quote forms (eye icon **Preview** opens it).
- **Contract** button → **Send Contract** → **Contract form** — lists active contract forms (when there is only one, it is used directly).

Until the company has made any forms, quotes use built-in layouts: **Quote (line items)**, **Quote (subtotals only)**, **Quote (total only)**, **Contract**, **Drawing & Layout (no prices)**. Once forms exist, only your active forms are offered. If forms exist but none is a contract form, the **Contract** button is disabled ("Add a contract form in Admin › Quotes › Forms").

---

### The Forms tab

Two sections, **Quote Forms** and **Contract Forms**, each with an **Add** button and columns **Form Template**, **Sequence** and **Status** (**Active** / **Inactive**).

Row buttons:
- **Design** (pencil) — opens the designer (clicking the name does the same).
- **Duplicate** (copy icon) — makes "… (copy)". Toast **Form duplicated**.
- **Activate** / **Deactivate** (power icon) — inactive forms are not offered on quotes. Toast **Form activated** / **Form deactivated**.
- **Delete** (red trash) — confirm **Delete form** → "Delete "Name"?" Toast **Form deleted**.

**Order:** drag a row by its grip (**Drag to reorder**). The order is the order forms are offered on quotes; the first one is preselected.

#### Create a form

1. Click **Add** in **Quote Forms** (dialog **Add Form**) or **Contract Forms** (dialog **Add Contract Form**).
2. Type a **Name** (empty shows **Name is required**).
3. Click **Create**. Toast **Form created**; the designer opens with only the company header.

## Admin Quotes: price list fabrication, edges, cutouts and sinks

These are the sections of a price list after **Materials**. They set what a quote charges for fabrication, installation, miters and waterfalls, finished edges, appliance edges, splashes, corners and bumpouts, cutouts and sinks.

**Where to find it:** **Admin** → sidebar **Quotes** → **Price Lists** → click a list's name → pick a section on the left: **Fabrication & install**, **Mitered Edges & Waterfalls**, **Finished Edges**, **Appliance Edges**, **Splashes**, **Curves & Bumpouts**, **Cutouts**, **Sinks**.

**Who:** users with Admin access. Nothing is stored until you click **Save changes** in the bar at the bottom right (see "Admin Quotes: price lists and material prices" for saving, history and restore).

---

### How a price block works ("Price for: Default")

Most sections are made of blocks with the same layout:

- **Price for: Default — All Materials** — the price every material uses. If it is missing the block says **Not set.**; click **Add Default Price** (or **Add Default Settings**).
- **Add Specific Material Price** — opens **Add specific material price**: pick **Material** and **Color** (**All colors** or one color) → **Apply**. That material or color then gets its own price instead of the default. A material can have only one price per color (**This material already has its own price.**).
- **Add Price for Every Material** — adds a copy of the default price for each material that has none yet, so you can edit them one by one.
- **Delete Price** — removes a specific price (confirm; "It is gone once you save.").

Each price also has these settings on its right:
- **Hide On Quote** — the line shows on the quote without its price.
- **Allow Discount** — quote discounts apply to this line.
- **Editable Price on Quote** — salespeople can change this price on a quote.
- **Tax Code:** — **None Selected**, **Tax code 1** or **Tax code 2**. Either code makes the line taxable at the quote's tax rate; **None Selected** means not taxed.

Blocks whose title says **Settings for:** (Splash, Mitered Edge and Waterfall Material) only choose how the line shows; the price comes from the material.

Prices by size use rows **Up to N″** with a price, and a last row **Over N″** (a single row reads **[Any Size]**). Click **Add Size** for another size row; the trash icon removes one.

---

### Fabrication & install

- **Fabrication** — $ per sq ft, plus **Enabled** / **Disabled**. "Colors priced by the slab always get this fabrication line (the slab price is only the stone), even when Disabled, and need a price above $0. Colors priced by the sq ft get it only when Enabled."
- **Installation** — $ per sq ft, plus **Enabled** / **Disabled**.

Both can be set per material (e.g. a higher fabrication price for quartzite).

---

### Mitered Edges & Waterfalls

- **Mitered Edge and Waterfall Material** — settings only (**Hide On Quote**, **Tax Code**). The material is charged at the color's price.
- **Mitered Cuts** — "Price for miters needed for waterfalls and mitered edges."
  - **Measure miters by:** **Glued joint (once)** (a 24" miter = 2 lin ft) or **Both cut pieces** (= 4 lin ft).
  - **$ /lin ft** and/or **$ each** (per miter). Leave a price empty to skip it.
- **Waterfall Installation** — $ each, "Charged per waterfall leg."

---

The left column lists **Default · All Materials** and any per-material edge prices. **Add price per material** adds one (starting as a copy of the default), and you pick its material and color at the top (**Price for:**). The trash icon at the top right (**Remove this price**) removes it after **Delete price** (*Delete the finished edge prices for <material>? They are gone once you save.*).

For the selected price:

1. **Price Settings** — **Allow Discount**, **Editable Price on Quote**, **Tax Code**.
2. **Price Group** — optional shared prices. **Add Price Groups** adds a group with a name and a $/lin ft price; edges set to that group all use it.
3. **Finished Edges** — **Add Finished Edge** → **Add finished edge** → **Name** → **Apply**. For each edge:
   - Click the picture (**Change drawing**) to choose the edge profile drawing shown on quotes (**Select Drawing**). The drawings: Flat / Square, Eased, Pencil, 1/4" Bevel, 1/2" Bevel, 3/4" Bevel, Double Bevel, Full Bevel, Full Bevel Eased, Full Bullnose, Half Bullnose, Demi Bullnose, Bead Bullnose, Ogee Bullnose, Undercut Bullnose, Stepped Bullnose, Stepped Half Bullnose, Quarter Round, Stepped Quarter Round, Step Half Round, Cove, Double Cove, French Cove, Cove Step, Cove Dupont, Ogee, Roman Ogee, Reverse Ogee, Long Ogee, Double Ogee, Triple Ogee, Ogee Cove, Ogee Bead, Ogee Pencil, Dupont, Dupont Ogee, Shark Nose, Shark Nose Eased, Mitered, Mitered Chiseled, Chiseled, Crescent, Cascade, Triple Waterfall, Stepped Bead, V-Groove and Laminated. No drawing: *No edge drawing*.
   - Click the name to rename it.

If no edges are priced yet you see **Finished edges are not priced yet.** with **Add Default Price**.

Salespeople pick these edges for each area of the quote.

### Common questions
