## Admin Quotes: price lists and material prices

A **price list** holds every price a quote uses: materials and colors, fabrication and install, edges, splashes, corners, cutouts, sinks and extras. A company can have several lists (for example "Retail 2026" and "Builder"). Each quote is priced with one list.

**Where to find it:** Switch to **Admin** → sidebar **Quotes** → **Price Lists** tab (the tab Admin > Quotes opens on).

**Who can change price lists:** users with Admin access (admins, Super Admins, platform superusers). Salespeople only pick a list on a quote.

---

### The price lists page

Heading **Price lists**: "Materials, colors, fabrication, edges, sinks and extras your salespeople can quote. Each company has its own lists; quotes keep the prices they were created with until they are re-priced. Drag to reorder."

Columns:
- **Name** — click it to open the list's prices. The list new quotes get has a **Default** badge.
- **Revision** — number of the current saved version (**Not saved** if it has never been saved).
- **Status** — **Active** or **Inactive** (inactive rows are grayed).
- **Created Date**, **Created By**, **Units** (**Inches** / **Millimeters**), **Expiration Days**.

Row buttons (right side):
- **Star** (**Make default for new quotes**) — not shown on the current default. Toast **Default price list updated**.
- **Duplicate** (copy icon) — makes "… (copy)" with the same prices, placed right after it, and opens it. Toast **Price list copied**.
- **Deactivate** / **Activate** — toast **Price list deactivated** / **Price list activated**.
- **Delete** (red trash) — confirm "Delete "Name"? Existing quotes keep their prices, but it can no longer be picked for new quotes." Toast **Price list deleted**.

**Reorder:** drag a row (toast **Order saved**). This is the order lists are offered to salespeople.

#### Create a price list

1. Under the table, type a name in **New price list** (e.g. "Retail 2026").
2. Click **Create**. Toast **Price list created**; the new list opens for editing.

An empty name shows **Give the price list a name.** A name already used shows "Name" already exists.

#### Which list does a new quote use?

- **Create Quote** preselects the default list; the salesperson can pick another in **Price list**.
- The default is the starred list if it is active and saved; otherwise the first active saved list in the order shown.
- Only **Active** lists with a saved revision are offered in **Create Quote**, **Copy Quote Revision** and **Change Price List** (in the quote's **Pricing Settings**).
- Deactivating or deleting a list does not change quotes already made with it.

---

### Editing a price list

Click the list's name. At the top: **← Price lists** (back), the list **name** box, an **Active** / **Inactive** switch, and **Revision N**.

On the left are the sections:
**Settings**, **Materials**, **Fabrication & install**, **Mitered Edges & Waterfalls**, **Finished Edges**, **Appliance Edges**, **Splashes**, **Curves & Bumpouts**, **Cutouts**, **Sinks**, **Extras**. The editor opens on **Materials**.

#### Saving

1. Make changes in any sections (they are kept while you switch sections).
2. A bar appears at the bottom right. Optionally type a note (**Change note**) in **What changed? (optional)**.
3. Click **Save changes**. The message **Prices saved.** appears and a new revision is created.

- **Discard** throws away all unsaved changes.
- Leaving the page with unsaved changes asks: **You have unsaved price changes. Leave without saving?**
- Renaming the list or switching **Active** also needs **Save changes**.
- If something is ambiguous the save is refused and red messages list the problems, e.g. "Material "X" is listed more than once.", "… has two prices for the same material.", "…: its levels overlap with price group "…"", "…: set both levels of the range.", "Default cooktop cutout: set a length and width above 0.", "Extra "…" has both options and a per-unit price; keep one."

#### History and restoring an old version

On the **Settings** section, **History** lists every revision: **#number**, date and time, who saved it and the note. The current one says **Current**.

1. Click **Restore** on an older revision.
2. Confirm "Restore revision N? It becomes a new revision…" (unsaved changes are discarded).
3. The message **Restored revision N.** appears.

#### How changes reach quotes

Saving does not change existing quotes. When a quote's prices differ from today's price list, inventory prices or catalog extras, the quote shows **Prices changed since this quote was priced: N lines would change. The quote keeps its prices until you update them.** with **Show changes** and **Update prices**. New quotes always use the latest revision.

---

### Settings section

| Field | What it does |
|-------|--------------|
| **Units:** | Shows the list's units (inches). Read only. |
| **Standalone Default Tax Rate:** | Tax rate filled in on new quotes made with this list (choices from **Admin > Quotes > Tax Rates**, or **-None-**). |
| **Standalone Default Payment Terms:** | Payment terms filled in on new quotes made with this list. With **-None-**, the company's first payment terms are used. |
| **Expiration Days:** | A new quote expires this many days after it is created. Must be 0 or more (**Enter a number of 0 or more**). |
| **Rounding Options:** | Line prices rounded to **$0.01** or to whole dollars (**$1**). |
| **Supplier Color Markup %:** | Added when a salesperson prices a color with **Price from Supplier** on a quote: the supplier's price per sq ft, plus the company sales tax, plus this markup. |
| **Material Rounding:** | Square feet rounded to **Nearest .1 feet (Default)** or **Round up to whole feet**. |

---

### Materials section (materials and colors)

**Materials & colors** lists the colors in stock in **Inventory > Stones**, grouped by material (stone type), plus materials and colors added only in this list. Every stocked color is quoted at its inventory (retail) price per sq ft unless you adjust it here.

Use **Search materials or colors** to filter. Click a material to expand it. Its subtitle shows "N colors in stock · N priced" (or "Added here · …" for a material added in this list).

#### Price groups (whole list)

The **Price groups** box at the top makes one adjustment for a range of stone levels: "Make a group once, e.g. levels 1 to 3 at -$2 or +10%, and pick the materials it applies to."

1. Click **+ Price group** (named "Group 1", "Group 2"…; all materials ticked).
2. **Group** — type a name.
3. **Price** — pick how it is set:
   - **Price** — a fixed price per sq ft (does not follow inventory). In the colors table, hovering a price says which it is: *Fixed price: won't follow the inventory price* or *Inventory price with the adjustment*. The pencil (**Edit color**) opens a color.
   - **± $** — inventory price plus or minus dollars per sq ft (e.g. -2).
   - **± %** — inventory price plus or minus a percent (e.g. 10 or -5).
4. **Levels** — first and last stone level (only levels in stock are listed).
5. **Per slab** — tick when the price is per sq ft of full slabs used.
6. **Materials** — click material chips to include or exclude them.

With no groups, every color is quoted at its inventory price. Levels of two groups must not overlap.

#### Inside a material

- **Default slab size** — width × height in inches, used when a color has no size of its own.
- Price settings: **Editable on quote** (salespeople can change the price on a quote), **Discountable** (quote discounts apply), **Taxable**, **Hide price on quote** (the customer sees the line without its price).
- **Price groups** chips — click to include this material in a list-wide group.
- **Colors** table:
  - **Color** — a **Custom** tag means it was added in this list, not in Inventory > Stones.
  - **Price group** — the group by level is shown automatically ("Group (level N)"); pick another group to override, or **None**.
  - **Inventory price** — retail price from Inventory > Stones.
  - **Price** — leave empty to use the group / inventory price, or set **Price**, **± $** or **± %** for this color only.
  - **Quote price** — what quotes will charge per sq ft (**No price** in red when nothing is set).
  - **Per slab** — charge by full slabs used.
  - **Display** — show this stone in the catalog (the checkbox in the table: *Show this color in the catalog*). This changes the stone's **Display** setting in inventory when you save.
  - **Slab size** — this color's slab size (defaults from inventory or the material).
- Long lists show 50 colors; click **Show all N colors**.

#### Add a material or color that is not in inventory

1. Click **+ Material** → **Add material** → type **Name** (and optional **Slab size**) → **Add**. It exists only in this list. If stones of that material are added to inventory later, the material follows them.
2. In the material, click **+ Color** → **Add (material) color** → **Name**, **Price** ($/sq ft, required), **Slab size** → **Apply**.
3. Click **Save changes**.

Custom colors are not shown in the catalog. Edit them with the pencil; delete with the trash icon. A custom material can be deleted with its trash icon (**Delete material**) — "It is gone once you save."

---

### Other sections

Fabrication, edges, splashes, corners, cutouts and sinks are described in "Admin Quotes: price list fabrication, edges, cutouts and sinks". Extras are described in "Admin Quotes: extras catalog".

---

### Common questions

- **A stone color is missing from Materials.** Only colors in stock in **Inventory > Stones** are listed. Add the stone to inventory, or add it here with **+ Color**.
- **A color shows No price.** It has no inventory retail price, group or own price. Set one and **Save changes**.
- **Salespeople can't pick my new price list.** It must be **Active** and saved. Check the **Status** column.
- **How do I make a list the default?** Click its star (**Make default for new quotes**).
- **I saved by mistake.** Open **Settings** → **History** → **Restore** the previous revision.
- **Can I undo a deleted price list?** No restore button exists; quotes made with it keep their prices.

## Admin Quotes settings (tax rates, payment terms, measurements, email templates)

**Admin > Quotes** is where an admin sets up everything salespeople use when they build quotes: price lists, extras, printed forms, measurement defaults, tax rates, payment terms and quote email templates. Salespeople build the quotes themselves under **Quotes** in the Employee sidebar.

**Where to find it:** Switch to **Admin** (header button) → click **Quotes** in the sidebar (a top-level item, not inside a section). It opens on the **Price Lists** tab.

**Who can see and change it:** Anyone with Admin access (admins, Super Admins in their assigned companies, and platform superusers). The **Manager** position is not needed. Employees without Admin access cannot open these pages or change these settings, but they see the results in every quote they build.

---

### Tabs on Admin > Quotes

| Tab | What it controls |
|-----|------------------|
| **Price Lists** | The price of every material, color, fabrication, edge, cutout, sink and extra; which list new quotes use; default tax rate, payment terms and expiration days per list. |
| **Extras** | The shared catalog of extra items (tear out, sealer, plumbing…) that every price list offers. |
| **Forms** | The printed / emailed quote layouts (**Quote Forms**) and the contracts sent for signature (**Contract Forms**). |
| **Measurements** | Default rounding and default counter depth for new quote drawings. |
| **Tax Rates** | The tax rates salespeople can pick on a quote. |
| **Payment Terms** | The payment terms text salespeople can pick on a quote. |
| **Email Templates** | Company email templates for sending a quote to the customer. |
| **Customer Quote** | The online quote customers fill in themselves: its link (**Copy**) and the extras it offers (**Customer Quote Options**, each switched **Offered** on or off). See the Customer online quote section. |

There is no **Commissions** tab at the moment (commissions are hidden for now).

---

### How each setting shows up on a quote

| Setting | What happens on the quote |
|---------|---------------------------|
| Default price list (star on **Price Lists**) | Preselected in **Price list** when someone clicks **Create Quote**. |
| Active price lists | The only lists offered in **Create Quote**, **Copy Quote Revision** and **Change Price List**. Inactive or deleted lists are not offered. |
| Prices in a price list | Every line price on the quote. A quote keeps the prices it was made with; when prices change later, the quote shows a yellow banner (**Prices changed since this quote was priced…**) with **Update prices**. |
| Price list **Settings** tab | Expiration date (today + **Expiration Days**, 30 when not set), default tax rate, default payment terms, rounding. Used when a quote is created. |
| **Tax Rates** | Choices in the quote's **Pricing Settings** → **Tax**. |
| **Payment Terms** | Prefills the terms of a new quote; choices in the quote's **Edit Payment Terms** → **Default**. |
| **Measurements** | Starting rounding and counter depth of a new quote's drawing. |
| **Extras** marked **Add to every new quote** | Added automatically to every new quote. |
| **Forms** | Choices in the quote's **Print** menu, the **Form** field of the quote email, and the **Contract** button. |
| **Email Templates** | Templates offered (with a **Company** badge) when emailing a quote. |

Changing these settings does not rewrite existing quotes. Tax rate, payment terms and expiration are filled in only when a quote is created; after that they are changed on the quote itself.

---

### Tax Rates

The page shows **Tax Rates** — "Rates salespeople can pick in a quote's pricing settings." Columns: **Name**, **Sequence**, **Tax %**.

**Add a tax rate**

1. Click **Add**.
2. In **Add Tax rate** fill in:
   - **Name** — e.g. the county or city (required).
   - **Sequence** — order in the list; **Lower numbers come first.** New rates start after the last one.
   - **Tax %** — the percent, e.g. 7 or 6.875 (up to 4 decimals). Must be between 0 and 100, otherwise you see **Tax % must be between 0 and 100**.
3. Click **Save**.

**Edit:** click the name or the pencil → change fields → **Save**. **Delete:** trash icon → confirm **Delete**.

**On a quote:** the salesperson opens the price details panel, clicks the pencil next to **Price Settings** (**Edit price settings**) and, in **Pricing Settings**, picks **Tax** = "Name (x%)" or **Custom** to type a **Tax Rate (%)**. When no tax rates exist, only **Tax Rate (%)** is shown.

**Default tax on new quotes:** the price list's **Standalone Default Tax Rate** (price list → **Settings** tab). Without one, a new quote starts with no tax (**Tax: None**).

**Which lines are taxed** is set in the price list (each price's **Tax Code** or **Taxable** setting). Lines with no tax code are not taxed.

**Not the same as the company sales tax.** The sales tax in **Admin > Company settings > Company** (Manager position needed) is used by **Special Order**, Chat's supplier price lookups and the quote's **Price from Supplier** dialog. Quote tax rates are managed here, on **Admin > Quotes > Tax Rates**, by any admin.

---

### Payment Terms

The page is titled **Default Payment Terms** — "The first by sequence prefills new quotes; others can be picked in a quote." Columns: **Name**, **Sequence**, **Terms**.

**Add payment terms**

1. Click **Add**.
2. In **Add Payment terms** fill in **Name** (e.g. "50% deposit"), **Sequence** (lower comes first) and **Terms** (the text printed on the quote, e.g. "Balance due on install").
3. Click **Save**.

Edit with the name or pencil; delete with the trash icon and **Delete**.

**On new quotes:** the price list's **Standalone Default Payment Terms** are used; if the list has none, the company's first payment terms by **Sequence** are used.

**On a quote:** the **Terms** row has a pencil (**Edit payment terms**). The **Edit Payment Terms** dialog has:
- **Default** — pick one of these presets to fill **Terms**, or **Custom**.
- **Terms** — free text (e.g. Net 10, Due on Receipt).
- **Deposits** — **Percentage (%)** or **Amount ($)**, **Add** a deposit with an amount and description. Deposits are set per quote; they are not part of the admin presets.

---

### Measurements

The page shows **Measurement Settings** — "Defaults for every new quote."

| Setting | Meaning |
|---------|---------|
| **Default Units** | Always **Inches** (cannot be changed). |
| **Default Rounding** | How drawing measurements round: **1/2"**, **1/4"**, **1/8"** or **1/16"**. Shown as "Round to nearest …". |
| **Default Counter Depth** | Depth a newly drawn counter starts with, in inches (1 to 120). |

**To change:** click the pencil (**Edit measurement settings**) → change values in **Measurement Settings** → **Save**. A depth outside 1–120 shows **Enter a counter depth from 1 to 120 inches.**

Only new quotes use the new defaults. Each quote's drawing can still change its own rounding (**Round To Nearest …**) and counter depths.

---

### Email Templates

**Email Templates** — "Defaults for emailing quotes. Every sales rep can use them; the first one is picked by default. Drag to reorder." Columns: **Name**, **Subject**.

**Add a template**

1. Click **Add**. **Create Email Template** opens.
2. **Template Name** — starts as "Email Template #N".
3. **Subject** — starts as "Your countertop quote".
4. **Body** — starts as "Here is a quote for your counters:" followed by **[PDFLink]**.
   - **[PDFLink]** becomes a link to the quote (it is added at the end if you leave it out).
   - **[QuoteName]** becomes the quote name.
   - **Insert Variable** (above the body) adds placeholders filled in when the email is sent: customer first / last / full name, email, phone, address, inventory page; employee first / last / full name, email, phone number; company name, address, hours of operation; current day and month; deal name, deal amount; quote name, quote total, quote material and color, quote link, quote expiration date.
5. Click **Save** (toast **Email template added**).

**Edit:** click the name or pencil → **Edit Email Template** → **Save** (**Email template saved**). **Delete:** trash → **Delete** (**Email template deleted**). **Reorder:** drag a row by its handle (**Order saved**).

**On a quote:** when a salesperson emails a quote, these templates appear in the template picker with a **Company** badge. Reps can also make their own templates from the quote email dialog; those personal templates are not listed or managed here.

---

### Price lists, extras and forms (summary)

- **Price Lists** — create lists, mark one as the default for new quotes (star), duplicate, activate/deactivate, delete, and edit prices section by section. Saving creates a new revision; old revisions can be restored.
- **Extras** — one catalog of extras for all lists; each list can switch an extra off or give it its own price.
- **Forms** — design quote and contract layouts; only **Active** forms are offered on quotes.

---

### Common questions

- **I don't see Quotes in the Admin sidebar.** You need Admin access. Ask an admin to give your user Admin access.
- **I changed a price but my quote still shows the old one.** Quotes keep their prices. Open the quote and click **Update prices** in the yellow banner, or pick the list again with **Change Price List** in **Pricing Settings**.
- **I added a tax rate or payment terms but an old quote did not change.** Defaults only fill in new quotes. Change the tax in **Pricing Settings** or the terms with **Edit payment terms** on that quote.
- **A tax rate is missing from the quote's Tax list.** It was deleted or never added. Add it on **Admin > Quotes > Tax Rates**.
- **Where do I set the company sales tax?** **Admin > Company settings > Company** (Admin access plus the **Manager** position). That is separate from quote tax rates.
- **Can a salesperson change these settings?** No. Only users with Admin access can.
- **Where is the Commissions tab?** It is hidden for now.

## Admin Stones (Stone / Material Management)

Use this area to build and maintain your stone catalog: colors (stones), material types, pricing, photos, color tags, price levels, and the individual slabs in your yard.

**Where to find it:** switch to **Admin** in the sidebar header, then **Inventory > Stones** (**Admin > Inventory > Stones**).

**Who can see it:** users with **Admin** access. Employees browse and sell from **Inventory > Stones** in the Employee view but cannot add, edit or delete stones.

---

### Browsing the admin catalog

#### Toolbar

- **Table View** / **Grid View** — switch layouts (*Switch to Table View* / *Switch to Grid View*; remembered for next time).
- **Sell Slab** — opens the sale form (same as the employee one; see Employee Stones).
- **Add Stone** — opens the **Add Stone** form.
- **Stone Search** — search by name (see below).

#### What is listed

- The admin catalog also lists stones whose **Display** is off. They sort last and look faded.
- Order: displayed in-stock stones A–Z, then displayed out-of-stock stones, then hidden stones.
- Sold-out stones (no free slab, not **Regular Stock**) are listed only when **Show sold out** is on in the sidebar filters.
- Stones with no photo at all (for example a color created with **Add New Color** while selling) don't appear in the grid or table — find them with **Stone Search** and add a photo.

#### Grid cards

Each card shows the photo, name, **Available**, **Size** (length x width), **Price** (`$retail/$cost per sqft`), and **Bundle Location** / **Bundle** when set. A red **Out of Stock** banner shows when the stone has no slabs and is not regular stock.

- Click the card to open the stone's slab list.
- Hover the card (always visible on phones) for two icons: pencil = **Edit Stone**, **X** = **Delete Stone**.

#### Table view

Sortable columns: **Image**, **Name**, **Type**, **Size**, **Available**, **Amount**, **Retail Price**, **Cost per Sqft**, **Bundle Location**, **Delivery Date**, plus a **⋮** menu (**Actions**: **Edit**, **Delete**). Click a row to open the slab list. Hidden stones are faded.

#### Sidebar filters

While **Stones** is open: **Stone Types**, **Finishing**, **Stone Colors**, **Stone Levels** (Level 1–7), **Show sold out**, **Suppliers**. **Clear** resets a group. They work the same as in the Employee view.

#### Stone Search (admin)

Type part of a name. Each result shows **Price: $retail / $cost** (or **Price per slab**), the bundle number, and **Out of Stock** when nothing is free. The first 3 show, then **Show more (N more)**.

- Click the result to open its photo viewer.
- **Slabs** — open the slab list.
- Pencil — open **Edit Stone**. Trash — start **Delete stone**.

Admin search includes sold-out stones but not stones with **Display** off.

#### Slab list and selling

Clicking a stone opens **Slabs for [stone name]** — the same list as in the Employee view (white = available, yellow = remnant, red = sold; hover for sale details; click the size to change length x width). In the Admin view every admin sees **Sell** and **Edit** on the rows, whatever their position. Selling, editing and **Unsell** work exactly as described in Employee Stones.

---

### Adding a stone

1. Click **Add Stone**.
2. Fill in the **Add Stone** form (fields below). Only **Name**, **Type** and **Finishing** are required.
3. Click **Add Stone** at the bottom. Toast: **Stone added**.
4. The **Stone Added** dialog asks *[name] has been added to your inventory. Would you like to add slabs for it now?*
   - **Yes, add slabs** — opens **Edit Stone > Slabs** for the new stone.
   - **No, I'm done** — back to the catalog.

The catalog turns **Show sold out** on so you can see the new stone even before it has slabs.

#### Stone fields (Add Stone and Edit Stone > General)

| Field | Required? | Notes |
|-------|-----------|-------|
| **Name** | Yes | Up to 100 characters. |
| **Type** | Yes | One of your company's stone types. Choose **Manage Types** at the bottom of the list to add, rename or delete types. |
| **File** | No | The stone's main photo (see below). If you add a stone with no file, a placeholder picture is used. |
| **Display** | On by default | Off hides the stone from the Employee catalog, the customer showroom and the contractor catalog; it stays (faded) in the Admin catalog. |
| **On Sale** | Off by default | Shows a red **ON SALE** ribbon on the Employee, customer and contractor catalogs. |
| **Regular Stock** | Off by default | For colors you always carry: the stone counts as available (**Regular Stock**) even with no free slabs, and is never hidden as sold out. |
| **Supplier** | No | Pick from your suppliers. Used by the **Suppliers** sidebar filter. |
| **Length** / **Width** | No | Typical slab size. Blank = 0. Used as the default size when adding slabs. |
| **Retail Price** | No | Price per sq ft shown in the catalog. Blank = 0. Saved as whole dollars. |
| **Cost Per Sqft** | No | Your cost, shown next to retail in the Admin catalog and in the Employee table. Blank = 0. Saved as whole dollars. When **Retail Price** is 0, employees see **By slab $[cost] sqft**. |
| **Bundle Number** | No | Shown as **Bundle: #N** on cards, in search, and in the slab list title. |
| **Bundle Location** | No | Where the bundle is stored; shown on cards and in the table. |
| **Delivery Date** | No | Date picker; shown in the **Delivery Date** table column. |
| **Level** | No | **1**–**7** price tier; used by the **Stone Levels** filter and shown in the photo viewer. |
| **Finishing** | Yes | **Polished** (default), **Leathered** or **Honed**. |
| **Color** | No | Pick one or more color tags from the standard color list; used by the **Stone Colors** filter. |

Numbers must be 0 or more (*Enter a number of 0 or more*).

#### Main photo: upload, crop, brightness and color

The **File** box (*Drop an image here, or click to browse* — PNG, JPG, WEBP, or GIF) holds the stone's main catalog photo. Brightness, contrast and color sliders exist **only** here — not in **Resources > Images**.

1. Drop or choose an image. A preview appears under the box (**X** removes the chosen file).
2. To adjust it, hover the preview and click **Edit image** (on **Edit Stone** you can also click the current photo's preview).
3. In the **Edit image** dialog, use the **Adjustments** sliders: **Brightness**, **Contrast**, **Red**, **Green**, **Blue** (**Reset** puts them back).
4. To crop, click **Crop image**, then drag each corner of the frame. **Reset crop** or **Cancel crop** undo it.
5. Click **Use edited image** (or **Cancel**).
6. Click **Add Stone** / **Save Changes** to save the stone with the new photo.

On edit, a new photo replaces the old one; if you don't choose a file, the current photo stays. There is no way to remove the main photo, only replace it.

#### Managing stone types

1. In **Add Stone** or **Edit Stone > General**, open **Type** and choose **Manage Types**.
2. In **Manage Stone Types**:
   - Type a name in *New stone type* and click **Add**.
   - Pencil — rename, then **Save** (or **Cancel**). Renaming also updates every stone that had the old name.
   - Trash — **Delete Stone Type** asks *Delete [type]? This cannot be undone.* Toast: **Stone type deleted**.
3. Click **Close**, then pick the type.

Names are 1–255 characters and unique per company (*This stone type already exists.*). A type used by any stone can't be deleted — the dialog lists the stones to delete or retype first. Your types also feed the **Stone Types** sidebar filter.

---

### Editing a stone

Open **Edit Stone** from the card pencil, the table **⋮ > Edit**, or the search pencil. The dialog has three tabs.

#### General tab

The same fields as **Add Stone**. Click **Save Changes** — toast **Stone Edited**, and you return to the catalog with your filters kept. Color selections replace the old set.

#### Images tab — installed project photos (heading **Stone Images**)

Extra photos (finished kitchens, installs) that appear as **Installed projects** in the photo viewer for staff and customers.

- **Add photos:** drop images in *Drop images here, or click to browse* — they upload right away. Toast: **Image added** / **N images added**.
- **Delete a photo:** click the **X** on it (no confirmation). Toast: **Image Deleted**.
- **Link Images from Different Stone:** in **Link Images from Another Stone**, search (*Search stones...*), pick a stone that has install photos, click **Link Images**. Its photos appear under **Linked Images**, **From: [stone]**. Toast: **Images linked successfully**.
- **Unlink:** click **Unlink** beside a linked group and confirm (**Confirm Unlink**). The source stone keeps its photos. Toast: **Images unlinked successfully**.

#### Slabs tab — slabs in the yard

**Stone Slabs** lists this stone's slabs and remnants that are not cut or deleted (sold ones included).

**Add a slab**
1. **Bundle** — the slab number (required; *Enter the slab number.*).
2. Optional slab photo (otherwise the stone's photo is used as the thumbnail).
3. **Length** / **Width** — prefilled with the stone's size; change if needed.
4. Click **Add Slab** (shows **Uploading...**). Toast: **Slab added**. Add one row per physical slab.

**Rename a slab:** click the pencil (**Edit bundle**), edit the number, press Enter or the check mark (**Save bundle**). Toast: **Slab number updated successfully**.

**Delete a slab:** click **X**, then **Delete** in **Confirm Delete** (*Are you sure you want to delete slab [number]?*). Toast: **Slab Deleted**. The slab leaves inventory (soft delete; history is kept).

**Link Slabs from Different Stone:** use this when two catalog entries share the same physical slabs. In **Link Slabs from Another Stone**, search, pick a stone and click **Link Slabs** (toast **Slabs linked successfully**). The source's slabs show under **Linked Slabs**, **From: [stone]**, and count toward this stone's availability and slab list. **Unlink** (with **Confirm Unlink**) stops sharing without touching the source slabs. You can't link a stone to itself, link the same stone twice, or link back to a stone that already links to this one.

Slab sizes can also be changed from the slab list (click the size).

---

### Deleting a stone

Start from the card **X**, the table **⋮ > Delete**, or the search trash icon.

1. **Delete stone** asks *Are you sure you want to delete [name]?* — **Cancel** or **Confirm**.
2. If the stone still has slabs in the yard, a second step warns: *This stone has N associated slab(s). The stone and its slabs will be hidden from inventory — nothing is permanently deleted.* — **Back** or **Confirm**.
3. Toast: **Stone Deleted**. The stone and its slabs disappear from every catalog and list.

---

### Availability labels

| Label | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `3 / 5` | Free whole slabs / whole slabs in the yard |
| **Regular Stock** | Regular stock is on and no whole slab is free |
| **Remnants Only** | No whole slab free, but remnant pieces are |
| **Out of Stock** | Nothing available and not regular stock |
| Faded card or row | **Display** is off |

**Amount** (table) counts every slab and remnant in the yard, sold or not. Slabs marked cut in the shop no longer count.

---

### Typical workflow

1. **Add Stone** — name, type, photo, prices, level, finishing, colors, supplier.
2. **Yes, add slabs** — one row per physical slab with its bundle number.
3. Add install photos on **Images**.
4. Keep prices and **Display** / **On Sale** / **Regular Stock** current on **General**.
5. Delete the stone when it leaves your catalog for good.

---

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **I can't find Add Stone / Edit / Delete.** Those are only in the Admin view — switch to **Admin** in the sidebar header. You need Admin access.
- **My new stone isn't in the list.** It has no slabs yet: turn on **Show sold out**. Also check sidebar filters (**Clear** them).
- **Employees can't see a stone.** **Display** is off, or it is sold out and they haven't turned on **Show sold out**.
- **A stone doesn't appear in Admin Stone Search.** Search skips stones with **Display** off; find them in the grid or table (faded, at the end).
- **A stone shows in search but not in the grid.** It has no photo (usually created with **Add New Color** while selling). Open **Edit**, add a **File**, **Save Changes**.
- **I can't delete a stone type.** Stones still use it — retype or delete those stones first.
- **How do I adjust brightness or crop a stone photo?** Only via **Edit image** on the stone's **File** (main photo), as above.
- **Why don't I see Sell on the Employee slab list?** In the Employee view, slab-row **Sell** / **Edit** require the **Sales Representative** position; in the Admin view all admins see them.

## Admin Surveys (Customer Feedback)

Use **Survey** to read what customers said about your sales rep, template technician and installation team after a job is installed. Customers fill out a short public survey; admins only read the results here (they cannot create, edit or delete answers).

**Where to find it:** Switch to the **Admin** view (the **Admin** button in the top header; on phones, at the top of the sidebar menu), then click **Survey** (a top-level sidebar item). The page title is **Customer Surveys**.

**Who can see it:** Only users with **Admin** access (and platform superusers). It shows the company you are currently working in.

---

### How customers get the survey (automatic)

The survey is sent automatically after an installer submits the **post-installation checklist** in the installer portal (only users with the **Installer** position can submit checklists; **Operations > Checklists** in the Employee view only shows them — see **Installer portal & post-installation checklists**). Nobody has to press a send button, and nothing goes out right away.

1. **First invitation — about one day after the checklist.**
   - **Email** to the email on the checklist, from noreply@granite-manager.com, subject **[Company name] - Post-Installation Survey**, with a **Rate your experience** button.
   - **Text** to the customer's phone as well, when your company texts through CloudTalk or RingCentral, a user with the **Office Manager** position has their **CloudTalk agent ID** and **CloudTalk phone number** (or their RingCentral line) set on their user, and the customer has a 10-digit phone number. The text comes from that Office Manager's line.
2. **Reminders** — only if the customer has not answered through their link yet:
   - **Day 3** and **day 7**: companies on CloudTalk send a text from the Office Manager's line (an email reminder if a text can't be sent); other companies send an email reminder, subject **[Company name] - Reminder: Post-Installation Survey** (plus a text when RingCentral texting is set up).
   - **Day 5**: an extra email reminder, only for customers who are being reminded by CloudTalk text and have an email on the checklist.
3. **When surveys go out:** only on weekday evenings (5:00–8:30 PM) or weekends (10 AM–5 PM), Eastern time by default. A checklist submitted in the morning is sent the next evening.
4. When the customer submits the survey from their link, the remaining reminders stop.

The link in these messages is personal to the checklist: it also fills in that job's installer for the customer.

#### Sharing the survey by hand

The public survey page is `/customer/{companyId}/survey` (for example `/customer/3/survey` for company 3). You can send that address yourself. A hand-shared link works, but it does not pre-fill the installer and does not stop reminders for a checklist.

---

### What the customer sees and fills out

In short: the page **How did we do at [Company name]?** asks for three star ratings (1–5) — **How did you like your sales rep?** (pick from **Select rep**), **How did you like the template technician?** (stars only, no name) and **How did you like the installation team?** (pick from **Select installer**, pre-filled when they come from a checklist link) — each with an optional comment, plus an optional **Your name** (blank = anonymous). They press **Send feedback** and see **Thank you!**. Every screen, message and error is described in **Customer survey page**.

**Who is in the dropdowns:** every active user with the **Sales Representative** position (rep list) or the **Installer** position (installer list) in your company, sorted by name. Set positions in **Admin > Company settings > Users > Edit**.

---

### Reading results on the Survey page

#### Period

The dropdown at the top right picks the period: **Last 30 days**, **Last 90 days** (default) or **Last 365 days**. Everything on the page follows it.

#### Summary cards

| Card | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| **Surveys sent** | How many first invitations went out in the period, with a small weekly trend line |
| **Filled out** | Percent of sent surveys that were answered, with **X of Y** under it (answers from hand-shared links count too; shown as **–** before anything was sent) |

#### Rep Performance Summary

"Average rating by team member": each sales rep with their average **sales rep** rating (stars and **x.x/5**), a bar, and how many answers it is based on, best first. **Not specified** groups answers whose rep account no longer exists. **No ratings in this period.** when empty.

#### Rating Distribution

Every star rating given in the period (three per survey: rep, technician, installation team), counted as **5 stars** down to **1 star** with the count and percent.

#### Recent Survey Responses

"Latest customer feedback and ratings" — one card per answered survey, newest first:

- The customer's name, or **Anonymous** if they left it blank.
- **Sales rep:** name and **Installer:** name (**Not specified** when missing), and the date.
- **Sales rep**, **Technician** and **Installation team** rows, each with stars, **x/5** and the customer's comment when they left one.

When the period has no answers: **No surveys in this period. Pick a longer range above to see older ones.**

There is no search, export, reply, edit or delete on this page.

#### Names on the cards

Rep and installer names come from the staff user accounts and always show the person's current name. To fix or change a name, edit the person's **Name** in **Admin > Company settings > Users** → **⋯** → **Edit** (Manager position + Admin access); the new name also appears on surveys already received. The technician is not chosen on the survey, so technician ratings have no name.

---

### Typical workflow for managers

1. Make sure installers submit a **checklist** with the customer's email (and that the customer has a phone on file) for every install.
2. Give at least one user the **Office Manager** position with their CloudTalk (or RingCentral) phone line set, so surveys also go out by text.
3. Keep **Sales Representative** and **Installer** positions current so customers can pick the right people.
4. Check **Admin > Survey** weekly: watch **Filled out**, low ratings in **Rating Distribution**, and comments in **Recent Survey Responses**.
5. Follow up with the rep or crew yourself — low ratings do not send any alert.

---

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **Why don't I see Survey?** It is only in the **Admin** view and needs Admin access.
- **A customer never got the survey.** It goes out about a day after the checklist, only in the evening (weekdays) or 10–5 (weekends). Check the checklist had the right email; texts also need an Office Manager with a phone line set and a 10-digit customer phone.
- **No texts are sent, only emails.** No user has the **Office Manager** position with a CloudTalk/RingCentral phone line set, or the company has no SMS provider.
- **A customer can't submit.** They must pick a rep and an installer and rate all three sections. If the **Select installer** or **Select rep** list is empty, nobody in the company has the **Installer** or **Sales Representative** position yet.
- **The customer's name is missing.** The survey is anonymous unless the customer types their name; cards then say **Anonymous**.
- **Filled out is over/under what I expect.** It compares answers in the period (from any link) with invitations sent in the same period, capped at 100%.
- **Can I delete or edit a response?** No — the page is read-only.

**Who can see it:** Only users with **Admin** access (and platform superusers). Employees without Admin access do not have this page. It always shows the company you are currently working in.

**How far back:** The page loads the **last 90 days** of activity. Phone calls also cover the last 90 days.

---

### Sales rep cards (top of the page)

The top of the page is a grid of cards, one for each user with the **Sales Representative** position in your company (sorted by name). Users without that position (for example office staff who only have **Manager**) do not get a card, but their actions still appear in **General activity**.

Each card shows:

- The rep's name.
- Counts for the **last 7 days**: phone icon = calls, speech-bubble icon = texts, envelope icon = emails.
- **Active … ago** — how long since the rep's last recorded action.
- **No activity in 7 days** when nothing was recorded in that week.

The caption under the grid reads **Card counts cover the last 7 days**. Click a card to open that rep's activity dialog (see below).

---

### General activity (company-wide table)

Below the cards, **General activity** lists actions by **everyone** in the company over the last 90 days, newest first.

| Column | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| **Date** | When it happened |
| **Customer** | The customer, or the phone number / email address when no customer matched; **-** when unknown |
| **Type of activity** | The action, with an icon (see the list below) |
| **Details** | One-line summary: email subject, activity name, note text, call result, file name, etc. |
| **User name** | Who did it |

- **Sort:** click **Date**, **Customer**, **Type of activity** or **User name**; click again to reverse. **Details** does not sort.
- **Rows per page:** 10, 20 (default), 50, 100, 200 or 500, with page arrows above and below the table (**Page X of Y**).
- **Grouping:** identical actions at the same moment for the same customer are merged into one row with a count, e.g. **Added image to a deal (3)**.
- **Open a row:** click a row to open a details window with the full text, links and players (rows with nothing more to show do not open).
- **Calls in this table:** CloudTalk calls are added for sales reps who have a **CloudTalk agent ID**.

If nothing was recorded in the last 90 days, the section shows **No activity yet**.

#### Activity types

| Type of activity | What it means |
|------------------|---------------|
| **Made a call** | Outgoing CloudTalk call by the rep |
| **Received a call** | Incoming CloudTalk call the rep answered |
| **Missed a call** | Incoming CloudTalk call with no talk time, or one that went to voicemail |
| **Sent a text** | A text from the CRM SMS inbox (CloudTalk or RingCentral), or a deal activity whose name contains "text". Incoming texts are also listed under this label and carry a **Received** tag in their details |
| **Sent email** | An email sent from the CRM (drafts are not counted) |
| **Add Activity** | A deal activity (task) was created |
| **Complete Activity** | A deal activity was marked complete |
| **Delete Activity** | A deal activity was deleted |
| **Add Note** | A note was added to a deal |
| **Delete Note** | A deal note was deleted |
| **Created deal** | A new deal (details show stage and amount) |
| **Deleted deal** | A deal was deleted |
| **Created customer** | A new customer was added (leads created automatically from marketing are not counted). Details show the address and a **Source:** tag |
| **Created user** | A staff account was created (the new user's name shows in the Customer column) |
| **Added image to a deal** | A picture was uploaded to a deal |
| **Added document** | A document was uploaded to a deal |

---

### Row details: what you can open

Clicking a row (in the general table or in a rep's timeline) shows its details:

- **Contact chip** — the phone number or email it went to.
- **Tags** — e.g. **High priority** (activities), stage and amount (deals), **Received**, **Failed** or **Pending** (texts), **Incoming** / **Outgoing**, the call length or **Missed** / **No answer** / **Voicemail**, **Recorded** and CloudTalk call tags (calls).
- **Due …** — the deadline of a deal activity.
- The note, email or text body (long text is shortened), or a thumbnail of deal images.
- Links that open in a new tab: **Open email thread**, **Open deal**, **Open customer**, **Open file** (documents), and **Texts with this number** (calls).
- **Texts:** the conversation with that number, with **Load earlier messages** and **Open in SMS inbox**. Messages are labelled with the rep's name or **Customer**.
- **Emails:** the email thread, with **Opened …** or **Not opened** on sent messages and **Expand all** / **Collapse** for longer threads.
- **Calls:** **Listen** plays the recording; **Transcribe** creates a transcript (then **Show transcript** / **Hide transcript**). Calls without a recording show **No recording for this call.** Call notes from CloudTalk appear under **Call notes**.

When a grouped row has several items, each item has its own button: **Read conversation**, **Read email** or **Listen & transcribe**.

---

### A rep's activity dialog

Click a rep's card to open the dialog **[Name] activity** (**User activity** until a rep is picked).

- **Arrows** beside the name (**Previous rep** / **Next rep**) step through the other reps without closing the dialog.
- Under the title, a summary line: number of actions, number of customers, time on the phone, and when the rep was last active.

#### Date range

| Control | What it shows |
|---------|---------------|
| **Date button** (shows the range, or **Pick dates**) | Opens a calendar to pick a custom from/to range |
| **1d** | Today only (the default every time the dialog opens) |
| **7d** / **30d** / **90d** | The last 7, 30 or 90 days |
| **All time** | Everything loaded — the last 90 days |

#### Filters

- **Summary chips** — one chip per activity type with its count (calls, texts, emails, activities, notes…). Click a chip to show only that type; click it again to clear.
- **Search box** (placeholder **Customer, email, phone, text…**) — matches customer name, phone/email, summary and body text.
- **Actions per day** chart — bars per day for the chosen range (up to the latest 90 days; shown when the range covers at least two days). Hover a bar for that day's breakdown; click a bar to show only that day (**Click a day to filter**), click again to clear.
- **Only show [customer]** — inside an opened row, narrows the timeline to every call, text, email and note with that customer.
- Active filters appear after **Showing** as chips; click a chip's **x** to remove it, or **Clear all** when there are several.

#### Timeline

Actions are grouped by day (e.g. **Monday, Oct 13, 2026** with the number of actions). Each line shows the time, icon, action, customer and a one-line summary; click a line to expand its details (same as above).

- Keyboard: **↑ / ↓** move between rows, **Enter** opens or closes one (hint at the bottom: **Click a row to open it · ↑ ↓ to move · Enter to open or close**).
- **Show more (N left)** loads the next 100 rows.
- **No activity yet** — nothing in the chosen range. **Nothing matches these filters** — your chip, search, day or customer filter hides everything.

---

### How to see how many calls a sales rep made

There is **no Call history button, tab or page**. Calls appear as rows in the rep's activity dialog (and in General activity).

1. Go to **Admin > Users Activity** (Admin access required).
2. Click the rep's card. The card itself already shows the last 7 days' call count next to the phone icon.
3. In the **[Name] activity** dialog, choose the range (**1d**, **7d**, **30d**, **90d**, **All time**, or the date button).
4. Read the call chips: **Made a call**, **Received a call** and **Missed a call** each show a count. Click one to list only those calls.
5. Click a call row to see the number, length, tags and notes, and to **Listen** or **Transcribe** a recorded call.

Calls load only for sales reps who have a **CloudTalk agent ID** on their user (**Admin > Company settings > Users > Edit**, or the rep's own **My Account**). Incoming calls that rang a group and were never answered by a specific agent do not appear under any rep. RingCentral calls are not listed on this page.

---

### Onboarding & training coverage

Shown only when the **Onboarding** feature is turned on for your company. A table lists each employee with **Name**, **Tasks completed** (done / available), **Points** and **Last active**. **Full onboarding report** opens the **Onboarding analytics** page. **No data yet** appears when nobody has started.

---

### Calls & SMS points

Shown only when the **leaderboard** feature is turned on for your company. It scores every user who can make calls:

- A call attempt (7 seconds of talk or less, or only a mailbox greeting) = **2** points, a voicemail left = **5**, a real conversation (both sides talking) = **10**, each hand-sent text = **1**.
- Daily cap per rep, per customer number: 1 attempt, 1 voicemail and 3 texts score; conversations have no cap. Automated SMS-flow texts do not score.

Columns: **Name**, **Conversations**, **Voicemails**, **Attempts**, **SMS**, **Points**. Use the **From** and **To** dates above the table to change the period (default: the 1st of this month through today). **No data yet** means nothing scored in that period.

---

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **Why don't I see Users Activity?** It is in the **Admin** view only and needs Admin access. Switch from **Employee** to **Admin** in the sidebar header.
- **A rep has no card.** Cards are only for users with the **Sales Representative** position. Add it in **Admin > Company settings > Users > Edit > Positions** (Manager + Admin needed).
- **No calls for a rep.** Their **CloudTalk agent ID** is missing or wrong, or your company does not use CloudTalk. Calls older than 90 days are not loaded.
- **The dialog is empty when it opens.** It starts on **1d** (today). Pick **7d**, **30d** or **All time**.
- **Can I see older than 90 days?** No. **All time** means everything loaded, which is the last 90 days.
- **Why does an incoming text say "Sent a text"?** All SMS messages use that label; incoming ones have a **Received** tag.
- **A name changed.** Staff names come from their user accounts; renaming the user in **Admin > Company settings > Users** updates the name here.
- **Where are Calls & SMS points or Onboarding coverage?** Those sections only appear when the leaderboard or onboarding feature is turned on for your company.

## AI Design (kitchen visualization in Chat)

**AI Design** takes a photo of a customer's kitchen and creates a realistic picture of it with a stone from your inventory installed on the countertops, fireplace and/or a full-height backsplash. You can compare up to 3 stones at once, adjust the result in your own words, and then download it, save it to a deal or email it.

**Where to find it:** sidebar **Chat** (bottom of the sidebar; on phones open ☰ first) → **+** (left of the message box) → **AI Design**. Available in the **Employee** and **Admin** views to any signed-in staff user. It is not offered in the shop portal.

---

### Creating a design

1. Open **Chat** → **+** → **AI Design**. A purple **AI Design** chip appears and Chat says "Add a kitchen photo and pick the stone you would like to see installed."
2. **Kitchen photo** — add one picture:
   - **From device** (Click, paste or drop): click to choose a file, drag a photo onto the box, or paste an image (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V) while AI Design is open.
   - **Emails** (Recent pictures): pick a picture a customer emailed you (see below).
   - To swap it, click **✕** next to the photo and add another.
3. **Install (up to 3 stones to compare)** — type in **Search stone name** (or click the arrow to see the list) and pick a stone. Add up to 3; remove one with **✕** on its chip. The box then says *Add another stone (up to 3)*, and *Maximum stones selected* at 3 (*Stone selected* where only one stone is allowed).
4. **Install on** — tick **Countertops** (ticked by default), **Fireplace** and/or **Full height backsplash**. At least one must stay ticked.
5. **Extra instructions** (optional) — e.g. "change cabinets to white, run veining left to right…".
6. Click **Generate design**. It is enabled once you have a photo, at least one stone and at least one surface.
7. Your request appears in the chat with the photo ("Install … on the countertops in this kitchen."), then **Creating image... It may take up to 1 minute.** Keep the screen open until it finishes.

**Results**
- **One stone:** "Here is your kitchen with *stone* installed." plus the picture.
- **Two or three stones:** one picture per stone ("Option 1: your kitchen with *stone*.", "Option 2: …"). The setup form closes; use **New image** under any option to start another design. If one stone fails, Chat says "Could not generate the option with *stone*: …" and still shows the others.
- Click a picture to see it full screen.

**Which stones can I pick?** Only stones that are shown in your inventory, have a main photo, and are in stock (an available slab of that stone or of a linked stone, or a stone marked **Regular Stock**). The list shows the material type next to each name. Messages: **Loading stones…**, **No stones found**, **Could not load stones**.

**Photo formats:** JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, HEIC/HEIF (iPhone photos are converted automatically), BMP and TIFF. Large photos are reduced automatically before sending; the limit is 4 MB.

---

### Using a picture a customer emailed you

1. In the **Kitchen photo** area click **Emails**.
2. The **Email pictures** dialog opens: "Choose from the latest image attachments in your inbox emails." It shows picture attachments from emails **you** received, newest first, with the customer's name (or the sender's email), the date and the file name.
3. Narrow it with **Search by email, customer, or filename**. Scroll down to load more.
4. Click a picture to use it as the kitchen photo.

Empty messages: "No recently received email pictures were found." or "No email pictures match this search."

---

### Adjusting a design

After a single-stone result, the form at the bottom changes to **Describe what to adjust…** with an **Apply** button.

1. Type the change (e.g. "make the backsplash lighter", "remove the plant on the counter").
2. Click **Apply** (or press Enter). The button shows **Applying…**.
3. Chat posts "Here is the updated design with *stone*." Each adjustment builds on the latest picture.

**Apply** stays disabled until you type something. Comparisons (2–3 stones) cannot be adjusted directly; click **New image** and start from one stone.

---

### What you can do with a result

Under every generated picture:

| Button | What it does |
|--------|--------------|
| **Download** | Saves the picture to your device as a PNG file. |
| **Save to a Deal** | Opens **Save design to a deal**: "Choose the deal where this AI design should be saved." Search with **Search by customer or deal name**, click a deal (customer name and deal title are shown), then **Save to deal**. Chat confirms "The AI design was saved to the selected deal." The picture appears on that deal's **Files** tab under **Images**. Only deals assigned to you are listed (newest first). |
| **Email** | Opens the new-email screen with the picture already attached. Nothing is sent until you send the email. |
| **New image** | Clears the kitchen photo and shows the setup form again (your stones and surfaces stay selected). |

Empty messages in **Save design to a deal**: "No active deals are available." or "No deals match this search."

---

### Closing and starting over

- Click **✕** on the purple **AI Design** chip to leave AI Design (not possible while a picture is being generated). The pictures stay in the chat.
- Choosing **Price lists** from **+** also closes AI Design.
- **Clear chat** in the panel header removes everything, including the designs, and resets the form. Download or save designs you want to keep first.

---

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **I don't see AI Design under +.** You are in the shop portal; switch to the Employee or Admin view.
- **My stone is not in the list.** It must be shown in inventory, have a main photo, and have an available slab (or be marked **Regular Stock**). Stones whose slabs are all sold or cut, hidden stones and stones without a photo are not offered.
- **Generate design is grayed out.** Add a photo, pick at least one stone and keep at least one surface ticked.
- **"The connection was lost while generating the design. Keep this screen open and try again."** The phone locked or the connection dropped. Keep the screen on and generate again.
- **"Sorry, I could not generate the design. Please try again."** The generation failed; try again, possibly with a clearer photo.
- **"Image is too large (max 4MB)." / "Only image files are allowed."** Use a smaller photo or an image file.
- **"The selected stones do not have a reference image."** The stone has no main photo; add one in **Admin > Inventory > Stones**.
- **The Emails button shows no pictures.** Only picture attachments of emails sent to you are listed; if you have no received emails with pictures, the list is empty.
- **Where did my saved design go?** Open the deal → **Files** tab → **Images**.
- **Did Email send the picture to the customer?** No. It only opens a new email with the picture attached; you choose the recipient and send it.

## AI Chat (sidebar Chat)

The **Chat** button opens Granite Manager's AI assistant. It answers questions from your company's instructions and from this user guide, looks up customers and deals, searches supplier price lists (with a special-order price calculator) and creates kitchen pictures with **AI Design**. (**Agent** mode for longer research is switched off for now.)

**Where to find it:** the blue **Chat** button at the bottom of the sidebar (below the phone buttons, if you have them). It is there in the **Employee** view, the **Admin** view and the shop portal for any signed-in user. When the sidebar is collapsed to icons, Chat shows as a speech-bubble icon. It is not shown on the quote drawing screen. There is no separate company setting that turns Chat on or off.

---

### Opening, closing and resizing

1. Click **Chat** in the sidebar. The chat opens as a full-height panel on the right side of the screen.
2. Type in **Type your message...** and press Enter or click **Send**.
3. To close it, click **✕** in the panel header (or click **Chat** again). Closing does not erase the conversation; reopening shows it again.

- **Resize (computer only):** drag the gray bar on the panel's left edge (*Resize chat width*) to make it wider or narrower (about 320 to 960 pixels; default 512). The width is remembered in that browser.
- The panel does not block the page: you can keep working on the page behind it while it is open.
- While an answer is being written, **Send** becomes a red **Stop** button. **Stop** ends the answer and keeps what was written so far.
- Status lines while you wait: **Typing...**, **Searching supplier files…** / **Reading documents…** (price lists), **Reviewing answer...** (after **Not helpful**), **Creating image... It may take up to 1 minute.** (AI Design).

#### On phones
1. Tap the menu button (☰) at the top of the screen.
2. Tap **Chat** at the bottom of the menu. The chat fills the screen.
3. Tap **✕** to close it. Tapping a **Source** link in an answer closes the chat and the menu and opens that page.

The panel cannot be resized on a phone. When **AI Design** is open, its form takes the lower part of the screen and scrolls.

---

### The ways to use Chat

| Way | How to start it | What it answers from |
|-----|-----------------|----------------------|
| **Regular chat** (default, sometimes called Instructions mode) | Just type a question | Your company's instructions (**Resources > Instructions**) and this Granite Manager user guide |
| **Customer & deal look-ups** | Just type a question about a customer, deal or note | Your company's customer and deal records |
| **Price lists** | **+** → **Price lists** | Supplier price files uploaded to **Suppliers** |
| **AI Design** | **+** → **AI Design** | Generates your kitchen photo with an in-stock stone installed |

The **+** button (**Open chat tools**) is to the left of the message box. It also has **Add picture** and **Share this page** (see below). In the shop portal the **+** menu has only **Add picture** and **Share this page** (no **Price lists** or **AI Design**). There is no separate "User Manual" item: how-to questions about the app are answered automatically in regular chat.

---

### Regular chat: company instructions and "how do I…" questions

Type any question. Chat decides where the answer comes from:

- **Company questions** (prices, fees, procedures, policies, videos, scripts): answered only from your company's instructions. You only get instructions you are allowed to read: an instruction limited with **Visible to** to certain positions is used only for users with one of those positions (same rule as **Resources > Instructions**). If no instruction covers it, Chat says it does not have an instruction for it.
- **How to use Granite Manager** (for example "how do I add a deal", "where is the logo setting"): answered from this user guide, limited to pages your account can open. If you ask about a page you cannot access, Chat tells you which access is needed instead of giving steps.

Under an instruction-based answer:
- **Source** / **Sources** — the instruction titles used. Click one to open **Instructions** at that item.
- **Pictures** from the instruction may appear under the answer. Click a picture to view it full screen and swipe/arrow through the others.
- Links (http/https) in answers are clickable and open in a new tab.

Follow-up questions keep the context of the conversation (for example "and for quartz?").

**When Chat asks back instead of guessing:**
- A question that fits two features with different steps ("how do I add a template": an email, text or quote email template), or a word with several meanings like "notifications": it asks which one, with a button for each.
- A question that could be about the app or about your company's own process, when your company has an instruction about it: *Do you mean how to do this in Granite Manager, or your company's own process?* (**In Granite Manager** / **Our company's process**).
- A question about the app it finds no answer for: after saying so it adds *Do you mean one of these?* with buttons for the two or three closest topics. Click one to get that answer, or type the question another way.

---

### Adding a picture or sharing the page you are on

**Add a picture** (for example a screenshot of an error or a photo of a slab):
1. Click **+** → **Add picture** and pick up to 3 pictures (JPG, PNG, WebP or iPhone HEIC).
2. They show as small previews above the message box. Click **✕** on a preview to remove it.
3. Type your question (or leave it empty: Chat then says what the picture shows) and click **Send**.

The pictures go with that one message only and show in your message bubble. They are not saved: after **Clear chat** or a reload, Chat no longer sees them.

**Share this page** lets Chat read the page you are on (its address, the text it shows, an open dialog, and what is typed in its fields; not the chat or the sidebar):
1. Click **+** → **Share this page**. A check mark shows it is on and a blue **Sharing this page** chip appears above the message box.
2. Ask about what you see, for example "why can't I save this?" or "what does this status mean?". Each question you send while it is on includes the page as it is at that moment.
3. To stop, click **✕** on the chip (*Stop sharing this page*) or click **+** → **Share this page** again. Reloading the browser page also turns it off.

Chat reads the page's text, not a picture of it: for drawings, images or colors, use **Add picture** with a screenshot instead.

---

### Customer and deal look-ups (data questions)

Questions about your company's records are answered automatically from the CRM data, for example:
- "Find customer Dena", "What is John Smith's phone number?", "Look up 555-123-4567" or an email address.
- "What deals does Dena have and what is next?"
- "Which customers have a note about price drop?"
- "Email Clark Kent a short follow-up."

What it can do:
- **Look up a customer** by name, phone or email: name, company, phones, emails, address, postal code and a short deal summary. If several customers match, it lists them and asks which one you mean.
- **List a customer's deals:** stage, amount, title, won / lost / open, and up to 5 activities and 5 notes per deal (not the full history).
- **Search deal notes** across customers. By default it searches notes on deals assigned to **you**; ask about "notes I wrote", "the team" or "all notes" to widen it.
- **Draft an email:** shows the subject and body and a link **Open email draft for …** that opens the draft in your email program. **Nothing is sent** by Chat.

It searches all customers of your company (not only yours). Answers are plain text. Questions that start with "how" or mention instructions, procedures, prices or the manual are treated as regular questions instead. It can't count or report across many records (for example "how many deals did we win this month"): use **Admin > CRM > Statistic**, the Dashboard widgets or the lists' filters for that.

---

### Agent mode (switched off for now)

**Agent** is not in the **+** menu at the moment: Granite Manager has switched it off until it is ready again. When it is back, it works like this:

1. Click **+** → **Agent**. A check mark shows it is on, the **+** button turns blue with a robot icon, and the box reads **Ask the agent (takes a few minutes)...**
2. Type your question and **Send**.
3. Wait: **Waiting for the agent to pick this up... (time)**, then **Agent is working on it. This can take a few minutes. (time)**.
4. The answer appears in the chat when it is done.

- Agent mode stays on (also after **Clear chat**) until you click **+** → **Agent** again or reload the page.
- You can reload the page or move to other pages: the wait continues and the answer still appears.
- **Stop** stops waiting: "Stopped waiting for the agent. It may still finish in the background, but the answer will not be shown here."
- After about 40 minutes Chat gives up: "Sorry, the agent is taking too long to answer."
- Agent mode is for **employee and admin accounts**. Admin accounts may get answers that include other users' data.

---

### Price lists mode

Finds a slab price in your suppliers' uploaded price files.

1. Click **+** → **Price lists**. A blue **Price lists** chip appears and Chat asks "Which color would you like me to find?"
2. Enter **Color** (e.g. Calacatta Gold) and pick **Supplier** (type to search).
3. Under Supplier, a status shows whether that supplier's files are ready: **N price files ready** (**1 price file ready**), **No price files uploaded yet**, **N of M ready · K processing**, or **… failed — retry in the Files tab**.
4. Click **Find price**. Chat shows the price, slab size and a **Source** link to the price file (opens in a new tab).
5. Keep typing follow-up questions; they stay in Price lists mode until you click **✕** on the **Price lists** chip.

Choices Chat may offer as buttons:
- **Thickness** buttons (e.g. 2 CM $36.78) when the product has several thicknesses.
- **Slab size** buttons when there are several sizes.
- **Pick a product for special order:** when several products or color variants match.

Chat only states a price that appears in the files. If the name is close but not exact, it says so and gives the closest product. Price files are uploaded by an admin on the supplier's **Files** tab (**Admin > Resources > Suppliers**, edit a supplier). If files are still processing or failed, Chat says so instead of answering.

#### Special order calculator
When Chat gives one exact price it asks "Would you like to adjust this price for a special order?"
1. Click **Yes** (or **Find a different stone** to search another color).
2. Fill in **Delivery** — **Fixed price** (amount, 0 allowed) or **Percentage** (%) — and **Amount of slabs**. If the slab size is unknown, also **Slab size** (**Length (in)**, **Width (in)**).
3. Click **Calculate price**. The result shows **Price per sqft (with tax & delivery)**, **Total square feet**, **Material cost (incl. N% tax)**, **Delivery** and **Total cost**.
4. Click **Recalculate** to change the numbers, or **Find a different stone**.

The tax rate is the company sales tax set in **Admin > Company settings > Company** (only users with Admin access and the **Manager** position can change it). While Chat waits for **Yes** / **Find a different stone**, the message box is locked.

---

### AI Design (kitchen pictures)

**+** → **AI Design**: add a kitchen photo (from your device or from pictures customers emailed you), choose up to 3 in-stock stones and the surfaces (**Countertops**, **Fireplace**, **Full height backsplash**), then **Generate design**. Results can be downloaded, saved to a deal or emailed. Full steps are in the **AI Design** section of this guide.

---

### Conversation, Clear chat and history

- Chat remembers the current conversation for follow-up questions while you move between pages.
- **Clear chat** (panel header) erases the conversation, closes Price lists / AI Design, and starts fresh. The next question starts a new conversation.
- Reloading the browser page also empties the panel; the next question starts a new conversation.
- There is no list of past chats to reopen.

---

An answer from your company's records can have **Show the query behind this answer** (or *Show the N queries behind this answer*): it unfolds what Chat looked up (each lookup and how many rows it found). A long answer that stopped early says *The answer was cut off.*

### "Not helpful" feedback and corrections

Answers to "how do I use the app" questions show **Not helpful** (thumbs-down) under them.

1. Click **Not helpful**. Chat shows **Reviewing answer...** and posts a corrected answer.
2. Under the correction click **Helpful** (thumbs-up) or **Still not helpful**.
   - **Helpful**: "Thanks — your review was saved for our team."
   - **Still not helpful** on the first correction: Chat tries a second correction.
   - **Still not helpful** on the second correction: the conversation is sent to the Granite Manager team ("I'm sorry — your review was added to our team and we will check it.").
3. If no better answer can be made: "I could not generate a better answer right now. Your feedback was saved for our team."

**Not helpful** does not appear on company-instruction answers, price-list answers or AI Design results.

#### Reviewing corrections (platform superusers only)
**Admin > Superuser Dashboard > Instruction corrections** lists saved reviews as cards: **User approved correction** or **Escalated review**, with company, user, date, the question, **Original answer**, each **Correction N (liked/disliked)** and a **Manual update** (section and proposed change).
- **Approve manual update** — replaces that section of the guide Chat uses, then marks it reviewed (only when a proposed change exists).
- **Mark reviewed** — closes it without changing the guide.
- Empty list: "No pending instruction corrections."

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **I don't see Chat.** It is at the bottom of the sidebar; on phones open ☰ first. It is not on public pages, and you must be signed in.
- **I don't see Price lists or AI Design under +.** They are not in the shop portal. Use the Employee or Admin view.
- **"… could not be added. Use a JPG, PNG or WebP picture."** That file is not a picture Chat can read. Take a screenshot or save it as JPG/PNG and add it again.
- **"You can add up to 3 pictures to one message."** Send the first 3, then add the rest to the next message.
- **Where is "User Manual" mode?** It no longer exists as a menu item; ask how-to questions in regular chat.
- **Chat says it has no instruction for my question.** No instruction visible to your positions covers it. Ask an admin to add one or change **Visible to** in **Admin > Resources > Instructions**.
- **Price lists says files are processing/failed or none uploaded.** Wait a few minutes, or ask an admin to upload or retry the file on the supplier's **Files** tab.
- **I can't type in the box.** A special-order question is waiting: click **Yes** or **Find a different stone**, or close the **Price lists** chip.
- **Did Chat send my email?** No. Look-ups only prepare a draft link; you send it from your email program.
- **Can I see old chats?** No. Clearing or reloading starts over.
- **"Chat is temporarily unavailable because the AI model is not enabled for this workspace."** The AI service is unavailable for your company; try later or contact support.
- **Sample messages appeared (e.g. Calacatta Gold from Cosentino) that I didn't ask for.** They come from a guided tour and are examples, not real prices.
- **How wide can the panel be?** Drag the left edge on a computer; phones always use full screen.

## Authentication (sign in, sign out, passwords, Telegram link and file links)

How staff sign in and out of Granite Manager, reset a forgotten password, where each kind of user lands after sign-in, and what the small standalone pages do (Connect Telegram, Link Expired, Privacy Policy, End-User License Agreement).

---

### Signing in (`/login`)

1. Open your company's Granite Manager address (for example `https://yourcompany.granite-manager.com`) or the main `granite-manager.com` site. If you are not signed in, the sign-in page opens.
2. The box is titled **Sign in to Granite Manager**. Enter your **Email** and **Password**.
3. Click **Login**.

**On the page:**

- **Forgot password?** — under the password field; see below.
- **Privacy Policy** · **End-User License Agreement** — links at the bottom.
- On your company's own web address, the company logo shows at the top (click it to open the customer showroom), with a **For Customers** link to the showroom. On the main site, the Granite Manager header shows instead.
- If you are already signed in, opening the sign-in page takes you straight to your home page.

**Messages:**

| Message | Meaning |
|---------|---------|
| **Please check your email and password.** | A field is empty or not valid |
| **Incorrect email or password. Please try again.** | Wrong email or password; the password field is cleared |
| **Too many login attempts. Please try again later.** | Too many failed tries within 15 minutes (10 for the same email from the same network, or 50 for the same email from anywhere). Wait and try again, or reset your password |
| **Reconnecting…** | **Granite Manager is updating. You are still signed in and will be taken back in a moment.** Wait; no action needed |

A sign-in lasts 60 days on that browser unless you log out or reset your password.

#### Where you land after signing in

| User | Home page |
|------|-----------|
| Platform superuser or **Super Admin** | Employee **Dashboard** |
| **Installer** | **Installer Checklist** form |
| **Walk-in** | Walk-in check-in form |
| **Marketing** | **Marketing** leads page |
| **Shop Worker** | Shop **Transactions** |
| **Template Guy** | Template **Schedule** page |
| Everyone else (Employee and Admin users) | Employee **Dashboard** |

- If a user has more than one of these positions, the first match in the order above wins.
- Installer, Walk-in, Marketing, Shop Worker and Template Guy users stay inside their own page. Opening any other address sends them back to their home page. Logout and password reset always work.
- If your company has its own web address, you are moved to it after signing in.
- If your company's account is restricted for billing, every signed-in user is sent to the **Billing** page until payment is fixed.

---

### Logging out (`/logout`)

- **Employee and Admin users:** open **My Account** in the Employee sidebar and click the red **Logout** button in the **Other** section.
- **Shop users:** **My Account** → **Logout**.
- **Marketing, Walk-in, Installer and Template pages:** **Logout** at the top right of the header.

Logging out ends your session on that browser and opens the sign-in page.

### Forgot password (`/forgot-password`)

1. On the sign-in page, click **Forgot password?**
2. Under **Forgot your password?**, enter your **Email**.
3. Click **Send Reset Link**.
4. A toast shows **Check your email** — **If an account with that email exists, you will receive a password reset link shortly.** You go back to the sign-in page. **Back to Login** also returns there without sending anything.

**The email:**

- From **Granite Manager** (`noreply@granite-manager.com`), subject **Reset your password**, with a **Reset Password** button.
- The link works for **60 minutes** and only once. It opens on your company's web address when it has one.
- Asking again sends a new link and cancels the older one. Requests made within a minute of the last one send nothing, so wait a minute before asking again.
- If the email does not belong to any account, nothing is sent (the page still shows the same message).

**Errors:** **Please enter a valid email address.** / **Failed to send email. Please try again later.**

---

### Setting a new password (`/reset-password/<link>`)

1. Click **Reset Password** in the email.
2. Under **Set a new password** (*Enter your new password below.*), enter **New password** and **Confirm new password** (a problem says *Please check the password fields.*).
3. Click **Reset Password**.
4. A toast shows **Password Reset** — **Your password has been successfully reset. Please log in with your new password.** Sign in with the new password.

- The password must be at least 8 characters (**Password must be at least 8 characters.**), and both fields must match (**Passwords do not match.**).
- Resetting signs you out on all your other devices.
- An old, used or expired link shows **Link Expired** — **This password reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.** — and returns to the sign-in page. Use **Forgot password?** again.
