### Setting up your account from an invite (`/invite/<link>`)

When a Manager adds you on **Admin > Company settings > Users**, you get an email from **Granite Manager** (`noreply@granite-manager.com`), subject **You're invited to <company> on Granite Manager**, with a **Set up your account** button. The Manager can also send you the same link themselves.

1. Click **Set up your account** (or open the link you were sent).
2. Under **Set up your account** (*<company> added you to Granite Manager.*, or *You were added to Granite Manager.*), your **Email** is shown. Enter your **Name** (`Your name*`), **Phone number**, **Password** and the password again (**Confirm password**, `Confirm password*`). A problem in any field says *Please check the fields above.*
3. Click **Create account**. You are signed in and land on your start page.

- **Name** is required (**Name is required**), the phone needs at least 10 digits (**Phone must include at least 10 digits**), the password at least 8 characters (**Password must be at least 8 characters.**), and both password fields must match (**Passwords do not match.**).
- The link works for **7 days** and only once. It opens on your company's web address when it has one.
- An old, used or expired link shows **Invite Expired** — **This invite link is invalid or has expired. Ask your manager to send a new one.** — and opens the sign-in page. Your Manager sends a new one with **Resend invite** (in **Edit** on the Users page).
- Clicking **Create account** twice sends it once. If you click it again after an answer that never arrived and your account was already set up, you see **Account already set up** — **Sign in with your email and the password you just chose.** — and the sign-in page opens.
- Until you set up your account, you can't sign in.

**Other way to change your password:** while signed in, open **My Account** in the sidebar, type a new **Password** (at least 8 characters; placeholder **Leave empty to keep current password**) and click **Save Changes**. Admin user editing has no password field, so a Manager cannot set someone else's password; that person uses **Forgot password?**.

## Billing (Granite Manager Subscription)

The **Billing** page is where your company pays for Granite Manager. It shows the plan, the card on file, and invoices. You can change the plan, update the card, pay an open invoice, and restore access after a missed payment. Payments go through Stripe. This page is about your Granite Manager subscription, not customer invoices for countertop jobs.

**Where to find it:** sidebar **Company settings > Billing**. It shows in both the Employee and the Admin sidebar.

**Who can see it:** only users with the **Manager** position in the company. Admin access is not required: a Manager sees **Company settings > Billing** in the Employee sidebar too. Without the Manager position, **Billing** isn't in the sidebar, and opening the page sends you back to the Employee dashboard. A **Super Admin** also needs the Manager position, which only applies in their home company.

---

### What the Billing page shows

Summary tiles:

| Tile | What it means |
|------|---------------|
| **Current plan** | The plan your company is subscribed to |
| **Monthly price** | Price per month |
| **Next billing date** | When the next charge happens |
| **Subscription status** | **Active**, **Past due**, **Suspended**, **Trialing**, or **Not subscribed** |
| **Payment method** | The card on file (brand and last 4 digits), or **No card on file** |
| **Last payment** | Date of the last successful payment |
| **Outstanding balance** | Total of unpaid (open) invoices |

The price is a flat amount per company, not per user.

Buttons:

- **Update Payment Method**: opens Stripe's secure card form to replace the card. You come back to Billing afterwards.
- **Pay Outstanding Invoice**: shown only when there is an unpaid invoice. Opens the invoice payment page in a new tab.
- **Manage Subscription**: opens Stripe's billing portal for the subscription.
- **Contact support**: emails support@granite-manager.com.

---

### Plans

The **Plan** dropdown lists the available plans by name, with the monthly price when one is set (*Plan name ($… / month)*). The current plan is selected by default.

**Subscribing for the first time (no subscription yet):**

1. Choose a **Plan**.
2. Click **Subscribe**. You go to Stripe Checkout to enter card details and pay.
3. After paying you return to **Billing**. The new plan shows there once Stripe confirms the payment.

**Changing plans (already subscribed):**

1. Choose another **Plan**.
2. Click **Update plan**. The change applies right away, and Stripe prorates the difference on your next bill.

Possible messages: *Unknown billing plan*, *This company already has a subscription. Update the plan instead.*, *No active subscription to update*, *Billing is not configured*.

---

### Invoice history

The **Invoice history** table lists your Granite Manager invoices:

- **Invoice**: Stripe invoice number
- **Status**: **paid** or **open**
- **Amount**: amount paid, or amount due for open invoices
- **Paid**: payment date
- **Download**: **Download Invoice** opens the PDF

*No invoices yet.* shows before the first invoice.

---

### Missed payments, warnings and paused access

Payment enforcement only applies when billing is required for your company (set by the Granite Manager team).

1. **A payment fails.** The subscription becomes **Past due** and a **10-day grace period** starts. Everyone keeps working.
   - Each Manager gets a **Payment required** notification in the notification bell: *Your Granite Manager subscription payment was unsuccessful. Please update your payment method or complete the payment. Your account will remain active until [date].* It has an **Update Payment Method** link to Billing.
   - Managers also see a yellow banner at the top of the app, *Payment past due — N days remaining*, with **Update Payment Method**. Other users don't see the banner.
2. **Fix it during the grace period.** Click **Update Payment Method** (new card) or **Pay Outstanding Invoice**. When Stripe confirms the payment, the status returns to **Active** and the warnings clear.
3. **The grace period ends unpaid.** The company is **Suspended**: access to Granite Manager is paused for everyone. Every page sends users to **Billing**. Only Billing, login and logout still work.
   - Users who aren't Managers see **Subscription payment required**: *Access to Granite Manager is paused for your company. Please ask your manager to update the billing.*
   - Managers see *Your subscription is past due. Please update your payment method to restore access.* and a **Restore Access** button. It opens Stripe's card form, and access comes back once the payment goes through.

---

### Common questions

- **I don't see Billing in the sidebar.** You need the **Manager** position. An admin with the Manager position can add it to your account in **Admin > Company settings > Users**.
- **Everything redirects to Billing / "Subscription payment required."** The company's access is paused for non-payment. A Manager must sign in and pay or update the card.
- **How do I download an invoice?** **Company settings > Billing** > **Invoice history** > **Download Invoice**.
- **How do I change the card?** **Update Payment Method** (or **Restore Access** while suspended).
- **Where do I see more subscription details?** **Manage Subscription** opens Stripe's billing portal. For cancellations or anything else, use **Contact support**.
- **"Billing is not configured. Add the Stripe secret key before taking payment."** Online billing isn't set up yet, so checkout and card changes won't work. Contact support.
- **Is this where customers pay us?** No. Billing is only for your Granite Manager subscription.

## Installer portal & post-installation checklists

Installers use a phone-friendly portal to see their jobs, get directions and have the customer sign the **post-installation checklist**. Office staff read the signed checklists on **Operations → Checklists**, and the customer then receives the post-installation survey.

---

### Who sees what

| User | Where |
|------|-------|
| User with the **Installer** position | Signing in opens the installer portal (`/installers/{companyId}/checklist`). It is the only page they can open: no sidebar, the company header with **Logout**, and tabs at the bottom of the screen. |
| Employees (sales reps, office, managers) | Employee sidebar → **Operations** → **Checklists** to read submitted checklists. |
| Admins | There is no Checklists item in the Admin sidebar; switch to **Employee** and use **Operations → Checklists**. |

Platform superusers can preview the installer portal by choosing **Installer** in the header's position selector. To make someone an installer, give their user the **Installer** position in **Admin → Company settings → Users**; they also appear in the schedule's **Installer** picker and in the survey's **Pick your installer** list.

---

### The installer portal tabs

The bottom bar has **Schedule**, **Map** and **Checklist**. The portal opens on **Schedule**; the chosen tab is kept in the link, so the phone's back button returns to it.

#### Schedule tab

Shows only the jobs assigned to this installer (events where the office chose them in the **Installer** field), on any calendar.

- The date heading opens a month and year picker. **<** / **>** change the day (or month), **Today** jumps back, and swiping left or right on a phone changes the day.
- **Day** / **Month** toggle: **Month** adds a calendar with up to three dots per day; tap a date to see its jobs.
- Each job card shows its stop number, the time (**All day** or a range), the customer's name, the address, and the description and note.
- **Directions** opens Google Maps driving directions from the phone's location to the job.
- **Checklist** opens the checklist for that job with the customer filled in (see below).
- **On my way** (today's jobs) marks the job and sends the customer the company's On my way message: a text, or an email when the company has no texting (an admin writes it in **Admin → Schedule → Customer notifications → On my way**). A toast says whether the customer got it, or why not (for example *No On my way message is set up…* or *The customer has no phone number*). The customer is told only once; the button goes away after that. **Completed** marks the job done; nothing else completes a job. The card then shows the status and its time, e.g. *On my way · 9:42 AM* or *Completed · 1:30 PM*. Repeating events have neither button.
- Tap the card for **Event details** (a big window with the details, project, the customer's quote drawings, attachments, and comments beside them): customer phone and email, attachments, the QuickBooks invoice (**View PDF**) when the office linked one (installers see no other invoices), and the comments. Installers can add a **Comment** and photos or files with the paperclip. They cannot edit, move or delete jobs.
- *Nothing scheduled for this day.* means nothing is assigned to them that day.

Admins and superusers who reach this page see a **Whose schedule** list to pick an installer.

#### Map tab

Shows the day's route on a map: the warehouse (company address) and the day's stops numbered in order, joined by the driving route. The map can be dragged and zoomed when interactive maps are available; otherwise a picture is shown. **Google Maps** under the map opens the whole route. The day's job cards follow below the map.

- *No addresses to show for this day.* — the day's jobs have no addresses.
- *The map could not be drawn. Open the route in Google Maps below.* — use the link instead.

---

### Filling in the post-installation checklist

The **Checklist** tab shows the company logo and **Post-installation check list**.

1. Start it one of two ways:
   - From a job card, tap **Checklist**. The customer (when the job is linked to a customer), name, address and email are filled in. After it is sent, the portal returns to the tab you came from.
   - Or open the **Checklist** tab and fill it in by hand.
2. **Customer** (required) — start typing (*Start typing customer…*) and pick from the suggestions; that fills **Email** and **Project Address** from the customer record. You can also just type a name that isn't in the list. The small **×** clears the chosen customer.
3. **Email** (optional, *example@gmail.com*) — where the customer's survey link is sent. It must be a valid address.
4. **Project Address** (required) — the installation address (type at least 3 characters to search).
5. **Check all that apply:** **Material is correct**, **Seams meet my satisfaction**, **Appliances fit properly**, **Backsplashes placed correctly**, **Edges and corners are correct**, **Holes for fixtures are drilled**, **Clean up completed**.
6. **Comments** — anything the customer or installer wants noted.
7. **Signature** (required) — the customer signs with a finger or mouse; **Clear** erases it. The text under it reads *By signing below I affirm that this installation is completed to my satisfaction, and I accept the countertops installed by Granite Depot.*
8. Tap **Submit**. The toast *Checklist saved to database* confirms it and the form is cleared.

Errors: *Required* (customer or address missing), *Signature is required*, *Invalid email*.

**Unsent form is kept:** while typing, the form is saved on the phone, so closing the page or losing the screen does not lose it. It is cleared after a successful submit.

There is no edit or delete for a submitted checklist; if something was wrong, submit a new one.

---

### No internet: the offline queue

Installers can submit checklists without signal.

- With no connection, an orange banner reads *⚠️ No internet connection — Form will be saved and sent automatically when connection is restored.*
- Submitting offline (or when the server can't be reached) shows **Offline Mode** — *No internet. Form saved and will be sent automatically when online.* The form clears and the checklist waits on that phone.
- A blue banner shows *📤 Checklist is waiting to be sent* (or *N checklists are waiting to be sent*) with *Attempts: n/20* and a **Try Now** button; *🔄 Sending checklist...* while it sends (*Please wait, sending in progress...*; otherwise *It will be sent automatically when connection is available.*).
- It is sent automatically when the phone comes back online, when the portal is opened again, and every 2 minutes while the page is open (every 10 minutes in the background). On success: *Pending checklist has been sent successfully!*
- After 20 failed attempts a red banner reads *Failed to send checklist after 20 attempts*, with **Try Again** and **Delete Pending Form** (asks *Are you sure you want to delete the pending form? This cannot be undone.*).

Waiting checklists are stored only in that phone's browser. Don't clear the browser's data or switch phones until they are sent; open the portal again once online.

---

### What happens after a checklist is submitted

- It appears at once on **Operations → Checklists** for the office, with the installer's name.
- **Customer survey:** about a day later the customer is sent the post-installation survey link by email (to the checklist's **Email**, subject *[Company] - Post-Installation Survey*) and by text when the customer was picked from the list, has a phone number, and the company texts from an **Office Manager** line. Reminders follow on day 3 and day 7 (text or email; plus an email on day 5 for customers reminded by text) until the customer completes the survey. Survey messages only go out on weekday evenings (5:00–8:30 PM) or weekends (10 AM–5 PM).
- The customer's answers, including the installer they rate, appear in **Admin → Survey**.

---

### Reading checklists (Operations → Checklists)

**Post-installation Checklists** lists every checklist of the company, newest first. Each card shows:

- the customer's name, the date and **Installer:** name,
- **Address**,
- ✓ (green) or ✗ (red) for **Material correct**, **Seams satisfaction**, **Appliances fit** and **Cleanup completed**,
- **Comments**, when given,
- **View PDF** — the full signed checklist with the company logo, all seven checks, comments and the customer's signature, ready to print or save.

There is no search, edit or delete on this page. *No checklists found.* means none have been submitted yet. An orange *(Pending)* card can appear when a checklist saved offline in this same browser is still waiting to be sent.

---

### Common questions

- **The installer can't see the CRM.** By design: the Installer position locks the account into the installer portal.
- **A job is missing from the installer's schedule.** On the company **Schedule**, open the event and check that **Installer** is set to them and the date is right.
- **The Checklist button didn't fill in the customer.** The job's **Customer** was typed rather than picked from the search; pick the customer when filling in the checklist.
- **A checklist isn't on the Checklists page.** It is probably still waiting on the installer's phone; have them open the portal with internet and tap **Try Now**.
- **The customer didn't get the survey.** It goes out about a day later in the evening (or weekend daytime) window. Without an **Email** on the checklist and without a linked customer with a phone, there is nobody to send it to.
- **The installer can't see the invoice.** Open the event on the **Schedule**, edit it and pick the invoice; it then shows in the installer's **Event details**.
- **Change an installer's name on checklists.** Rename their user in **Admin → Company settings → Users**. The **Installer:** line on the Checklists cards always shows the user's current name, so older checklists show the new name too.

## Commissions (signed quotes, payroll and commission rules)

Granite Manager can work out what each sales rep earns on quotes their customers signed, check in QuickBooks whether the customer paid, and add paid commissions, monthly goal bonuses and a base pay into paychecks per payroll date.

**Commissions are hidden for now.** There is no **Commissions** tab on **Admin > Quotes** and no **My Commissions** button on **Quotes**. The two pages below still open if someone goes to their web address. If you were told to find commissions in the menus, they are not there at the moment.

---

### Who sees what

| Page | Who | Shows |
|------|-----|-------|
| Admin commissions page `/admin/quotes/commissions` (inside Admin > Quotes) | Users with Admin access | Every rep's signed quotes and paychecks, the QuickBooks sync, pay-out marking, pay settings and commission rules |
| My commissions page `/employee/commissions` | Any employee | Only your own signed quotes and paychecks (read only) |

Only admins can sync, mark commissions paid out, change pay settings or edit rules.

---

### Which quotes earn a commission

- A quote counts once the **customer signed it** (accepted an option and signed on the quote link they received).
- The commission is for the option the customer accepted, at that option's total.
- The rep is the quote's **Salesperson** (or whoever created the quote if no salesperson is set).
- Nothing appears until an admin clicks **Sync with QuickBooks**; the list does not update by itself.

---

### Admin commissions page

#### Salary table

One row per signed quote, newest first:

| Column | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| **Signed** | Date the customer signed. |
| **Customer** | Customer name (click to open the quote); the quote name below when different. |
| **Rep** | The rep who earns it. |
| **Contract** | Total of the accepted option. |
| **Customer paid** | **Paid**, **Partly paid**, **Not paid** or **No invoice**, with the paid date when paid. |
| (amount) | The commission. Hover it to see each rule's share. |
| **Payroll** | The payroll date it is paid on, or **Paid out (date)**. |

Empty table: **No signed quotes with commissions yet.**

#### Sync with QuickBooks

1. Click **Sync with QuickBooks**.
2. Every signed quote's commission is worked out with the current rules, and the customer's QuickBooks invoices are checked:
   - The invoice whose total matches the quote (within $1) is used; otherwise the first invoice dated on or after signing.
   - Balance 0 = **Paid**; some paid = **Partly paid**; nothing paid = **Not paid**; no invoice found = **No invoice**.
3. A toast says the result: **Synced N quotes with QuickBooks**, or "Calculated N quotes. QuickBooks is not connected, so payments are unknown.", or "Calculated N quotes. Some QuickBooks lookups failed."

Quotes already **Paid** and signed more than 60 days ago are left as they are. Once a quote is paid, its paid date and payroll date stay fixed.

**Payroll date:** the first payroll day (see **Pay settings**) on or after the date the customer paid.

#### Mark commissions as paid out

1. In the salary table, tick the checkbox on rows that are **Paid** and not yet paid out.
2. Click **Mark selected as paid out**. Toast **Marked as paid out**. The **Payroll** column then shows **Paid out (date)**.

Only commissions whose customer paid can be marked.

#### Paychecks

One row per payroll date and rep (newest first): **Payroll date**, **Rep**, **Base**, commission (paid commissions that week), **Bonus** (monthly goal bonuses) and **Paycheck** (the total). Empty: **Nothing to pay out yet.**

- Base pay is added to each rep's paycheck on payroll dates where they have paid commissions or a bonus.
- A monthly goal bonus is paid with the first payroll after the month ends.

#### Pay settings

- **Base pay per payroll ($)** — added to each paycheck (0 or more).
- **Payroll day** — **Sunday** to **Saturday** (Friday until changed).

Click **Save** (toast **Saved**).

---

### Commission rules

"Rules add up. A stone rule marked "replaces lower stone rules" keeps rules below it from paying on the same area, e.g. a 7% rule for special colors above a 5% levels rule."

Each rule shows its name and a summary (e.g. "5% of the stone · levels 1–3"). Turned-off rules are crossed out. Click a rule to open it.

#### Add a rule

1. Open **Add a rule** (it is open when there are no rules).
2. Fill in:
   - **Name** — required (e.g. "Levels 1-3").
   - **Applies to**:
     - **Stone (per area)** — the stone sold on each area (slab, splash, waterfall and mitered-edge material).
     - **Whole quote** — the quote total before tax.
     - **Price lines (sealer, waterfall…)** — lines whose text contains **Line contains**.
     - **Monthly sales goal** — a bonus once the rep's paid sales in a month reach the goal.
   - **Pays** — **Percent of the amount**, or **Dollars (per sq ft / unit / quote / goal)**.
   - **Rate** — the percent or dollar amount (not negative).
   - **Materials (comma separated)** and **Colors (comma separated)** — leave empty for all (stone rules).
   - **Level from** / **to** — limit to stone levels (stone rules).
   - **Line contains** — e.g. "sealer", "waterfall", "miter" (price-line rules).
   - **Monthly goal ($ of paid sales)** — for monthly goal rules.
   - **Priority (higher first)** — order the rules are applied.
   - **Replaces lower stone rules on the same area** — once this stone rule pays on an area, lower-priority stone rules do not.
3. Click **Add rule** (toast **Saved**).

How amounts are figured:
- Stone, percent: % of the stone's price on that area. Stone, dollars: $ per sq ft.
- Whole quote, percent: % of the quote before tax. Dollars: a flat amount per quote.
- Price lines, percent: % of each matching line. Dollars: $ per unit of the line.
- Monthly goal: the dollar amount once the month's paid sales reach the goal.

#### Change, turn off or delete a rule

Open the rule, then:
- Change fields → **Save rule**. Note: **Save rule** also turns the rule on.
- **Turn off** / **Turn on** — stops or restarts the rule (it stays in the list).
- **Delete rule** — removes it (toast **Rule deleted**).

Rule changes affect amounts after the next **Sync with QuickBooks** (except quotes already **Paid** and signed more than 60 days ago).

---

### My commissions page (employees)

Shows **Signed quotes** (the salary table without the **Rep** column) and **Paychecks** (your own), plus **Back to quotes**. It is read only; ask an admin to sync or to fix a commission.

---

### Common questions

- **Where is the Commissions tab / My Commissions button?** Hidden for now.
- **My signed quote is not listed.** An admin must click **Sync with QuickBooks**. The quote must be signed by the customer.
- **Customer paid shows No invoice.** QuickBooks is not connected, the customer has no invoice in QuickBooks, or the customer is not linked to QuickBooks.
- **Why is the commission $0?** No active rule matches that quote (material, color, level or line text).
- **Can I pay a commission before the customer pays?** No. Only **Paid** rows can be marked paid out and only paid commissions go into paychecks.

## Contractors portal (`/contractors/:companyId`)

The contractors portal is a stone catalog for contractors and builders. It looks like the customer showroom, but each stone card shows a **contractor price** (your retail price minus a fixed discount by stone level). It has stones only: no sinks, faucets or customer account.

**Address:** `/contractors/<company ID>/stones`, for example `https://yourcompany.granite-manager.com/contractors/3/stones`. The number is your company ID (the same number as in the customer showroom link).

**Who can open it:** Anyone with the link. No sign-in is needed.

**How staff share it:** No button or sidebar item in the CRM opens this portal. Type the address yourself (or change `/customer/` to `/contractors/` in your showroom link), then send it to the contractor.

---

### Page layout

- **Header:** company logo, company name and a **Logout** button. **Logout** only matters if someone is signed in on that browser.
- **Menu:** **Inventory** → **Stones**, with the stone filters under it.
- **Stone Search** box at the top.

---

### Which stones appear

The same stones as in the customer showroom:

- **Display** is on for the stone (**Admin > Inventory > Stones** → Edit).
- It has at least one whole slab available, **or** **Regular Stock** is on.

Stones with slabs are listed first, then the rest, each group by name.

---

### Stone cards

Each card shows:

| Field | What it shows |
|-------|---------------|
| Stone name | Title of the card |
| **Size** | Length x width |
| **Type** | Stone type |
| **Price** | Contractor price per square foot, for example `$42`. For stones priced by slab: **By slab $X sqft**. |
| **Bundle** | Only when a bundle number is set |

A red **ON SALE** ribbon marks stones with **On Sale** on.

---

### How the contractor price is calculated

The contractor price is the stone's price per square foot minus a discount based on the stone's **Level**:

| Stone level | Discount per sq ft |
|-------------|--------------------|
| Level 1 or 2 | $3 |
| Level 3 and higher | $5 |
| No level set | No discount |

- The same discount applies to stones priced by slab (**By slab $X sqft**).
- A price never goes below $0.
- The discount amounts are fixed. There is no setting to change them.
- To change what contractors see, change the stone's price or **Level** in **Admin > Inventory > Stones** → Edit (Admin access only).

---

### Enlarged view and search

- Click a stone picture to open it large. It shows **Stone ID**, **Type**, **Size**, **Available**, **Level** and **Bundle**, plus **Installed projects** photos and the magnifier, the same as the customer showroom. **The enlarged view and the search results do not show prices**; the price is only on the card.
- **Stone Search** finds stones by name and shows type and bundle; click a result to open it.

---

### Filters

Under **Stones** in the menu: **Stone Types**, **Finishing** (Polished, Leathered, Honed), **Stone Colors** and **Stone Levels** (Level 1–7), each with **Clear**. A **Suppliers** list also appears, but it does not narrow the list. Filters are kept in the address bar, so a copied link keeps them.

---

### Common questions

- **How do contractors see our prices?** In the contractors portal: take your showroom address, change `/customer/` to `/contractors/`, and send it to the contractor. No button in the CRM opens it.
- **Why is the contractor price lower than the price on our Stones page?** Contractors get $3 off per sq ft on level 1–2 stones and $5 off on level 3 and higher.
- **Why does a card say "By slab"?** The stone is priced by slab rather than by a retail price per square foot.
- **Can I change the contractor discount?** No. The discount is built in. You can only change the stone's price or level.
- **Can contractors see sinks, faucets or invoices here?** No. The contractors portal shows stones only.
- **Why is a stone missing?** It is not set to **Display**, or it has no whole slab available and is not **Regular Stock**.
- **Where is the link in the CRM?** There is none. Use `/contractors/<company ID>/stones`.

## Customer online quote (customers draw their own countertops)

The **online quote** is a public page where a customer draws their countertops, picks a backsplash, sink, cooktop and colors, and sends it to your company. No login is needed. What they send becomes an ordinary quote in **Quotes**, and a new customer becomes a lead. The customer does **not** see a price: they are told you will contact them.

**The link:** `https://<your company address>/customer/<company ID>/quote` (the Stones showroom address with `/quote` instead of `/stones`). To copy it: **Admin > Quotes > Customer Quote** → **Customer quote link** → **Copy**. In an email or text, typing "online quote", "quote link" or asking for measurements offers to insert it (see the SMS and email composer). The chat also answers "what is our customer quote link?".

**Related sections:** Employee Quotes (the saved quote) · Customer Management (leads) · My Account (Telegram lead alerts) · Customer Showroom (the customer's own page).

---

### Admin > Quotes > Customer Quote (set up the online quote)

**Where:** Admin → **Quotes** → **Customer Quote** tab. Anyone with Admin access.

- **Customer quote link** — the company's online quote address, read-only, with **Copy** (*Link copied*). Send it to customers.
- **Customer Quote Options** — the extras the online quote offers (*Add your own options, or delete the ones you do not offer*). Columns **Name**, **Sequence** (order on the customer's Extras step) and **Offered** (a switch). **Add** opens a form with **Name**, **Sequence** and **Offered**; the pencil edits, the trash deletes.
- Every company starts with **Laminate tear out**, **Stone tear out** and **10 year sealer**, all off. Turn one on and the online quote gets an **Extras** step listing every option that is on. All off: no Extras step.
- What the customer picks is added to their quote as an extra: priced by the price list extra with the **same name** (Admin > Quotes > Extras), or added with no price for you to price.

**What the online quote offers (it is not set up separately):**

| Part | Where it comes from |
|------|---------------------|
| **Colors** | Stones in stock with a photo whose color the company's **default price list** (the starred one) prices, not sold out and shown in the catalog. Grouped by material. |
| **Sinks** | The default price list's sink models that are shown in the catalog and have a cutout size and a photo. |
| **Cooktop** | The price list's default cooktop cutout (23" × 14", 4 burners when not set). |
| **Counter depth** | The starting depth from **Admin > Quotes > Measurements**. |
| Tax, payment terms, expiration, rounding, extras marked **Add to every new quote** | The default price list and quote settings, like a quote staff create. |

**"Online quotes are not available right now"** — the customer sees *Online quotes are not available right now. Please call us… and we will be happy to give you a quote.* when the company has no default price list with prices, or no color to offer (no stone in stock with a photo that the list prices). Fix: star a price list in **Admin > Quotes > Price Lists**, give its colors prices, and add photos to the stones in stock.

---

### What the customer does (step by step)

The page shows a step bar at the top. Hints point at what to tap next (*Start here*, *Type the sizes*, *Pick a backsplash*, *Add your sink*, *Have a cooktop?*, *Optional: arrange them*, *Pick your colors*, *Send it to us*…). **Back** and **Next** stay at the bottom of the screen.

1. **Contact** — *Tell us about your countertops · 5 easy steps, about 3 minutes.* **Your name**, **Email** (*We email you a copy of what you send*) and **Phone** (a US number with the area code). **Start**. The same device fills these in next time.
2. **Countertop** — *Draw your countertop.* Tap a shape: **Straight** (along one wall), **L-shape** (two walls that meet in a corner), **U-shape** (three walls) or **Island** (stands on its own, no wall). Type each side in inches (**Side A**, **B**, **C**: left wall, back wall, right wall), measured along the wall from the corner to the end of the counter, and the **Depth (front to back)** (*Most kitchen counters are N inches*, N being the company's usual depth; an island: **Length** and **Width**). The gray lines in the picture are the walls. **Add another countertop (like an island)** adds a piece (up to 8; *What shape is the next countertop?*); **Remove** deletes one. Sizes: 6 to 600 inches; a side that turns a corner must be at least 26 inches (more when the side it meets is deep).
3. **Backsplash** — *Do you want a backsplash?* **No backsplash** (*Just the countertop.*), **Standard (4 inches tall)** or full height (*Stone all the way up to your cabinets*; **How tall?**, 6 to 96 inches, *Most are about 18 inches*). The backsplash goes on the gray walls; tap a side of the drawing (**Add backsplash here** / **Remove backsplash here**) to add or take it off there (a peninsula, for example). Islands only: *No backsplash needed*.
4. **Sink & cooktop** — *Now add your sink and cooktop*. **Add a sink**: pick one of your sinks (photo) or **My own sink** (*I have one or will buy it myself*: then **Undermount**, **Top-mount** or **Farmhouse**), then the countertop and side it goes on. **Add a cooktop** for a cooktop that sits inside the counter (a regular stove needs no cutout). Up to 6; each needs 33 inches of a side (*No room left* when a side is full).
5. **Arrange** (only with more than one piece, optional) — *Arrange your countertops (optional)*: drag each piece to where it is in the kitchen; tap a piece, then **Turn piece N** turns it (the button says *Tap a piece to turn it* until one is picked); **Start over** resets. **Skip** goes on.
6. **Colors** — *Pick colors to compare*: tap up to 10 colors (tap again to take one off; at 10: *You can pick up to 10 colors. Tap one you picked to take it off.*). Filter by material (**All** or a material) or **Search colors** (*No colors match. Try another search.*). A color's **Photos** button shows the stone and its *Installed in a kitchen* photos when there are any; **Pick this color** picks it.
7. **Extras** (only when the company offers some) — *Anything else?* Tap what else they would like done (optional; **Skip** when none).
8. **Send** — *Almost done*: their drawing, colors and extras. The green **Send my details** button asks *Is this your email?* (with *Did you mean …?* for a likely typo, **Yes, use it**) → **Yes, send my details**, or **No, let me fix it** (**Fix your email**: type it, then **Send my details**).

After sending: *Thank you, we got your details! <Company> will look them over and contact you soon. We sent a copy to <email>.*

Messages that stop a send: *You already sent us your details today. We will be in touch soon.* (3 online quotes per email address a day) and *We are getting a lot of quotes right now. Please try again in an hour.* (30 per company an hour).

---

### What your company gets

- **A quote** in **Quotes** (active, revision 1, note *Made by the customer with the online quote*): one area, one color option per color the customer picked, priced with the default price list, its tax, payment terms and expiration. It has no deal. Open it, check the sizes, and edit the drawing like any quote.
- **A new customer becomes a lead.** When no live customer of the company has that email or phone (last 10 digits), a customer is created: source **Leads**, referral source website, no sales rep. It shows under **Customers** → **Leads**.
- **Who is told:**
  - New customer (or a known one with no sales rep): every **Sales Manager** is told. A manager with the Granite Phone app gets a lead push on the phone; the others get a Telegram message from the leads bot (*New lead from the online quote*) with the name, phone, email and each color's price, a button per sales rep (with their leads this month) to assign it, and **Open the quote**. When no manager could be reached either way, the managers are emailed.
  - Known customer with a sales rep: the quote gets that rep. They get a lead push when they have the Granite Phone app, else a Telegram message, else an email (**Open the Quote**).
- **The customer's email** — *<Company> got your countertop details*, with a button to their own customer page, where their online quotes stay (drawing and colors, never a price: *We will contact you about this soon.*). They unlock it with an emailed code (see Customer Showroom → Customer Account). Replies go to their sales rep, else the sales managers.
- If the email to the customer cannot be sent, the quote is still saved and the team's message says *The quote could not be emailed to the customer: email it from the quote.*

---

### Common questions

- **Does the customer see prices?** No. They see their drawing and colors; the prices are in the quote and in the team's message.
- **Where do online quotes show up?** In **Quotes** (All Quotes), on the customer, and in the managers' Telegram. There is no deal until you make one.
- **How do I add or remove an extra the customer can pick?** Admin > Quotes > **Customer Quote** → **Add**, or switch **Offered** off / delete it.
- **Why is a color missing from the online quote?** It needs a stone in stock with a photo, a price in the default price list, not sold out, and shown in the catalog.
- **Why is a sink missing?** It must be in the default price list, shown in the catalog, with a cutout size and a photo.

## Customer showroom portal (`/customer/:companyId`)

The customer showroom is the public catalog of your company's live inventory: **Stones**, **Sinks** and **Faucets**. Customers open it on their phone or computer from a link you send, or on a screen in your showroom. No login is needed to browse. It also has a **Customer Account** area where a customer can see their own projects and invoices after entering a code sent to their email.

**Where to find it (staff):** On any Employee or Admin page, click **Customer** in the top header (next to **Admin** / **Employee**). On phones, the **Customer** button is at the top of the ☰ menu. Every signed-in staff user has this button. While you are in the showroom the button reads **Employee**; click it to go back.

**Address:** `/customer/<company ID>/stones`, for example `https://yourcompany.granite-manager.com/customer/3/stones`. The number is your company ID.

**Who sees it:** Anyone with the link. Customers never see staff pages; the staff-only **CRM > Customers** list is a different page.

---

### What customers see

- **Header:** your company logo (click it to return to **Stones**) and one button: **Customer Account** on the Stones page, **Stones** on the other pages. Staff who are signed in see the normal staff header instead (with the **Employee** button).
- **Menu:** **Inventory** with **Stones**, **Sinks** and **Faucets**. The filters of the open catalog appear under its name. On phones, open the menu with the ☰ button at the top right.
- **No prices** are shown anywhere in the customer showroom: not on cards, not in search, not in the enlarged view. (The Contractors portal is the catalog that shows prices.)

---

### Stones

#### Which stones appear

A stone is listed when all of these are true:

- **Display** is on for the stone (**Admin > Inventory > Stones** → Edit).
- It has at least one whole slab available, **or** **Regular Stock** is on.
- It has a picture.

Stones that only have remnants left are not listed. Stones are sorted by name.

#### Stone cards

Each card shows the stone name, **Size** (length x width), **Type**, and **Bundle** when one is set. Stones with **On Sale** turned on get a red **ON SALE** ribbon.

#### Enlarged view

Click a stone picture to open it large:

- Details: **Stone ID**, **Type**, **Size**, **Available** (available slabs / total slabs, or **Regular Stock**), **Level**, and **Bundle** when set.
- **Installed projects** — a row of photos of finished jobs with this stone. Hover a photo to preview it; click it to keep it on screen (tooltip **Lock in this picture**). Click the main picture to return to the stone photo.
- **Magnifier** button at the top left (**Enable zoom mode**, computers only): first click 1.5x, click again within 3 seconds for 2x, click again to turn it off.
- Move to the next or previous stone with the arrows (computer) or by swiping (phone). Close with the **X**.

While a stone is open, the address bar shows `?stone=<ID>`. A copied link with that part opens the same stone enlarged.

#### Stone Search

The **Stone Search** box at the top finds showroom stones by name (it ignores the filters). Each result shows the type and bundle. Click a result to open it enlarged. **Show more (N more)** lists the remaining results.

#### Stone filters

Under **Stones** in the menu:

| Filter | Options |
|--------|---------|
| **Stone Types** | Your company's stone types |
| **Finishing** | Polished, Leathered, Honed |
| **Stone Colors** | Color list (**Show more** / **Show less**) |
| **Stone Levels** | Level 1 to Level 7 |

Tick options to narrow the list; each group has a **Clear** link. Filters are saved in the address bar, so a copied link keeps them. A **Suppliers** list also appears in the menu, but it does not narrow the customer showroom list.

---

### Sinks and Faucets

- Listed: models with **Display** on that are available or marked **Regular Stock**, and have a picture.
- Cards show the name, **Type**, and **Size** (sinks only). Click a picture for the enlarged view (**Type**, **Size**, **Available**).
- Filters: **Sink Types** (your company's sink types) or **Faucet Types** (Single Handle, Double Handle), each with **Clear**. The **Suppliers** list does not narrow these lists either.

---

### Sharing the showroom with a customer

1. On any staff page, click **Customer** in the header (phones: top of the ☰ menu).
2. Browse to what you want to show: a catalog (**Stones**, **Sinks**, **Faucets**), filters, or one open stone.
3. Copy the full address from the browser's address bar.
4. Paste it into an email, text or chat to the customer.

**Shortcuts:**

- If a stone is open on your **Inventory > Stones** page when you click **Customer**, the showroom opens with that same stone enlarged. Filters you set carry over too.
- In email and SMS templates, **Insert Variable** → **Customer** → **Customer inventory page** adds the showroom link (it uses your company's web address).

---

### Using the showroom on a screen in your shop

- Open the showroom address on the display's browser. No sign-in is needed.
- If a staff member is signed in on that browser, the staff header and buttons show. For a customer-facing screen, use a browser where nobody is signed in (or click **Logout** on **My Account** first).
- A customer who opens **Customer Account** on that screen stays unlocked in that browser for up to 7 days, and there is no sign-out button. On a shared screen, avoid opening a customer's account there, or clear the browser's cookies for the site afterwards.
- The walk-in sign-in form for visitors is a different page; see Walk-in check-in.

---

### Customer Account (projects and invoices)

A customer can see their own projects and invoices. The email they enter must be saved on their customer record in **CRM > Customers**.

#### Steps for the customer

1. On the showroom **Stones** page, click **Customer Account**.
2. In **Access your account**, type the **Email** on their account and click **Email me a code**.
3. They receive an email **Your customer login code** with a 6-digit code. It expires in 10 minutes.
4. Type the code in **Login code** and click **Continue**.
5. Their page opens.

If the email is not on any customer record, no code arrives. For privacy, the page does not say so.

#### The customer's page

- Their name at the top.
- **Quotes**: their online quotes (each drawing and its colors, never a price).
- **Projects** table: **Date**, **Stone**, **Stone Pictures** (click to enlarge, **Open image**), **Sink**, **Sales Rep**, **Status**. Status is **Sold**, **Partially Cut**, **Cut**, **Installed** or **Cancelled**.
- **Invoices** (from QuickBooks): **Invoice**, **Date**, **Project** (when an address is known), **Total**, **Balance**, **Status** (**Paid**, **Partial**, **Open**). Click an invoice to open its PDF.

Invoice messages:

- **Invoices are unavailable right now.** — QuickBooks is not connected for the company.
- **No invoices were found for this account.** — The customer has no QuickBooks invoices, or is not linked to QuickBooks.
- **Could not load invoices.** — A temporary error; reload later.

#### Code screen and messages

The code screen is titled **Verify it's you** (*We'll send the code to <masked email>.*). A wrong page address says *That page could not be found.*:

- **Resend code** sends a new code. Wait about 45 seconds between sends, or you get **Please wait a moment before requesting another code.**
- **That code is not valid.** / **That code expired. Request a new one.** / **Too many attempts. Request a new code.** (after 8 wrong tries).
- **Cancel — use a different email** starts over.
- If the account has no email: **This account does not have an email on file. Contact the company to add one before you can sign in.**

After a customer verifies, that browser stays unlocked for up to 7 days, and **Customer Account** opens their page directly.

The CRM has no button that copies a customer's personal page link. Send the showroom link and have the customer use **Customer Account**.

---

### Other public addresses

- **`/customer/stones`** (no company number) on your company's own web address finds your company from the address and opens your **Stones** page. If the company cannot be found, it shows **Company not found**.
- **Choose your company** (`/customers/companies`) on the main Granite Manager site lists a fixed set of showroom companies (**Select a location to browse stones and products**). Clicking a logo opens that company's showroom; **For Employees** opens the sign-in page. On a company's own web address, visitors who are not signed in go to the sign-in page instead, which has a **For Customers** link to the showroom.
- **`/customer/<company ID>/stones/slabs/<stone ID>`** opens **Slabs for <stone name>**, listing each available slab (bundle and size; click the thumbnail to enlarge). The showroom page has no button that opens it.

### Slab QR code links (staff only)

A printed slab QR code opens `/redirects/slabs/<slab ID>`. For a signed-in staff user it opens that stone's slab list in **Inventory > Stones** (Employee view) with the slab highlighted. If you are not signed in, you go to the sign-in page; after signing in, scan the code again. Customers cannot use these links.

---

### Common questions

- **Why don't customers see prices?** The customer showroom never shows prices.
- **Why is a stone missing from the showroom?** Its **Display** switch is off, it has no whole slab available and **Regular Stock** is off (remnants only), or it has no picture. Change this in **Admin > Inventory > Stones** → Edit (Admin access only).
- **Why does picking a supplier change nothing?** The **Suppliers** list does not filter the customer showroom. Use the type, finishing, color and level filters.
- **The customer did not get the login code.** Check that their email is saved on their customer record, ask them to check spam, and wait about 45 seconds before **Resend code**. Codes expire after 10 minutes.
- **The customer sees "Invoices are unavailable right now."** QuickBooks is not connected for the company.
- **How do I get back to the CRM?** Click **Employee** in the header (phones: top of the ☰ menu).

## Customer survey page (`/customer/:companyId/survey`)

The customer survey is the public post-installation feedback form your customers fill in after their countertops are installed. They rate the sales rep, the template technician and the installation team with stars, and can add comments. Answers are anonymous unless the customer types their name. Staff read the answers on the Admin **Survey** page (see Admin Surveys (Customer Feedback)).

**Address:** `/customer/<company ID>/survey`, for example `https://yourcompany.granite-manager.com/customer/3/survey`. No login is needed.

**Who sees it:** Anyone with the link. The page shows only your company logo: no menu and no showroom buttons.

---

### How customers receive the survey

The survey is sent automatically after an installer submits the post-install **checklist** for the job. Nobody needs to click anything.

| When | What is sent |
|------|--------------|
| 1 day after the checklist | Email **<Company> - Post-Installation Survey** with a **Rate your experience** button, plus a text message: **Thank you for choosing <Company>! How did we do? It takes about a minute (just tap the stars) and is fully anonymous: <link>** |
| Day 3 | Reminder |
| Day 5 | Reminder email, only to customers who are reminded by text |
| Day 7 | Reminder |

- Day 3 and day 7 reminders:
  - If the company uses CloudTalk for SMS, the reminder is a text (**Friendly reminder from <Company>: …**). If the text cannot be sent, an email goes out instead.
  - Otherwise, the reminder is an email with the subject **<Company> - Reminder: Post-Installation Survey**, plus the reminder text when RingCentral can send it.
- Messages go out only during send hours: weekdays 5:00–8:30 PM and weekends 10 AM–5 PM (Eastern time by default). A survey due outside those hours waits for the next window.
- The email goes to the email entered on the checklist. Texts go to the customer's phone and need all of these:
  - The company has SMS (CloudTalk or RingCentral) connected.
  - The checklist is linked to a customer with a 10-digit phone number.
  - An **Office Manager** user has a phone line on that SMS service.
- Reminders stop as soon as the customer submits the survey from their link.
- The link in these messages fills in the installer from the checklist automatically.

#### Sharing the survey by hand

You can send `/customer/<company ID>/survey` yourself, for example in an email. That plain link has no installer filled in. A survey sent through it does not stop the automatic reminders for a checklist. The CRM has no button that copies the survey link.

---

### What the customer sees

Heading: **How did we do at <Company>?** with **Just tap the stars. It takes about a minute and is fully anonymous unless you add your name.** and **We do not save your email, phone or address with your answers, or your name unless you add it below.**

Four cards:

1. **How did you like your sales rep?**
   - **Select rep** dropdown: the company's sales reps.
   - 5 stars.
   - **Add a comment (optional)** opens a comment box (**Anything you would like us to know? (optional)**).
2. **How did you like the template technician?** — 5 stars and an optional comment. (There is no technician dropdown.)
3. **How did you like the installation team?**
   - **Select installer** dropdown, filled in when the customer came from the automatic link.
   - 5 stars.
   - Optional comment.
4. **Your name (optional)** — **Leave blank to stay anonymous** (up to 255 characters).

Star labels: 1 **Poor**, 2 **Fair**, 3 **Good**, 4 **Very good**, 5 **Excellent**.

A bar at the bottom shows **N of 3 rated** and the **Send feedback** button.

---

### Filling in and sending

1. Choose the sales rep in **Select rep** and tap the stars.
2. Tap the stars for the template technician.
3. Check or choose the installer in **Select installer** and tap the stars.
4. Optionally add comments (*Comments about your sales rep*, *Comments about the template technician*, *Comments about the installation team*) and a name.
5. Tap **Send feedback**.

**Required:** sales rep, installer, and a star rating in all three sections. Comments and name are optional.

**Messages:**

- **Please choose your sales rep and installer, and rate all three.**
- **Please give a star rating in each section.**
- **Your name is too long: shorten it or leave it blank.**
- **We could not save your answers. Please check the stars and try again.** — saving failed; try again.

**After sending:** **Thank you!** — **Your feedback was sent to <Company>. It helps us take better care of every customer.**

---

### Who appears in the dropdowns

- **Select rep** lists the company's users with the **Sales Representative** position.
- **Select installer** lists users with the **Installer** position.
- Both are sorted by name. Deleted users are not listed.

To add someone, give them the position in **Admin > Company settings > Users** (**Actions → Edit**). To fix a name, change the user's **Name** there. Surveys already sent keep the name saved at that time.

---

### Where the answers go

Each submission appears on the Admin **Survey** page (Admin sidebar → **Survey**, Admin access only) with the sales rep, installer, the three ratings and comments. Submitting does not send alerts to staff.

---

### Common questions

- **A customer never got the survey.** The checklist had no customer email, the text conditions above weren't met, or less than a day has passed (and the send hours have not come yet).
- **Why isn't a sales rep or installer in the dropdown?** They don't have the **Sales Representative** or **Installer** position, or their user was deleted.
- **Can customers stay anonymous?** Yes. Only the name they type (if any) is saved. Their email, phone and address are not saved with the answers.
- **How do I stop the reminders?** They stop when the customer submits the survey from the link they received.
- **Can I see the answers?** Admins can, on the Admin **Survey** page.

## Document scope

This manual describes **what exists** in Granite Manager, **where to find it**, **who can use it**, and **how to do each task step by step**: every staff portal (Employee, Admin, Shop, Installer, Template, Marketing, Walk-in), the customer-facing pages (showroom, quote link, e-signature, survey), and platform superuser tools. It is written from the application itself and does not cover internal technical documentation.

## Employee Customers — Customer Information window

**Customer Information** is the full picture of one customer: contact details, lead form answers, all their deals, assignment history, QuickBooks invoices, an AI search of their messages, and every activity, note, call, text and email.

**Where to find it:** **CRM > Customers** → click a customer's row, or click a name in **Find Customer**. Admins: **Admin > CRM > Customers**, the same way. Close it with **X**, **Esc** or a click outside. Your list filters stay as they were.

**Who can use it:** everyone with access to **CRM > Customers**.

The window has two tabs, always shown: **Company info** and **Projects**.

---

### Company info tab — left column

#### Contact

- **Name** (**Contact name** when the customer has a company)
- **Company**
- **Email** (and **Email 2**, **Email 3**…)
- **Phone 1**, **Phone 2**
- **Address**, with a **Map** button for Google Maps directions
- **Sales rep** (or *Not assigned*)
- **Source**
- **Created**

Hover a value and click it to copy it (**Copy**). The **pencil** (**Edit customer information**) opens **Edit Customer**. Save with **Submit**, and the window refreshes.

#### Project

Shown when the customer has lead form or ad details:

- **Location**
- **Remodal type**, **Project size**, **Contact time**, **Tear out**, **Improve offer**, **Sink**, **When start**, **Backsplash**, **Kitchen stove**
- **Your message**, **Notes**, **QBO ID**
- **Campaign**, **Ad set**, **Ad name**

Only filled-in items appear.

#### Deals

Every deal of this customer that isn't deleted (open, won or lost), from any sales rep. Each deal card shows:

- The **stage** name
- The **$ amount**
- **Created** date
- **Lost reason** (in red), if any

Each card has two buttons:

- **Add Activity**: type an **Activity name...**, optionally pick a **Deadline** (*Optional*), then click the green checkmark (or press **Enter**). The **X** cancels. The message **Activity added** appears.
- **Add Note**: type in **Write a note...**, then click the green checkmark (or press **Enter**). The message **Note added** appears.

Both save on that deal and show in the deal's activity panel. **No deals found** means the customer has no deals. These cards don't open the deal. To open it, use **CRM > Deals** (Find Customer) or **Go to Deal** in an email.

#### History

A timeline of what happened to the customer, for example:

- "Customer added as a lead on …" / "Customer created by … on …"
- "Assigned to … by sales manager" / "Assigned to … by … on …"
- "Deal created by … on …" / "Deal automatically created on …"
- "Deal marked as won …" / "Deal marked as lost (reason) …"
- "Deal deleted by … on …" / "Customer deleted on …"

Only the latest 3 show. **Show more** / **Show less** opens or closes the rest.

---

### Company info tab — right column

#### QuickBooks

Shown only when QuickBooks is turned on **and** connected for the company.

- Click **Get invoices** ("Load invoices from QuickBooks when you need them.").
- You get a table of the customer's QuickBooks invoices: **Invoice**, **Date**, **Project**, **Total**, **Balance**, **Status** (**Paid**, **Partial**, **Open**).
- Click an invoice to open its PDF. The pencil edits it (**Save to QuickBooks** / **Save and send**). The envelope emails it with the PDF attached.

There is no separate Invoices tab. Full details are in the **Invoices** section.

#### AI Activity Search

Ask a question about this customer's history, for example "What price did we quote?" or "When did they say they'd decide?".

1. Type in **Ask about this customer activity...** (at least 3 characters).
2. Optional: tick **Include phone calls (slower)** to also search call recordings.
3. Click **Search** (or press **Enter**). While it works, the button says "Searching emails and messages…" (or "…and calls…").

The answer shows with a **Sources** list of the emails, texts or calls it used. Sources shown as links open that item.

#### Activity

A read-only timeline of everything with this customer across all their live deals. Filter with **All**, **Activities**, **Notes**, **Actions** (calls), **SMS** (only when the company uses CloudTalk or RingCentral) and **Emails**.

- Calls and texts are found by the customer's phone numbers.
- You can't edit, pin, complete or delete items here. Do that inside the deal.
- Click an **email** to read the whole conversation in this window. It is read-only: reply from **CRM > Emails** or from the deal. **Go to Deal** opens the linked deal. The back arrow returns to **Company info**. Opening it marks the customer's email as read, except when an admin opens it.
- Texts can't be opened from here. Open them from the deal's **History** or from **CRM > SMS**.

---

### Projects tab

Groups related customers, for example a builder company and each of its job sites, into one family.

**Link another customer:**

1. Type at least 2 letters in **Search to link existing customer...**.
2. Pick a customer from the results (**No customers found** if none).
3. Click **Link Customer**. That customer becomes a project of this family.

**The family cards** (this customer, the main customer and its linked projects). Each card shows:

- Name (the company name for the customer you opened), emails, phone, city/state/ZIP
- The stage of the newest live deal, or **No active deals**
- The sales rep's name

Click a card to unfold its **Projects History**: completed sales, each with the job address (**No address provided** if blank), sale date and price. **No completed projects found** means it has no sales yet. **No other customers found for this company** means nothing is linked yet.

The **Companies** view of **CRM > Customers** shows each company's **Revenue Generated** and **Amount of projects**.

---

### Common questions

- **How do I open Customer Information from a deal?** Not from inside the deal: go to **CRM > Customers** and click the customer's row (or a name in **Find Customer** there). Inside the deal, the **Project** tab shows the customer's details.
- **How do I create a project, or keep several jobs under one customer?** Several jobs for the same customer: add a deal for each job (**CRM > Deals** → **Add Deal** → pick the same customer). A builder with job sites: add each site as its own customer, then open the builder's **Customer Information** → **Projects** tab → **Search to link existing customer...** → **Link Customer**.
- **How do I edit a customer from here?** Click the pencil on **Contact**.
- **Why is there no QuickBooks section?** QuickBooks isn't turned on or connected for the company. An admin connects it in company settings.
- **Can I reply to an email here?** No, this view is read-only. Use **CRM > Emails**, or open the deal and use the envelope on its **Project** tab.
- **Why doesn't clicking a deal card open the deal?** Cards here are for quick activities and notes only. Open the deal from **CRM > Deals**.
- **Where is the Invoices tab?** It was removed. Invoices are in the **QuickBooks** section of **Company info**.
- **Why are both tabs shown for a person without a company?** **Company info** and **Projects** are always shown. **Projects** is simply empty until you link customers.

## Employee Customers (Customer Management)

**Customers** is the list of everyone your company works with: walk-ins, leads, call-ins and companies. Use it to find a customer, add or edit one, assign a sales rep, mark a lead invalid, or delete a customer. Click a customer to open **Customer Information** (see Employee Customers — Customer Information window).

**Where to find it:** Employee portal → sidebar **CRM > Customers** (page title **Customers List**). Admins have the same page at **Admin > CRM > Customers**.

**Who sees it:** everyone with Employee CRM access sees **all** of the company's customers, not only their own. **Invalid** and **Delete** in the row menu need the **Sales Manager** position.

---

### Filters

| Filter | Options |
|--------|---------|
| View | **Customers** (people, the default) or **Companies** (only customers with a company name) |
| Type | **All Customers**, **Walk-in** (the default), **Leads**, **Call-In**. Customers with the source **Other** or a custom source only show under **All Customers**. |
| Sales rep | **All Sales Reps** or one rep |
| **Invalid leads** | Checkbox, only on **Leads**. Tick it to also show leads marked invalid (yellow rows). Invalid customers are hidden everywhere else. |

Filters, sorting and the page number stay in the address bar. Switching to **Companies** sets the type to **All Customers**.

---

### The table

**Customers view columns:**

- **Name of customer** (long names are cut short)
- **Phone Number** (Phone 1 and Phone 2)
- **Email** (every address)
- **Sales Rep**: a dropdown. Picking a rep saves at once (see **Assigning a sales rep** below).
- **Date**: when the customer was added. On **Leads** this column is **Assigned**, the date the lead was first given to a sales rep (or when it came in, if it has no rep yet).
- **⋮** (**Actions**): **Edit**, plus **Invalid** and **Delete** for Sales Managers

**Companies view columns:** **Name of Company**, **Phone Number**, **Revenue Generated**, **Amount of projects**, **Sales Rep**, **Date**.

- **Sorting:** click a column title (arrow up or down). Without a sort, the newest customers come first.
- **Row colors:** **red** = no sales rep; **yellow** = marked invalid.
- **Open a customer:** click the row to open **Customer Information**.
- **Pages:** **Rows per page** (10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500; 20 by default) and page arrows, above and below the table.

**On a phone:** the search box and a round **+** (add customer) are at the top, then the three filters. Each customer shows as a row with name, phone, email, date and a **Sales Rep** dropdown.

#### Monthly counts by sales rep

In the Customers view, next to **Add Customer**, a line such as **Walk-ins this month:** (or **Leads this month:**, **Call-ins this month:**, **Customers this month:**) shows how many customers each rep got this month for the selected type. Leads count by the date they were assigned; walk-ins and call-ins count by the date they were added, without invalid ones.

Rep names are colored by rank (the **ⓘ**, *How sales rep colors are ranked*, explains it): **green** = fewest, **yellow** = second, **orange** = third, **red** = fourth or more (most). When counts are tied, the rep whose latest customer came in earlier ranks higher. Hover the **ⓘ** icon to see these rules.

---

### Find Customer

The search box (**Find customer or company**) sits above the table on a computer and at the top on a phone.

1. Type a name, company name, phone number (4 or more digits) or email (anything with **@**).
2. Results show the company, emails and phones. **Show more** loads 5 more. **Enter** opens the first result.
3. Click a name to open **Customer Information**.

Each result has an **Edit** (pencil) and a **Delete** (trash) button. Deleting only works for Sales Managers and admins. Others get an error.

---

### Adding a customer

1. Click **Add Customer** (phone: the round **+**). It isn't shown in the Companies view.
2. Fill in the **Add Customer** form:

| Field | Required | Rules / notes |
|-------|----------|---------------|
| **Name*** | Yes | "Name is required" |
| **Email** | No | Must be a valid email. **Add email** adds **Email 2**, **Email 3**… (the **X** removes one). The first one is the main address. |
| **Phone 1** | No | Format **XXX-XXX-XXXX**, a valid US number |
| **Phone 2** | No | Click **Add a phone** to show it. The **X** removes it. |
| **Billing Address** | No | Pick from the address suggestions. If filled, at least 3 characters. |
| **Source*** | Yes | **Walk-in**, **Leads**, **Call-in**, **Other**, plus your company's own sources. "Source is required" |
| **Sales Rep** | No | Pick a rep (**Select**) |
| **Company** | No | Switch it on to show **Company Name** |
| **Notes** | No | Free text. It shows as **Your Message** on the deal's Project tab. |

3. Click **Submit**. The message **Customer added successfully** appears.

**Duplicate check:** if a phone number or email already belongs to a customer, saving stops and a box says **Customer [name] already exists** with **Sales rep: [name]** (or **Unassigned**). Open that customer instead, or change the contact details.

**What happens when you add a customer:**

- No sales rep picked, the source isn't **Walk-in**, and you hold the **Sales Rep** position? You become the sales rep.
- A customer with a sales rep automatically gets an open deal in the first column of the company's default group, on that rep's deal board.
- The customer is added to the company phone system's contacts (CloudTalk / RingCentral).

#### Managing sources (admins)

Admins see a **Manage** link next to **Source*** in the form. It opens **Manage Sources**:

- Type in **New source** → **Add**.
- **Pencil** renames a source. Renaming a built-in source only changes the label people see.
- **Trash** deletes a custom source → **Delete Source** ("Delete … ? Existing customers keep this source. It will no longer appear in the dropdown."). Built-in sources can't be deleted.
- **Close** when done.

---

### Editing a customer

Open the form from:

- **⋮ → Edit**,
- the pencil in **Find Customer**,
- the pencil (**Edit customer information**) on **Contact** in **Customer Information**, or
- **Edit Customer** on a deal's **General** tab.

The **Edit Customer** form has the same fields as **Add Customer**. Click **Submit**. The message **Customer updated successfully** appears.

- There is no duplicate check on edit. But an email that already belongs to another customer is refused: "[email] is already saved on [name]".
- Changing **Sales Rep** works like assigning a rep (next section).

---

### Assigning a sales rep

Pick a rep in the **Sales Rep** dropdown of the row (or in the customer form). It saves right away, and the red row color goes away.

What happens:

- The first assignment date is recorded (used by the **Leads** tab's **Assigned** column and the monthly counts). **History** in **Customer Information** gets a line "Assigned to … by …".
- **All** of the customer's deals move to the new rep's deal board.
- If the customer has no open deal, one is created in the first column of the company's default group.
- When assigned from the list, the rep gets two reminders in their notifications: **Please text [name]** (due a day after the customer came in) and **Please check the customer [name]** (due three days after).

### Marking a lead invalid

**Who:** users with the **Sales Manager** position (in the **⋮** menu).

1. **⋮ → Invalid**. **Mark invalid: [name]** opens.
2. Choose a **Reason** (**Select reason**):
   - Wrong number, email, etc.
   - Out of area
   - Accident submission
   - Looking for unrelated service
   - **Other** (type your own reason)
3. Click **Save** (or **Cancel**). The message **Customer marked invalid** appears.

What happens:

- The reason is saved and the sales rep is removed.
- **All of the customer's deals are deleted.** Each deletion is recorded in the customer's History.
- The customer disappears from every tab. To see invalid leads, open **Leads** and tick **Invalid leads** (yellow rows).

There is no button to undo **Invalid**.

### Deleting a customer

**Who:** users with the **Sales Manager** position (**⋮ → Delete**). Admins and Sales Managers can also use the trash icon in **Find Customer**.

1. **Delete customer**: "Are you sure you want to delete [name]?" Click **Confirm** (or **Cancel**).
2. If the customer has deals, a second step warns: "This customer has N associated deal(s). The customer and their deals will be hidden — nothing is permanently deleted. Continue with [name]?" Click **Confirm** (or **Back**).

The message **Customer deleted** appears. The customer and their deals are hidden from all lists and boards, and the customer is removed from the phone system's contacts. There is no undo button in the app.

The address `/employee/customers/view/` + a customer number opens **Customer: [name]**. It shows emails, phone and address, plus a table of sales (**Date**, **Seller**, **Price**). **Open PDF** opens a sale's contract. No button on the list leads here; it is used by links (for example after an online payment).

### Sharing your stone catalog with a customer

Customers can browse your live stones, sinks and faucets without logging in. Send them the **customer showroom** link, not the staff **Customers** page, which customers can't open.

1. In the top header, click **Customer** (on a phone, the **Customer** button is at the top of the sidebar). The showroom opens and the address bar shows something like `…/customer/3/stones` (3 is your company's number).

Click **Employee** in the header to go back.

### Common questions

- **How do I add a new lead source?** Admins: in the **Add Customer** (or edit) form, click **Manage** next to **Source** → type in **New source** → **Add**.
- **I deleted a customer by mistake. Can I undo it?** There is no undo button in the app. Nothing is permanently deleted: the customer and their deals are only hidden from all lists and boards.
- **How do I tell leads from walk-ins?** Use the type filter (**Walk-in**, **Leads**, **Call-In**). The **Source** shows in **Customer Information** too.
- **Why is a row red?** The customer has no sales rep. Pick one in the **Sales Rep** column.
- **Why don't I see Invalid or Delete in the ⋮ menu?** They need the **Sales Manager** position (**Admin > Company settings > Users**).
- **A customer is missing from the list.** Check the type filter (customers with source **Other** or a custom source are only under **All Customers**), the sales rep filter, and **Invalid leads** on **Leads**. Deleted customers don't show.
- **Why can't I save a new customer?** The phone or email belongs to an existing customer (**… already exists**), the phone isn't **XXX-XXX-XXXX**, or **Source** is empty.
- **I assigned a rep and a deal appeared.** That's automatic. Every customer with a rep has an open deal on that rep's board.
- **Can I export or import customers (Excel, CSV)?** No. There is no customer export or import in the app; the only CSV export is the cut-slabs report (**Admin > Transactions** → **Reports** → **Export to CSV**). Large imports (for example from Moraware) are done by the Granite Manager team.
- **Can I merge two customers?** No. There is no merge in the app: keep the one you use and delete the other (Sales Managers: **⋮** → **Delete**). Deals, notes and messages of the deleted one are not moved.
