## Dashboard widgets (leaderboard, sales goal, stats, call coach, daily sales, inventory)

This section explains the numbers widgets on the Employee **Dashboard**: what each one counts, what you can click, and when it appears. To add, remove or move widgets, use **Edit** on the Dashboard (see **Employee Dashboard**).

**Where to find it:** Employee view → sidebar **Dashboard**. All numbers are **your own** (deals assigned to you, emails and texts you sent). The exceptions are the Leaderboard, which compares people, and Daily sales and Available inventory, which show the whole company.

---

### Leaderboard (points)

Ranks the company's sales reps by points. It is always the first card.

**Shown when:** your company's **Leaderboard** feature is turned on. Granite Manager platform admins set this per company. When it is off, the card is hidden and not offered in **Add widget**. Your choice to show or hide it is kept for when it comes back on.

**Who is ranked:** only users with the **Sales Rep** position. If you are not a sales rep (for example a manager or Super Admin), you see your own score in a separate row marked **Not ranked** (*Only Sales Reps are ranked. Only you see this row.*).

**What you see:**
- A period switch: **This month** or **All time** (default **All time**, meaning since points started counting).
- Up to 5 people. Gold, silver and bronze rings mark the top 3. Your own row is highlighted and named **You**. If you are far down the list, you see the top people, the person just above you, and yourself, with **N more** where rows are skipped.
- A colored bar per person split by source (**won deals**, **deal progress**, **calls**, **SMS**, **emails**, and **tours** when guided tours are on). Hover the bar, or the ⓘ next to the points, to see each source's points.
- Footer: your goal, such as **N points to pass <name>**, **Top of the board** or **Tied for first**. A line under it counts your conversations, voicemails, call attempts, SMS and emails.
- **See all ranks** opens **All ranks** (*This month's points* or *All-time points* for N people): everyone with their points, points per source and activity counts.
- With no points yet: **No points yet** (or **No points yet this month**) and *The first points take the lead.*

**How points are earned** (click the ⓘ next to **Leaderboard**):

| Activity | Points |
|---|---|
| Won deal | 25 |
| Deal moved to a new stage | 3 (each new stage a deal enters; creating the deal doesn't count) |
| Call: conversation | 10 |
| Call: voicemail left | 5 |
| Call: attempt (7 s or less) | 2 |
| SMS sent by hand | 1 |
| Email sent | 1 |
| Finished tour | As shown on the tour (only when your company's guided tours are on) |

Calls are your outgoing CloudTalk or RingCentral calls. Calls are picked up and checked periodically, so call points can appear with a delay. A call with 7 seconds of talk or less is an **attempt**. A longer one is transcribed and read: only a mailbox greeting is still an attempt, a greeting followed by your message is a **voicemail**, and real back-and-forth (both sides talking, a few turns each) is a **conversation**; up to 30 seconds of talk counts as a conversation only with that back-and-forth. Per customer phone number per day, only 1 call attempt, 1 voicemail and 3 SMS count. Conversations and emails always count. Automated SMS-flow messages, scheduled messages and emails the app sends for you don't score.

---

### Sales goal: Won deals or QuickBooks sales

A single widget (named **Sales goal** in **Add widget**). Its title depends on your company:
- **QuickBooks sales**, if QuickBooks is turned on **and** connected for your company.
- **Won deals**, otherwise.

The app switches between the two automatically. You never have both.

**What it shows (both versions):**
- The amount for **This month**:
  - **Won deals:** the total amount of your deals marked won this month.
  - **QuickBooks sales:** your sales this month from QuickBooks' *Sales by Class* report. These are the classes named after you (your full name, "Name/…", or your first name), including their subclasses.
- **Goal $** box: your monthly sales goal. It shows 50,000 until you save your own.
- With a goal: **N% of goal** and a progress bar, plus:
  - **Need by week end:** what you still need by the end of this week to be on pace, or **On pace**.
  - **Per day (month end):** how much per working day (Mon–Fri) you need to reach the goal by month end, or **Goal reached**.

The month is split into 7-day weeks (days 1–7, 8–14, and so on). The weekly target is your share of the goal for the working days through the end of the current week.

**Set or change your goal:**
1. Click the **Goal** box on the widget.
2. Type the amount (more than $0).
3. Press Enter or click outside the box. It saves to your account. If it can't save, you'll see *We couldn't save your goal. Please try again*.

**QuickBooks extras:**
- **View by customer** opens **Sales by customer** (*Your QuickBooks sales for <month>*). It lists each customer with the amount and this month's invoices (date, invoice number, total), plus a **Total** row. Click an invoice to open its PDF in a new tab.
- If QuickBooks has a problem, the card says **Please notify your manager that QuickBooks is disconnected.**

---

### My sales

Your deals for the current month so far (shown at top right, for example *October 2026*). Only deals assigned to you count.
- **Closed won:** deals won this month.
- **Won revenue:** amount of those won deals.
- **Active deals** (*In pipeline*): your open deals, whenever they were created.
- **Pipeline** (*Open deals*): total amount of your open deals.
- **New deals:** deals created this month.
- **Win rate:** won ÷ (won + lost) this month, with *N won · M lost*. Shown only once you have won or lost a deal this month.

### Conversion metrics

Your close rate for **All time**: won deals out of all your deals, as a percent with *won of total*:
- **Sold (Total):** all your deals.
- **Closed Leads:** customers whose source is leads.
- **Walk-in:** customers who came in through the walk-in check-in form.
- **Call-in:** customers whose source is call-in.

With no deals: **No deals created yet.**

### Call coach

AI coaching on your recent sales calls.

**Shown when:** your account has both a **CloudTalk agent ID** and a **CloudTalk phone number** (on **My Account**, or set by an admin under **Admin > Company settings > Users**).

**What it lists:** your last 3 incoming or outgoing CloudTalk calls from the last 30 days with more than one minute of talk time. Each shows the customer name (or phone number), *Incoming/Outgoing*, the talk time and the date.

**Get coaching:**
1. Click **Ask coach** on a call.
2. Wait while it works (*Listening to the recording…*, *Scoring the conversation…*, and so on).
3. You get a **score from 1 to 100**, a one-line summary and 2–4 sentences of advice. The score is green for 67–100, yellow for 34–66, and red/orange for 1–33.

It scores how well you advanced the call: asking questions before pitching, a calm and confident tone, a clear next step (such as a showroom visit with a choice of times), and finding the decision-maker and the real concern. If scoring fails, the call shows a reason (for example **No recording for this call**) and a **Try again** button. Empty states: **No calls longer than one minute in the last 30 days.** or **Could not load recent calls.**

### My top sold colors

Up to 3 stones you sold the most full slabs of this month (cancelled sales and remnants don't count). It shows the number of slabs and square feet. Empty: **No slab sales recorded this month yet.** Not on the dashboard by default. Add it with **Edit → Add widget → Top sold colors**.

### Sent emails

Bar chart of emails you sent in each of the last 3 months, with **N this month** at the top. Hover a bar for its count. Only if your company has Emails. Empty: **No emails sent in the last 3 months.** Not on by default.

### Sent SMS

Bar chart of texts you sent from Granite Manager in each of the last 3 months, with **N this month**. It counts texts from your CloudTalk agent or RingCentral extension. If the company has both, RingCentral is used. Only if your company has SMS. Empty: **No SMS sent from Granite Manager in the last 3 months.** Not on by default.

### Daily sales

Every sale the company made today (your local day), newest first, with the day, the number of sales and their total at the top. Switch **Day / Week / Month** at the top right to see this week (Sunday to Saturday) or this calendar month instead. It refreshes every 2 minutes. Cancelled sales are left out. Each sale shows:
- **Sales order:** the customer, with **Signed** (green) when the customer has a signed contract, or **Not signed**. Click **Signed** to open the signed contract, or **Not signed** (*Sales order, not signed yet*) to open the sale's contract PDF.
- **Sales rep:** who sold it.
- **Stone color:** the stones of the sold slabs.
- **Sinks:** the sinks sold with it, for example *2 × Undermount 3219*, or **No sink**.
- **Package:** the price list of the deal's quote. Empty (**—**) when the sale's deal has no quote.
- **Sale amount** and **Deposit**. The deposit is the one on the sales order: half of a sale over $1,000, otherwise the full amount.

On a phone each sale is a card. Empty: **No sales yet today.** (or **this week** / **this month**). Not on by default. Add it with **Edit → Add widget → Daily sales**.

### Available inventory

The company's stones that have slabs in the yard not tied to a sale, by name: the stone type, the number of whole slabs and the remnants (**rem.**). The top shows how many colors and slabs. Click a stone to open its slabs. Type in **Search colors** to filter by stone name or type. Empty: **No slabs available.** Not on by default. Add it with **Edit → Add widget → Available inventory**.

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **Why am I "Not ranked"?** Only users with the Sales Rep position are ranked. Your row is visible only to you.
- **Why didn't my call/text score points?** Only 1 attempt, 1 voicemail and 3 SMS per customer number per day count. Automated flow and scheduled messages never score.
- **How do I see last month's points?** You can't. The leaderboard shows only **This month** and **All time**.
- **Why does it say Won deals instead of QuickBooks sales?** QuickBooks isn't turned on and connected for your company.
- **My QuickBooks sales show $0 or nothing.** Your sales are matched to QuickBooks classes named after you. Ask your manager to check the class names. If the card says QuickBooks is disconnected, a manager must reconnect it.
- **Where do I change my monthly goal?** In the **Goal** box on the Won deals / QuickBooks sales widget. Type the amount and press Enter.
- **No Call coach widget.** Add both your CloudTalk agent ID and CloudTalk phone number on **My Account**.
- **Ask coach failed with "No recording for this call".** The call wasn't recorded in CloudTalk, so it can't be scored.
- **Numbers look different from Admin Statistics.** Dashboard numbers cover only your own deals, and My sales covers only the current month.

## Employee Dashboard

The **Dashboard** is your home page in the Employee view. It shows your unread messages, the points leaderboard, your sales goal and monthly numbers, call coaching, shortcuts, and your onboarding checklist. Each block is a **widget**: you choose which ones appear and in what order.

**Where to find it:** Employee view → sidebar **Dashboard** (the first item, above **Inventory**). Staff who open the site's home address while signed in are taken here.

**Who can see it:** Anyone with Employee or Admin access (and platform superusers), in the **Employee** view. The **Admin** view's sidebar has no Dashboard, so switch to **Employee** first. Shop workers, installers, marketing and walk-in accounts use their own portals and don't have this page. Each person has their own layout. Nobody else sees how you arranged yours.

Details for each numbers widget (Leaderboard, Sales goal, My sales, Conversion metrics, Call coach, Top sold colors, Sent emails, Sent SMS, Daily sales, Available inventory) are in **Dashboard widgets**.

---

### What is on the page

From top to bottom:

1. **Dashboard** title, the **Unread** strip (only when you have unread messages) and the **Edit** button.
2. The **Telegram** panel. It shows only until both Telegram bots are connected (see below).
3. The widget grid.

### All widgets

| Widget (name in **Add widget**) | What it shows | Shown when | On by default |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Unread messages** | Unread emails and CloudTalk texts, in the top row (*Unread emails and SMS*) | Always (empty = hidden) | Yes |
| **Leaderboard** | Points ranking of the company's sales reps | Your company's Leaderboard feature is on | Yes |
| **Call coach** | AI score and advice on your recent calls | You have a CloudTalk agent ID **and** CloudTalk phone number | Yes, if available |
| **Sales goal** | Card **QuickBooks sales** (QuickBooks connected) or **Won deals** (otherwise), with your monthly goal | Always (one or the other) | Yes |
| **My sales** | Your deals this month: won, revenue, pipeline, new, win rate | Always | Yes |
| **Conversion metrics** | Your all-time close rate overall and by customer source | Always | Yes |
| **Quick links** | Shortcuts to main pages | Always | Yes |
| **Onboarding** | Setup checklist, tours and guided walkthrough | Always | Yes |
| **Top sold colors** (card title **My top sold colors**) | Your top 3 stones sold this month (*Your best-selling stone colors this month*) | Always | No |
| **Sent emails** | Emails you sent, last 3 months | Company has Emails | No |
| **Sent SMS** | Texts you sent, last 3 months | Company has SMS (CloudTalk or RingCentral) | No |
| **Daily sales** | The whole company's sales today: sales order (signed or not), sales rep, stone color, sinks, package, sale amount and deposit | Always | No |
| **Available inventory** | Stones with slabs in the yard that are not sold, with how many | Always | No |

### Customizing your dashboard

All changes happen in **Edit** mode.

1. Click **Edit** (pencil, top right). It turns into **Done**.
2. The hint **Drag widgets to rearrange · ✕ removes one** appears and an **Add widget** button shows next to **Done**.
3. Make your changes (below). While editing, widgets show their content but you can't click inside them.
4. Click **Done** to leave Edit mode.

Every change is saved to your account right away. There is no separate Save button.

#### Move a widget
- **Mouse:** press anywhere on a card and drag it to a new spot. The other cards slide aside. Each card also has a grip button (**Drag to reorder**) at its top-left corner.
- **Phone or tablet:** press and hold a card until the ring around your finger fills and the card lifts (about a quarter second), then slide it. A quick swipe scrolls the page instead.
- **Keyboard:** Tab to a card's grip, press Space or Enter to pick it up, use the arrow keys to move it, Space or Enter to drop, Escape to cancel.

Some blocks stay in place. The **Leaderboard** is always the first card and can't be dragged. **Unread messages** always sits in the top row. The **Telegram** panel is not a widget. While editing, the leaderboard and Telegram panel are dimmed and their tooltip says **This block stays in place**.

#### Remove a widget
1. In Edit mode, click the **✕** at the top-right corner of the card. The leaderboard has one too. Unread messages becomes a small **Unread messages** chip with its own ✕.
2. A bar at the bottom says **Removed <widget name>** with **Undo**. Click **Undo** to put it back exactly where it was. The bar disappears after about 6 seconds (it waits while your mouse is over it) and when you click **Done**.

#### Add widgets
1. In Edit mode, click **Add widget**.
2. The **Add widget** dialog lists every widget you don't have yet, with a short description. Click as many as you want to tick them.
3. Click **Add widget** (or **Add N widgets**). **Cancel** closes without adding.

New widgets go to the end of the grid. The leaderboard and unread messages always go back to their fixed places. If every widget is already on the page, **Add widget** is greyed out and the dialog says **All widgets are already on this page.**

#### Widget sizes
You can't resize widgets. Widths are set automatically. Onboarding takes the full row, larger widgets take half, and small ones a third. Cards in a row widen to fill it, but a card is never wider than half the page unless it is a full-row widget. On a phone every widget is full width, one under another. On a tablet there are two per row.

#### Empty dashboard
If you removed everything, the page says **No widgets on this page. Turn on Edit to add widgets.** In Edit mode it says **No widgets on this page. Add a widget to get started.**

---

### Unread messages

A yellow **Unread** strip next to the title, with a red count:
- **One unread:** the strip shows it directly. Click it to open that email or text thread.
- **Several:** it shows counts (for example *2 emails · 1 SMS*) and the newest one. Click to open the **Unread messages** list, then click any row to open it.

Emails appear only if your company has Emails. Texts appear only for CloudTalk SMS (RingCentral texts are not listed here). The strip refreshes every minute and when you return to the tab. With nothing unread, it is hidden.

### Telegram panel (connect Telegram)

There are two Telegram bots. The **leads** bot sends lead alerts. The **notifications** bot sends email and deal-activity alerts (text messages are not sent to Telegram, even though the card's text mentions SMS). Until both are linked, the Dashboard shows a **Telegram** panel with a **Connect Telegram** button.

1. Go to **Dashboard** and find the **Telegram** panel (the Onboarding row **Connect Telegram** also takes you there).
2. Click **Connect Telegram** and approve the Telegram login. The first click links the leads bot.
3. The page reloads. If the panel says *Connect the notifications bot…*, click **Connect Telegram** again for the second bot.
4. When both are linked the panel disappears.

On a company web address (yourcompany.…), the button first opens a **Connect Telegram** page on the main site and brings you back afterward. If you later block a bot in Telegram, the panel comes back so you can reconnect. If it says **Telegram linking is not configured**, ask your administrator.

### Quick links

One-click shortcuts: **Deals** (Pipeline and boards), **Emails** (Inbox and threads, only if your company has Emails), **Customers** (Contacts and projects), **Stones** (Inventory catalog), **SMS** (Text threads and flows, only if you can text) and **My Account** (Profile and settings).

### Onboarding widget

A full-width card titled **Onboarding** with progress (**N of M done**, or **All set**). Click the header to fold or unfold it. Your browser remembers this, and it starts folded once everything is done.

- **Your setup:** **Add email name**, **Add email signature** (open My Account), **Connect Telegram** (jumps to the Telegram panel) and **Set up a goal** (for sales reps who aren't admins and only while guided tours are off; it highlights the goal field on the Sales goal widget).
- **Company setup** (admins only): **Add a sales rep**, **Add an installer**, **Log in to the Walk-in form** (shows a reminder to sign in to the Walk-in form on a tablet), **Add logo**, **Add sales tax**, **Connect QuickBooks** (tagged **Optional**, shown only if QuickBooks is available to your company; it never holds back **All set**) and **Add supplier price lists**. Each row opens the right Admin page.
- **Tours** (only when your company's guided tours are on): every guided tour you can take, with points (**+N points**, then **Earned N** or **Done**). Click a row to start the tour. A revised tour shows **Updated**. While tours are on, **Your setup** rows also earn points, and **Company setup** shows *Shared by your admins, no points*.
- **Guided walkthrough · N of M:** a folded list of step-by-step walkthroughs for each area (grouped **Employee**, **Admin**, **Company** for admins and managers). Click one to start it. During a walkthrough, press Enter to go to the next step. **Restart** resets the walkthrough progress.

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **I don't see Dashboard in the sidebar.** You are in the Admin view. Switch to **Employee**. Portal accounts (shop, installer, marketing, walk-in) don't have a dashboard.
- **How do I get a removed widget back?** Click **Undo** right away. Later, use **Edit → Add widget** and tick it.
- **The Add widget button is grey.** All available widgets are already on your page.
- **I can't click anything inside a widget.** You're in Edit mode. Click **Done**.
- **I can't drag on my phone.** Press and hold the card until it lifts, then slide.
- **I can't drag the Leaderboard or Unread.** They have fixed places. You can only remove them.
- **Can I make a widget bigger?** No. Sizes are automatic.
- **Leaderboard missing and not in Add widget.** Your company's Leaderboard feature is off.
- **Call coach missing.** You need both a CloudTalk agent ID and a CloudTalk phone number on **My Account**.
- **Sent emails / Sent SMS not offered.** Your company doesn't have Emails, or doesn't have SMS.
- **Unread strip doesn't show my texts.** Only CloudTalk SMS is listed. RingCentral texts are not.
- **Where do I connect Telegram?** On the Dashboard's **Telegram** panel (not on My Account). If the panel isn't there, both bots are already connected.
- **Does my layout follow me to another computer?** Yes, it is saved to your account.

## Employee Deals — Activities, notes & history

Every deal has an **activity panel** with your tasks (activities), notes, and the full history of calls, texts, emails, quotes and contracts with the customer.

**Where to find it:** **CRM > Deals** → click the customer name on a card → the right side of the **Edit Deal** window (on a phone, below the tabs). It has **Activity** and **Notes** tabs at the top, then **To Do** and **History**. **History** is part of this panel, not a tab on the left.

**Who can use it:** anyone who can open the deal, including admins from **Admin > CRM > Deals**. You can also add an activity or note from a customer's **Customer Information** window (see the end of this section).

---

### Activities (tasks)

#### Add an activity

1. Click the **Activity** tab.
2. Type the task in **Activity name**. A list of **your most used activities** (names you've used before) opens. Click one to use it, or pick it with the arrow keys and **Enter**. **Show more** lists more. The **X** next to a suggestion (**Remove suggestion**) stops suggesting it for good.
3. Optional: click **Deadline** and pick a day.
   - **Add time** sets a time (the **Deadline time** box; otherwise the deadline is just a date).
   - **Clear deadline** removes it.
4. Click **Add Activity** (or press **Ctrl+Enter** / **Cmd+Enter**).

The message **Activity created** ("… added to To Do") appears, and the task shows under **To Do**. Text you typed but didn't save is kept as a draft for that deal.

There is no priority picker. New activities get **Medium** priority.

#### The To Do list

**To Do (n)** lists open activities, by priority (High, Medium, Low) and then by earliest deadline. Each one shows:

- A checkbox to complete it
- The name (click it to edit)
- The deadline: **Overdue** / **3d overdue**, **Today 2:00 PM**, **Tomorrow**, or a date. Overdue and today's tasks get a colored border.
- When it was created, and **By …** when someone else created it
- On hover: **pencil** (**Edit activity**) and **trash** (delete)

The board card shows the activity due first and its deadline. Clicking that activity on the card opens the deal with the activity ready to edit.

#### Edit, complete, reopen, delete

- **Edit:** click the name or the pencil. The form shows **Editing: …**. Change the name or deadline and click **Save Changes**. The message **Activity updated** appears. The **X** or **Esc** cancels.
- **Complete:** tick the checkbox. The message **Activity completed** appears ("… marked as done"), and the task moves to **History** with a **Done** badge and the time it was done.
- **Reopen:** untick a done activity in **History**. The message **Activity reactivated** appears ("… moved to To Do").
- **Delete:** trash → **Delete Activity** ("Are you sure you want to delete "…"?") → **Delete**. The message **Activity deleted** appears.

#### Who gets notified

When an activity is added, edited or deleted, the deal's owner and the customer's sales rep get a notification in the app, and on Telegram if they connected it. A deadline **with a time** also sends the deal owner a reminder at that time.

---

### Notes

Notes stay with the **deal**. Use them for reminders, handoff details, prices discussed, stone choice, square footage or billing details. Deals have no separate fields for these.

#### Add a note

1. Click the **Notes** tab (next to **Activity**).
2. Type in **Write a note...** (up to 5000 characters).
3. Click **Add Note** (or press **Ctrl+Enter** / **Cmd+Enter**).

The message **Note added** ("Your note has been added") appears, the box clears, and the panel scrolls to **History** so you can see the note. The deal's people are notified. A note icon appears on the board card. Hover it there to read the notes.

#### Work with a note

Notes show in **History** under **All** and **Notes**. Each note shows a **Note** or **Pinned** badge, the text, the time, and **By …** when someone else wrote it. Hover a note to see the buttons:

- **Pencil** (**Edit note**): change the text, then **Save** (or **Ctrl+Enter**). **Cancel** (or **Esc**) keeps the old text. The message **Note updated** appears.
- **Pin** (**Pin note** / **Unpin note**): pinned notes go to the top with an amber background.
- **Trash:** **Delete Note** ("Are you sure you want to delete this note?") → **Delete**. The message **Note deleted** appears.
- **Add a comment:** type in **Write a comment...** (up to 2000 characters), then **Add** or **Enter**. Comments appear under the note. Delete one with its trash icon → **Delete Comment**. Comments written by admins show the admin's name and notify the deal's people.

---

### History

**History (n)** sits under **To Do**. Click its header to fold or unfold it. Use the buttons to filter:

| Filter | What it shows |
|--------|---------------|
| **All** | Everything, by date, including quote and contract events: **Quote sent**, **Quote printed**, **Contract sent**, **Contract signed** (with recipients, form or signer, and who did it). Click a quote event to open the quote. |
| **Activities (n)** | Completed activities |
| **Notes (n)** | Notes, pinned first, then newest |
| **Actions (n)** | Phone calls for this deal (CloudTalk or RingCentral): **Outgoing** or **Incoming**, with the duration or the call result |
| **SMS (n)** | Texts with the customer, with photos and files. Shown only when the company uses CloudTalk or RingCentral. Click a text to open the conversation. |
| **Emails (n)** | Emails of this deal. Click one to open the conversation inside the deal. Icons show attachments and unread mail. |

Empty filters say **No notes yet**, **No actions yet**, **No SMS yet**, **No emails yet**, **No history yet** or **No completed activities**.

**Emails with this customer outside the deal:** when the customer has other emails, use **Show all emails with this customer**. **Show only this deal** goes back.

**Recorded calls** (in **Actions** and **All**):

- **Add note** saves an AI summary of the call as a note ("Call summary saved as a note").
- **Add Activity** creates follow-up activities from what was said on the call.
- The **⋮** menu has **Voice call** (play the recording) and **Transcribe** (then **Show text** / **Hide text**).
- On a phone, **Add note** and **Add Activity** are in the **⋮** menu too.

History refreshes by itself when texts, emails or calls come in, and when you close an email or text conversation.

---

### From the Customer Information window

In **CRM > Customers**, click a customer to open **Customer Information**. Under **Deals**, each deal card has:

- **Add Activity:** type an **Activity name...**, optionally pick a **Deadline** (*Optional*, date only), then click the green checkmark (or press **Enter**). The **X** cancels. The message **Activity added** ("Activity has been added to the deal") appears.
- **Add Note:** type in **Write a note...**, then click the green checkmark (or press **Enter**). The message **Note added** ("Note has been added to the deal") appears.

These save on that deal and show in the deal's activity panel. The **Activity** section of **Customer Information** shows this customer's history across all their deals (activities, notes, calls, texts, emails). It is read-only: you can't edit, pin or delete there.

---

### Common questions

- **How do I add a note to a deal?** Open the deal → **Notes** tab in the activity panel → **Write a note...** → **Add Note**.
- **How do I set a reminder?** Add an activity with a **Deadline** and **Add time**. The deal owner gets a reminder at that time.
- **Can I set an activity's priority?** No. New activities are always **Medium**.
- **Where do completed tasks go?** **History** → **Activities**. Untick one to put it back in **To Do**.
- **Why is there no SMS filter?** The company doesn't use CloudTalk or RingCentral.
- **Why don't I see calls?** Calls show when they were made through CloudTalk or RingCentral and are linked to this deal.

## Employee Deals (Deal Board & Pipeline)

The deal board is your sales pipeline: every deal is a card in a column (stage). Move cards between stages, add deals, change amounts and activity deadlines right on the card, and open a deal to work on it.

**Where to find it:** Employee portal → sidebar **CRM > Deals**.

**Who sees it:** every user with Employee access to the CRM (for example **Sales Rep**, **Sales Manager**, **Office Manager**). Admins have a company-wide, read-only board at **Admin > CRM > Deals** (see Admin Deals).

**Whose deals are on it:** only deals that belong to **you**. A deal belongs to the customer's **sales rep**. When a customer gets a new sales rep, all of that customer's deals move to the new rep's board. A customer with no sales rep belongs to whoever created the deal.

Related sections: **Employee Deals — Deal window** (the tabs inside a deal) and **Employee Deals — Activities, notes & history** (tasks, notes, calls, texts, emails).

---

### Toolbar

| Control | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| **Group** | Picks which pipeline (group) you see. Each group has its own columns. In the open list, a red alert icon next to a group name means at least one of your deals in that group has an unfinished activity whose deadline day has passed. |
| **Status** | **Active Deals** (open deals), **Won**, or **Lost**. |
| **Add Deal** | Opens **Create Deal**. On a phone: tap **⋮** → **Add New Deal**. |
| **Find Customer** | Search box (placeholder **Find customer or company**) to jump to a customer's deal card. |

Your group and status choice stay in the address bar, so refreshing or sharing the link keeps the same view. Only groups the admin set to **Visible** appear in **Group**.

---

### Columns (stages)

Each column is a stage, such as *New Customer* or *Quoted*. The black header shows the stage name and how many cards are in it. Admins set up groups and stages under **Admin > CRM > Deals > Menu > Manage Lists**. Employees cannot add, rename or delete stages.

On a phone, swipe sideways to move from column to column.

#### How cards are sorted in a column

Sorting is automatic. You cannot reorder cards by hand inside a column.

1. Cards **without** an open activity come first, newest deal on top.
2. Then cards **with** an open activity, soonest deadline first. On the same day, an activity with a time comes before one without a time.

---

### What a deal card shows

- **Colored dot** before the name: the customer's temperature (**Hot** red-orange, **Medium** yellow, **Cold** blue). No dot means no rating. Set it on the deal's **Project** tab.
- **Customer name** (and **company name** below it when set). Click it to open the deal.
- **Title**: optional gray text under the name. Teams often put a job-site address or a short label here.
- **Amount: $ …**: click to edit it on the card.
- **Next activity**: the open activity due first. Click it to open the deal with that activity ready to edit. Long text has **show more** / **show less**. If the deal has no open activity, the card says *No upcoming activities*.
- **Deadline** of that activity:
  - Red pill **Overdue** or **3d overdue**.
  - Orange pill **Today** (with the time, if set).
  - Gray text **Tomorrow** or a date such as *Oct 22*.
  - **No deadline** when the activity has none.
- **Lost reason**: on lost deals.
- **Icons** at the bottom right:
  - **Envelope**: there are emails with this customer. Opens the deal.
  - **Paperclip**: the deal has photos. Opens the **Files** tab.
  - **List icon**: the deal has two or more open activities. Hover it to see them with their priority and due date. Click it to open the deal.
  - **Note icon**: the deal has notes. Hover it to read them (pinned first, with author, time and number of replies). Click it to open the deal.
  - **Lightning bolt**: an automated follow-up flow is running (or paused) for this customer. Click it to open the text conversation.

Won and lost cards don't show the next activity or its deadline.

---

### Find Customer

1. Type in **Find customer or company**: a name, a company name, a phone number (4 or more digits) or an email (anything with **@**).
2. The search looks at your own customers and at customers with no sales rep. Results show the company, emails and phones. **Show more** loads 5 more results. **Enter** picks the first result.
3. Click a customer's name. The board scrolls to that deal card and highlights it with a blue ring. If the deal is in another group or under Won/Lost, the board switches the **Group** and **Status** for you first.

Buttons next to each result:

- **Edit** (pencil): opens the deal on its **General** tab.
- **Delete** (trash): opens **Delete Deal**. This deletes the **deal**, not the customer.
- **No Deals**: the customer has no deal you can open from here.

---

### Moving a deal to another stage (drag and drop)

1. On a computer, press on an empty part of the card (not the name or the amount) and drag it to another column.
2. On a phone or tablet, press and hold the card for a moment, then drag. Drag near the screen edge to slide to the next column.
3. Drop it on the column. The card moves at once.

What happens when you drop a card:

- The stage change is saved and recorded in the deal's stage history (the progress bar inside the deal).
- If the deal was **Won** or **Lost**, it becomes active again and its lost reason is cleared.
- If an admin attached automatic emails or texts to that stage (**Admin > CRM > Automations**, trigger list), they are scheduled for customers whose source is **Leads**. Unsent ones from the old stage are cancelled.
- If the save fails (for example a weak connection), a **Move not saved** message appears ("Connection problem — the board was restored. Please try again.") and the card goes back.

You can only drag between columns of the group on screen. To move a deal to another group, open it and use the **Group** dropdown on its **Project** tab.

---

### Adding a deal

1. Click **Add Deal** (phone: **⋮** → **Add New Deal**). **Create Deal** opens.
2. **Customer** (required): choose **Search by** (**name**, **phone**, **email** or **company**), start typing in **Start typing customer…**, then pick from **Suggestions**. The **X** clears the choice.
   - No match? Click **Add Customer** to create the customer right there. The name you typed is filled in. Save it and the new customer is selected.
   - Once a customer is picked, the button changes to **Edit Customer**. A red alert icon (**Missing customer info**) means the customer has no email, no phone or no address.
3. **Amount** (optional): the dollar value (placeholder **Amount of the deal**). It must be 0 or more.
4. **Title** (optional): text shown under the name on the card (placeholder **Title of the deal**).
5. Click **Create**. The message **Deal added successfully** appears.

What happens:

- The deal goes into the **first column** of the group on screen.
- **One open deal per customer.** If the customer already has an open deal, no second deal is made. That deal moves into this column instead, and the amount and title you typed replace the old ones (empty fields keep the old values).
- The deal belongs to the customer's sales rep. If that rep is someone else, the deal shows on **their** board, not yours.
- If the customer has no sales rep and you hold the **Sales Rep** position, you become their sales rep.
- If the board is showing **Won** or **Lost** when you click **Add Deal**, the new deal is created as won or lost.

---

### Quick edits on the card

- **Amount:** click the **$** amount, type a new value, then press **Enter** or click away. Leave it empty to clear it.
- **Activity deadline:** click the deadline (or **No deadline**), then pick a day in the calendar. This changes the next open activity's deadline. A deadline set here has no time.

---

### Opening a deal

Click the customer name on a card. The **Edit Deal** window opens over the board, with tabs on the left (**Project**, **General**, **Files**, **Quotes**) and the activity panel on the right. See **Employee Deals — Deal window**. Close it with **X**, **Esc** or a click outside, and you are back on the board with the same filters.

---

### Won, Lost and back to active

Open the deal → **Project** tab:

- **Won**: marks the deal won. A deal still in its pipeline's first stage (e.g. **Not Contacted Yet**) moves to the next stage (e.g. **Contacted**); the same happens when a deal is added as won or a quote is sold.
- **Lost**: opens **Closed Lost**. Pick a **Lost reason** (required: *Reason is required*):
  - Too expensive
  - Out of area
  - Never responded
  - Wrong number, email, etc.
  - Accident submission
  - Looking for unrelated service
  - Bought somewhere else
  - Stopped responding
  - Gave up on the project
  - **Other** (type your own reason)

  Click **Submit**. The message **Deal marked as lost** appears. **Cancel** closes the dialog without changes and highlights the card on the board.
- **Move to Active**: reopens a won or lost deal in its stage.

After **Won** or **Move to Active**, the message **Deal status updated successfully** appears and you go back to the board. Switch **Status** to **Won** or **Lost** to find closed deals. A closed deal's window shows **Won**, or **Lost · Reason: …**, above the progress bar.

---

### Deleting a deal

1. Open the deal → **General** tab → **Delete**. (Or use the trash icon in **Find Customer**.)
2. **Delete Deal**: "Are you sure you want to delete this deal?" Click **Confirm**.

The message **Deal deleted** appears. The deal disappears from every view (active, won, lost), and the customer's **History** records "Deal deleted by …". The customer stays. There is no undo in the app.

---

### Common questions

- **How do I reopen a won or lost deal?** Switch **Status** to **Won** or **Lost** to find it, open the deal → **Project** tab → **Move to Active**.
- **Can I drag a deal to Won or Lost?** No. **Won** and **Lost** are statuses, not columns: open the deal → **Project** tab → **Won** (or **Lost**).
- **I added a deal but it isn't on my board.** It went to the customer's sales rep's board. Or the customer already had an open deal, which moved to the first column of the group on screen. Also check **Group** and **Status**.
- **A deal disappeared.** It may have been won or lost (check **Status**), deleted, moved to another group, or its customer got a different sales rep. Deals in a stage or group an admin deleted no longer show on the board. Marking a customer **Invalid** also removes their deals.
- **Why is a group marked with a red icon?** One of your deals there has an overdue activity (*Overdue activity in this group*). Open that group and complete or reschedule it.
- **Can I reorder cards inside a column?** No. Cards sort by next activity deadline.
- **Can I rename a column?** No one can rename columns. Admins can add, delete and reorder them in **Manage Lists**.
- **Why can't I drag on the admin board?** The admin board is read-only. Use **CRM > Deals** in the Employee portal.
- **Where do I add a task or note?** Inside the deal, in the activity panel on the right. See **Employee Deals — Activities, notes & history**.

## Employee Deals — Deal window (Edit Deal)

When you click a customer's name on a deal card, the **Edit Deal** window opens over the board. Here you see the customer's details, change the deal, schedule an estimate, upload files, see quotes, and work tasks and notes.

**Where to find it:** **CRM > Deals** → click the customer name on a card. It also opens from **Find Customer** (pencil), from the card's activity, envelope, paperclip and note icons, and from **Go to Deal** in an email conversation.

**Who can use it:** anyone who can open the deal board. Admins open the same window from **Admin > CRM > Deals** with fewer buttons on the **Project** tab (see Admin Deals).

---

### Layout

**Top of the window**

- Title **Edit Deal** and a close button (**X**). **Esc** or a click outside also closes it.
- On a closed deal, a line above the progress bar shows **Won**, or **Lost · Reason: …**.
- **Progress bar:** one segment per stage of the deal's group, in board order. Stages up to the current one are green and show how long the deal spent there. Stages after it are gray (**0 days**). Stage names are listed below the bar, with the current stage in bold green.

**Left side: tabs**

| Tab | What it's for |
|-----|---------------|
| **Project** | Win/lose/reopen, **Schedule an Estimate**, change group, the customer's details with call, text, email and map buttons |
| **General** | The deal's customer, **Amount** and **Title**; **Save** and **Delete** |
| **Files** | Photos and documents of the deal. The badge shows how many. |
| **Quotes** | The customer's quotes. The badge shows how many. |

**Right side: activity panel**

**Activity** and **Notes** tabs at the top, then **To Do** and **History**. **History** is part of the activity panel, not a tab on the left. See **Employee Deals — Activities, notes & history**.

On a phone, the activity panel appears below the tabs.

**Questionnaire:** the deal's **Questionnaire** tab is not shown at the moment. **Quotes** took its place. When its page opens, it says *Fill out discovery questions for this customer.*:

- **Questionnaire** picks which one to fill out (shown when there are two or more). The **Default** button next to one (*Set as default questionnaire*) makes it the one that opens first for you.
- Type each answer under its question, then click **Save answers** (*Answers saved.*), or **Create note**, which saves them and also adds them to the deal as a note (*Note created and answers saved.*). Leaving with unsaved answers asks **Leave without saving?** (**Stay** / **Leave**).
- **Manage Questionnaire** opens **Manage Questionnaires** with your own questionnaires. **Add Questionnaire** takes a **Name** and the questions (**Add question** adds a box; its trash, **Remove question**, deletes one) → **Create Questionnaire**. **Back** returns to the list.
- A sample deal has none (*Sample deal has no questionnaires.*). With none set up it says *No questionnaires have been set up yet. Ask an admin to create one under Deals → Menu → Manage Questionnaires.*

---

### Project tab

#### Buttons at the top

- **Move to Active**, **Won**, **Lost**: only the ones that apply are shown. **Lost** asks for a reason (**Closed Lost** dialog). After a change you go back to the board. If the company has **Sale on a win** turned on (**Admin > CRM > Automations**) and the deal has no sale yet, **Won** first opens the **Sell Slab** form, filled in from the deal's sold quote. You go back to the board once you submit or close it. See **Won, Lost and back to active** in Employee Deals (Deal Board & Pipeline).
- **Schedule an Estimate**: books an in-home estimate (see below).
- **Group** (dropdown on the right): moves the deal to the **first stage** of another group (pipeline). A won or lost deal becomes active again. The message **Group updated successfully** appears and you go back to the board.

#### Customer details

A table lists the customer's details. Only filled-in rows appear:

- **Contact:** **Name**, **Email** (every address), **Phone**, **Phone 2**, **Address**, **City**, **State**, **Postal Code**, **Company Name**
- **Lead form answers:** **Remodal Type**, **Project Size**, **Contact Time**, **Tear Out**, **Improve Offer**, **Sink**, **When Start**, **Details**, **Backsplash**, **Kitchen Stove**
- **Ad details:** **Compaign Name**, **Adset Name**, **Ad Name**
- **Other:** **Your Message** (the **Notes** typed in the customer form), **Qbo Id** (QuickBooks), **Notes**, **Source**, **Deal Created**, **Customer Created**

You can't type in this table. To change a detail, go to the **General** tab → **Edit Customer**, or to **CRM > Customers** → **Edit**. Both change the customer record everywhere.

Buttons beside the details:

- **Name**
  - The dot before the name is the customer's **temperature**. Click it (**Customer temperature**) and choose **Hot**, **Medium** or **Cold**, or **Remove rating**. The dot also shows on the deal card.
  - **Automated Follow-up** starts or manages an automatic text/email follow-up flow for this customer. The button turns yellow while a flow is running. It shows only when the company uses CloudTalk or RingCentral and **My Account** has your full phone line (CloudTalk agent ID and phone number, or RingCentral extension and phone number).
  - On a phone, **Add to contacts** saves the customer as a phone contact. It shows only if you have no CloudTalk or RingCentral line.
- **Phone / Phone 2**
  - Copy the number.
  - **SMS** opens the text conversation inside the deal. It shows only if you have a texting line (CloudTalk agent ID or RingCentral extension). It is greyed out with "No valid phone number on file" when the number isn't a valid 10-digit number.
  - The **phone icon** calls the customer:
    - **Call with RingCentral** if the company uses RingCentral and you have a RingCentral line.
    - Otherwise **Copy number and open CloudTalk phone** if you have a CloudTalk agent ID (not on iPhone/iPad).
    - Otherwise your device's own dialer.
  - When automated follow-ups aren't available to you, a **lightning bolt** appears ("Connect CloudTalk to use automated messaging" or "Connect RingCentral…"). Click it, then **Open My Account** to add your line.
- **Email** (each address)
  - Copy the address.
  - The **envelope** opens a new email to that address inside the deal.
  - When text follow-ups aren't available to you, a **lightning bolt** (**Follow-up flow**) starts an email follow-up flow. It turns yellow while one runs (*Follow-up flow running*, *Follow-up running for this customer*) and can't be clicked when the customer has no email (*No email address on file*).
- **Address / City**: copy, and **Map** opens driving directions in Google Maps.
- **Attached File** (bottom): a file the lead sent with the web form. Pictures show in the tab (click to enlarge). Other files show as a link.

#### Email and text conversations inside the deal

The envelope, the **SMS** button, and email or text rows in **History** open the conversation over the deal. A customer panel on the left shows Company, Email, Phone, Address (with map), Source, Deal Created, Customer Created and Notes. Close the conversation to return to the **Project** tab. The deal's History refreshes with anything you sent. For writing emails and texts, see the **Emails** and **SMS** sections.

#### Schedule an Estimate

1. **Project** tab → **Schedule an Estimate**.
2. Check the customer box: name, email and phones, and address (with an **Open in Google Maps** button). A red line warns when the customer has no phone or email.
3. Set **Starts** and **Ends**. The default is tomorrow 12:00–1:00 PM. While "Checking the conversation for an agreed time…" shows, the app reads recent texts and emails. If a time was agreed, it fills it in and shows "Time from the conversation: "…". Check it before submitting." Changing **Starts** moves **Ends** to one hour later.
   - Beside the times, the chosen day on the **Estimates** calendar is listed like the Schedule's day view: one row per booking with its color bar, title, the person who created it and its time (*All day* ones on top), and your new estimate in place, marked **New**. The header says *Nothing booked yet* or *N already booked*; **Overlaps N** warns when it clashes with N bookings, and each clashing row says **Overlaps**. It follows the date and time you pick.
4. Click **Submit** (or **Cancel**).

What happens:

- The estimate is added to the **Estimates** calendar in **Schedule**, linked to the customer and the deal.
- The customer gets a confirmation by **text** from the office manager's line, or by **email** from their sales rep when a text isn't possible.
- Reminders are scheduled for the customer and the sales rep.
- The message **Estimate scheduled** says whether the customer was notified by text or email. "The estimate was saved, but we could not send a confirmation by text or email" means it was saved without a confirmation.

**Schedule an Estimate** is greyed out when the company has no **Estimates** calendar. **Submit** is greyed out until the customer has a phone or email (*Contact info required: Add a phone number or email to the customer before scheduling an estimate.*). Other messages: *Estimates calendar unavailable* (the company's Estimates calendar can't be found) and *Customer unavailable* (the deal's customer can't be found).

---

### General tab

| Field | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| **Customer** | Required. Shows the deal's customer (read-only). The **X** clears it, so you can search for another customer (**Search by**: **name**, **phone**, **email**, **company**). Picking another customer moves the deal to that customer. **Edit Customer** opens the customer form (name, emails, phones, address, source, sales rep, company, notes). A red alert icon (**Missing customer info**) means the email, phone or address is missing. |
| **Amount** | Optional. The deal value shown on the card (**Amount of the deal**). |
| **Title** | Optional. Text shown under the customer name on the card (**Title of the deal**). |

- **Save**: the message **Deal updated successfully** appears.
- **Delete**: opens **Delete Deal** → **Confirm**.

#### Showing an address on the board card

Deals have no address field of their own.

1. Open the deal → **General** tab.
2. Type the address or site label in **Title**.
3. Click **Save**.

It now shows under the customer name on the card. The customer's real address lives on the customer record. It appears on the **Project** tab with copy and map buttons. Change it with **Edit Customer** or in **CRM > Customers**.

#### Deal value, invoice amounts, stone and square footage

Deals have no invoice-amount, stone or square-footage fields.

- **One number on the card:** use **Amount** (here or on the card).
- **More detail** (invoiced amounts, stone name, square footage): add a **note** in the activity panel. A short label such as "Misterio 45 sqft" can go in **Title**.
- **Pricing the job:** build a quote. Quotes for this customer appear on the **Quotes** tab.
- **QuickBooks invoices:** when the company has QuickBooks connected, they are in the **QuickBooks** section of the customer's **Customer Information** window (**CRM > Customers**).

### Files tab

**Upload**

1. Drop files on the box **Drop files here, or click to browse** (*Images, PDFs, and documents*), or click it to pick files. You can choose several at once.
2. The files upload right away. PDF, Word, Excel, CSV and text files go under **Documents**. Pictures (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, HEIC) go under **Images**.
3. A message such as **Image added successfully**, **2 documents added successfully** or **3 files added successfully** appears.

If the type isn't allowed, **Failed to save files** says "That file type is not supported…".

**Images**

- Click a thumbnail to see it large.
- The **X** (**Delete image**) asks **Delete Image** → **Delete**.

**Documents**

- Click a document to open it in a new tab.
- The **pencil** (**Edit name**) lets you rename it: type a name (up to 255 characters), then **Save** or **Cancel**. Some older documents have no pencil and can't be renamed.
- The **X** (**Delete document**) asks **Delete Document** → **Delete**.

Deleting can't be undone. The message **File deleted successfully** appears. The paperclip on the board card shows when the deal has photos. A file attached to an email from the customer can be added to the deal from the email conversation (**Add the file to the deal**).

---

### Quotes tab

Lists **this customer's quotes** (all of them, not only ones made from this deal):

- Quote name (or **Untitled quote**)
- **Rev 1**, **Rev 2**… or **Draft**
- A green check when the quote was sold
- Date · sales rep · price list

Click a quote to open it in the quote editor. **No quotes yet.** means the customer has none. Creating and editing quotes is covered in the Quotes section.

### Common questions

- **Where do I see the emails and texts with this customer inside the deal?** Click an email or text row in **History** (or the envelope / **SMS** button on the **Project** tab): the conversation opens over the deal.
- **Where are the Images and Documents tabs?** Both are on the **Files** tab now (sections **Images** and **Documents**).
- **Where is the Questionnaire tab?** It isn't shown at the moment. **Quotes** took its place.
- **Why is there no SMS or call button?** **SMS** needs a CloudTalk agent ID or RingCentral extension in **My Account**. Calls in the app need a RingCentral line or a CloudTalk agent ID. Otherwise the phone icon uses your device's dialer.
- **Why is Schedule an Estimate greyed out?** The company has no **Estimates** calendar. Or, for **Submit**, the customer has no phone or email.
- **Can I edit the customer's phone or address from the deal?** Yes: **General** → **Edit Customer**. It changes the customer record.
- **Where do I add a task or note?** In the activity panel on the right (**Activity** / **Notes** tabs).

## Emails — Conversations & Replying

How to read an email conversation and answer it: **Reply**, **Reply all**, **Forward**, the AI tools (**Generate with AI**, **AI reply**, **Improve message**, typing suggestions), templates, attachments, **Send later**, read receipts and saving attachments to a deal. The mailbox itself (folders, search, Trash, **Send Email**) is in **Emails — Mailbox & Send Email**.

**Where conversations open:**

- **CRM > Emails** → click a row. The conversation opens in a window over the mailbox.
- A deal's **Project** tab → the **envelope** next to a customer email starts a new conversation inside the deal; email rows in the deal **History** open existing ones.
- Email rows in a customer's history (**CRM > Customers**).
- An email notification in the bell.

**Who can reply:** anyone in the Employee portal. In **Admin > CRM > Emails** conversations are view-only (no reply box, and opening them does not mark them read).

---

### Reading a conversation

**Header:**

- The customer's name and email address. Click either to copy it.
- **Go to Deal** (tooltip **Open customer deal**): opens the customer's deal. With several deals, pick one in **Choose a deal**. Messages you may see: **No deal found** — *There is no open deal for this customer.*, **Cannot open deal**.
- A lightning button (**Follow-up flow**) next to the email address in companies without CloudTalk, when the conversation is linked to a customer. It starts an automatic email follow-up (see **Follow-up flows** in the SMS or Automations sections).

**Messages:**

- Customer messages are gray on the left; yours are blue on the right. Days are separated by a date line; each message shows its time.
- When more than two people are in the thread, each message has a small *To / Cc* summary line. Click it to see **from**, **to**, **cc**, **bcc**, **date** and **subject**.
- Your messages that carried a signature show a small **Signature** tag. Hover it to see the signature.
- Emoji reactions the customer added in Gmail show under the message.
- On a computer, **Read** next to your latest opened message means the customer opened it. Hover **Read** to see *Opened N times* and each open time (*Not opened yet* if none).
- Pictures show as thumbnails. Click one to view it full screen and flip through all pictures in the thread. Other files open in a new tab.
- A picture you attach to your own reply can be marked up before sending: click its thumbnail to open **Edit image** (brush, line, arrow, rectangle, ellipse, text, crop; see *Edit image* in the SMS section).
- A message that quotes the earlier email has **Show reply** (shows the quoted part; **Hide reply** folds it again).

Opening a conversation marks the customer's messages as read (employees only).

### Reply, Reply all, Forward

On a computer, hover a message: small buttons appear under it — **Reply**, **Reply all** (only when other people besides the customer are on the thread), **Forward**, **Mark as unread** and **Delete**. On a phone, tap the message (not a link) to get the same list.

1. Click **Reply**, **Reply all** or **Forward**. Text you already typed stays.
2. The recipients line above the text box fills in. Click it (or **Add recipients**) to edit **To**, **Cc** and **Bcc**. When **To** has 2+ addresses, **Send as one email (Reply All)** appears — *On: everyone in To sees each other. Off: separate emails to each recipient.*
3. A chip (**Reply**, **Reply all** or **Forwarding**) shows the mode. Click its **X** to go back to a normal reply to the customer.
4. **Forward** opens the recipients box so you can add someone (company staff are suggested too). *Forwarding original message* lists the original attachments; remove any with its **X**. The text box says *Add a note, or send as-is…*. Toast after sending: **Forwarded**.

A plain reply simply goes to the customer: type in **Send a message** (phones: **Type a reply…**; after **Reply**: *Write your reply…*; after **Forward**: *Add a note, or send as-is…*) and send.

---

### Sending

- Click **Send** (paper plane) or press **Ctrl/Cmd + Enter**.
- A normal reply appears in the conversation at once and finishes sending in the background. Toast: **Success — Email sent!**
- **Undo send:** for 10 seconds after **Send**, a card *Sending… 10s* counts down (bottom left on a computer, above the box on a phone). **Undo** takes the email back and puts it in the box again; the arrow (**Send now**) sends it at once. Leaving the conversation also sends it at once. A scheduled email (**Send later**) has no undo card.
- If it fails: **Email not sent** — the message is taken back out; if your box is still empty it is put back so you can press **Send** again.
- Blocked sends: unfilled `{{placeholders}}` (**Placeholders detected** — *Please replace all {{placeholders}} with actual values before sending*), a template name variable for a customer with no name (**Customer has no name**), a failed attachment (**Attachment upload failed** — *… did not upload. Remove it and attach it again.*).
- Your **Email Signature** and a short opt-out line are added automatically.
- Typed but unsent replies are kept as a draft in this browser and show a red **Draft** label in the Inbox.

#### Improve message offer

Until you have tried **Improve message** once, pressing **Send** may first show a tip, **Improve this message**, pointing at the **Improve message** button. Click it to polish the text, or choose **Send without Improve** to send as is. On phones the tip opens the composer's **⋮** (**More actions**) menu and points at **Improve message** there.

### AI tools in the composer

**On a computer** the bar above the text box has: **Generate with AI** (new conversation only), **AI reply**, **✦** (**Improve message**), the paperclip (**Attach files**) and the template icon (**Templates**).

**On a phone** these are in the **⋮** (**More actions**) menu at the left of the text box: **Generate with AI** (new conversation only), **AI reply**, **Upload from computer**, **Request signature** (when available), **From Stones**, **From Images**, **From Documents**, **Use Template**, **Improve message**. **Improve message** is only in this menu on phones, never next to **Send**.

| Tool | What it does |
|------|--------------|
| **Generate with AI** | Only in a conversation with no messages yet (for example a new email from a deal). Writes a first-contact subject and body for this customer (*Generating your message*). |
| **AI reply** | Opens the **AI reply** dialog: **Fast reply** (*Short reply to what they just said*), **Follow up** (*Check in and keep the conversation moving*) or **Custom** (*Tell AI exactly what to write*, then **Generate**). Tick **Use instructions** to include company instructions. The draft opens in **Review AI reply**: edit it, type a change (*e.g. shorter…*) and click **Update draft**, or **Paste into input**. **Back** returns to the choices. |
| **✦ Improve message** | Rewrites your draft for clarity and tone (*Improving your message…*; an AI reply in progress shows *Writing a reply*). Select part of the text first to improve only that part. |
| Typing suggestions | While you type, AI may show the rest of a sentence in gray. Press **Tab**, or click the small **Tab** chip at its end (*Add suggestion (Tab)*), to accept (phones: tap the suggestion strip, **Tap to add**, or swipe right across the message box). Typing phrases like "our inventory" or "inventory link" offers **Insert inventory link** (your public stone catalog link). Typing "measurements" or "online quote" offers **Insert quote link** (the customer quote page, where the customer sends you their sizes). **X** dismisses a suggestion. |

AI reply needs the conversation to be linked to a customer or have the customer's email.

### Templates in a conversation

1. Click the template icon (**Templates**; phones: **⋮** → **Use Template**). **Choose Template** opens.
2. Search (**Search templates...**) and click a template. Hover a template to preview it.
3. If the box already has text, confirm **Replace message** — *This will replace your current message with the template. Continue?* → **Replace**.
4. The template's text and files replace what was in the composer. Its subject is used only if the conversation has no subject yet. Customer and your own details fill in automatically.

- Templates tagged **Company** are made by admins (**Admin > CRM > Automations**) and can't be edited here.

- The list puts recently used templates first. Drag the handle to set your own order; **Reset to Automatic Order** undoes that.
- Variables: customer first/last/full name, email, phone, address and inventory page; your first/last/full name, email and phone number; company name, address and hours of operation; current day and month; deal name and deal amount (only when sending from a deal). A yellow box lists anything still to replace (**Action required** or *This customer has no name in our system.*).
- Custom placeholders typed as `{{something}}` must be replaced by hand before sending (**Custom variables detected**).

- **Can I schedule a new email?** **Send later** (the clock next to **Send**) is in a conversation's reply box. The **Send Email** window for a new email has no clock: it sends right away.

## Emails — Mailbox & Send Email

**Emails** is the CRM's mailbox: read customer emails, keep conversations organized (read/unread, Trash, Drafts) and send new emails from your company address. Replying inside a conversation (Reply, Reply all, Forward, AI tools, templates, attachments, Send later) is covered in **Emails — Conversations & Replying**.

**Where to find it:**

- Employee view: sidebar **CRM > Emails**.
- Admin view: switch to **Admin**, then sidebar **CRM > Emails** (the whole company's mail, see below).

**Who sees it:** everyone in the Employee or Admin portal, **but only when the company's email is set up.** The **Emails** item appears only after a platform superuser has entered the company's mail domain (**Domain / company email** in the company's settings on the Superuser Dashboard) and inbound email is working. Without it the sidebar has no **Emails** item, and opening an old Emails link sends you back to the Dashboard.

A red number next to **Emails** in the sidebar is your count of unread conversations. It refreshes about once a minute and right after you open or mark a conversation.

---

### The mailbox screen

- **Left column** (on phones, tap the **☰** menu button at the top left): the **New email** button and the folders.
- **Toolbar:** a select-all checkbox, actions for selected conversations, the search box and the **↻** refresh button.
- **List:** one row per conversation (thread), newest first.
- **Bottom:** **Previous** / **Next** and *Page X of Y (N conversations)*. Each page shows 25 conversations.

The Inbox also refreshes by itself when new mail arrives.

#### Folders

| Folder | What it holds |
|--------|---------------|
| **Inbox** | Conversations where a customer (or someone else) wrote to you. The number beside it is the unread count. Your reply stays in the row preview, but the order follows the latest incoming message, so answering doesn't move the conversation. |
| **Sent** | Conversations you sent. |
| **Drafts** | Emails you started in **Send Email** and closed without sending. The number beside it is how many. Employee mailbox only. |
| **Trash** | Deleted conversations. They can be restored or deleted forever. |

#### What a row shows

- The customer's name (in **Sent** and **Drafts**: the recipient; *(No recipient)* if a draft has none).
- A red **Draft** label when you have an unsent reply typed in that conversation (saved in this browser).
- **Subject** (*(No Subject)* if empty) and a short preview of the latest message.
- A paperclip when the conversation has attachments.
- The time (today) or the date (*Oct 14*).
- **Sent** only: an eye icon. Blue = **Read by client** (the customer opened it), gray = **Unread**. Hover the blue eye, **Read by client: see every open** (or tap it on a phone), to see *Opened N times* with the date and time of every open.

Unread conversations have a light-blue background and bold text.

---

### Searching

1. Type in the search box: **Search subject, message text, or addresses...**
2. After 2 characters a suggestion list drops down with matching conversations (name, subject, snippet). Click one (or use the arrow keys and **Enter**) to open it directly.
3. Or press **Enter** to filter the whole list. The search also matches the customer's name. Matching words are highlighted.
4. Click **X** to clear the search.

No results: *No emails found matching your search.* The search covers the folder you are in. There is no separate date or attachment filter.

---

### Opening a conversation

Click a row. The conversation opens in a large window over the mailbox (full screen on phones). Close it with **X** to return to the same folder, search, page and scroll position. Opening a conversation marks the customer's messages as read.

Drafts are different: clicking a **Drafts** row reopens it in **Send Email**.

---

### Mark as read / Mark as unread

**One conversation (Inbox):**

1. Hover the row (on a computer).
2. Click the envelope: closed envelope = **Mark as unread** (for a read conversation), open envelope = **Mark as read** (for an unread one).
3. Toast: **Success — Marked as unread** or **Marked as read**.

**Several conversations (Inbox or Sent):**

1. Tick their checkboxes (**Select email**), or the toolbar checkbox to select the whole page.
2. Click the envelope in the toolbar. If any selected conversation is unread it says **Mark as read**; if all are read it says **Mark as unread**.

**From inside a conversation:** hover any message and click **Mark as unread** (on a phone: tap the message, then **Mark as unread**). The conversation closes and shows as unread again.

On phones the row's delete and envelope buttons are hidden: select rows with the checkboxes and use the toolbar. **Trash** has no read/unread actions.

---

### Deleting, restoring and deleting forever

**Move to Trash:**

- One conversation: hover the row in **Inbox** or **Sent** and click the trash icon (**Delete**).
- Several: tick them, then the toolbar trash icon (**Delete selected**).
- From inside a conversation: hover a message → **Delete** (phone: tap the message → **Delete**), then confirm **Delete conversation?** — *This conversation will be moved to Trash.* Toast: **Conversation moved to Trash**.

After deleting from the list, a bar at the bottom left says *Conversation moved to Trash.* (or *N conversations moved to Trash.*) with **Undo** for 5 seconds. **Undo** brings it back (*Action undone.*).

**Restore from Trash:** open **Trash**, hover the row and click **Undelete**. Toast: **Conversation restored**.

**Delete forever:** in **Trash**, tick conversations and click **Delete forever** in the toolbar (*Delete selected forever*), then confirm **Delete forever?** (*This conversation will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.*). Toast: *Conversation deleted forever*. This cannot be undone.

---

### Sending a new email (Send Email)

**Open it:** the **New email** button above the folders (on phones: the round pen button at the bottom right).

The **Send Email** window has:

| Field | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| **To** | Required (*Recipient is required*). Type a name or address to pick a customer, or type any address and press **Enter**, comma or **Tab** (the list offers it as *Add email address*). You can add several. |
| **From list** | Next to **To**. Adds everyone on a deal board list (column). The **Deal status filter** checkboxes **Won** / **Lost** also include won or lost deals. |
| **Cc** / **Bcc** | Click **Cc** or **Bcc** beside **To** to show the field (phones: the arrow beside **To**, *Show Cc and Bcc* / *Hide Cc and Bcc*, shows or hides both). **Bcc** is *Hidden from everyone else on this email.* The **X** on a field (**Hide Cc** / **Hide Bcc**) hides it and clears it. |
| **Send as one email (Reply All)** | Appears when **To** has 2+ addresses. On: everyone in **To** sees each other and can reply all. Off (default): each person gets a separate email. |
| **Subject** | Placeholder *Email subject*. Optional, but sending without one asks *Send this email without a subject?* |
| **Template** | **Search templates...** Picking one fills the subject, body and the template's files (a spinner shows while it loads). The **X** (**Clear template**) removes what the template added; files you added yourself stay. |
| **Body** | Rich text editor. Hover a toolbar button for its name; **Clear formatting** removes styling from the selected text. Pasted text takes the editor's own colors (copying from a chat bubble doesn't bring its color or highlight). A message or an attachment is required (*Add a message or an attachment*). |

At the bottom: **✦ Improve message** (AI polishes the body), the paperclip (**Add attachment**) and **Send**. **Ctrl/Cmd + Enter** also sends.

**Attachments** (paperclip menu): **Upload from computer**, **From Stones**, **From Images**, **From Documents**, and **Request signature** when your company uses eSignatures. You can also drag files onto the window or paste them. Each file uploads right away: a spinner, then a green **Ready** tag; a failed one shows **Upload failed — Retry**. **Send** stays disabled until every file is ready (*Uploading attachments… Send unlocks when they are ready.*). Click an image to edit it before sending. A PDF tile has a **Sign** button to request a signature (see **eSignatures**).

**When you press Send:**

1. If the text mentions an attachment ("attached", "file"…) but nothing is attached, it asks *You didn't attach anything, is that fine?*
2. Unfilled custom placeholders block sending: *Please replace custom placeholders before sending: {{…}}*.
3. The window closes at once and a **Sending email…** toast shows, then **Success — Email sent**.
4. If it fails: **Email not sent** — the text is kept as a draft; open **Send Email** again, attach files again and press **Send**.

#### Drafts

- Closing **Send Email** with a subject or body saves it to **Drafts** (toast **Email saved in drafts**), including recipients and uploaded files.
- Click the draft in **Drafts** to continue. Sending it removes it from Drafts.
- Closing with nothing typed discards it (and deletes an existing empty draft).
- Unsent replies inside a conversation are kept separately, in this browser only; the Inbox row shows a red **Draft** label.

**Emailing a deal's customer** doesn't use **Send Email**: on the deal's **Project** tab, click the **envelope** icon next to the customer's email address. A new conversation opens inside the deal (see **Emails — Conversations & Replying** and **Employee Deals — Deal window (Edit Deal)**).

#### Other ways a Send Email opens prefilled

- From a QuickBooks invoice (**To**, **Subject** and the invoice PDF filled in).
- From an AI Design (the image is attached).

---

### What the customer receives

- **From:** your **Email Name** (set on **My Account**) and your email address. If your login email is not on the company's mail domain, the email is sent from *sales@granite-manager.com* instead.
- Your **Email Signature** (from **My Account**) is added below the message.
- A short line is added at the bottom: *If you'd rather not receive further emails from me, just reply and let me know.*
- Opens are tracked: the eye in **Sent** and **Read** in the conversation.

### Admin > Emails (company mailbox)

Admins see every rep's mail in **Admin > CRM > Emails**.

- A **Sales rep** filter at the top left: **All Sales Reps** or one rep.
- Folders: **Inbox**, **Sent**, **Trash** (with a count). No **Drafts** and no **New email**.
- Rows also show which employee the conversation belongs to (on phones: a *To:* / *From:* line).
- Opening a conversation is view-only: no reply box, no Reply/Forward, and it does **not** mark the conversation read for the rep.
- Search, Mark as read/unread, Delete, Undelete and Delete forever work the same as for employees.

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **I don't see Emails in the sidebar.** The company's email domain has not been set up yet (a platform superuser does this). Until then there is no mailbox.
- **Where is my sent email?** **Sent** folder. Scheduled emails go out at their time (see **Send later** in Conversations & Replying).
- **Did the customer open my email?** **Sent** → blue eye = opened; hover it for every open time.
- **I deleted a conversation by mistake.** Click **Undo** within 5 seconds, or open **Trash** → **Undelete**. Items deleted forever cannot be recovered.
- **How do I mark an email unread?** Inbox row → closed-envelope **Mark as unread**, or select rows → toolbar envelope.
- **Can I forward an email?** Yes, from inside the conversation (**Forward**). See Conversations & Replying.
- **Send is greyed out.** Files are still uploading or one failed: wait, **Retry**, or remove it. Sending too early says **Attachments still uploading** (*Please wait until all attachments finish uploading before sending.*); a field problem says **Cannot send email** with the first problem.
- **The email went from sales@granite-manager.com.** Your login email isn't on the company's mail domain. Ask a manager to change your email (Admin > Company settings > Users) or change it on **My Account**.
- **Why can't I reply in Admin > Emails?** The admin mailbox is view-only. Switch to **Employee** and use **CRM > Emails**.

How a quote's price is worked out, where to change the price list, tax, discounts, expiration date, extra items and individual prices, and how payment terms and deposits work.
