### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **How do I send a quote to the customer?** Open the quote → **Email** → check the **Template**, **To** and **Subject** → **Send**. The customer gets a **View your quote** link where they see the quote.
- **Can I attach the quote PDF to the email?** The Email button sends a link, not a file. Print → save the PDF, then attach it to a normal email.
- **How do I text a quote?** There is no text button or copyable link: **Print** → save the PDF → attach it in **CRM > SMS** (paperclip → **Upload from computer**). To get it signed, send a **Contract**.
- **Did the customer open my quote?** Check **Views** in the quote's **Email** table or **Email Viewed** in the list. Only emailed links are tracked.
- **The customer says the link doesn't work.** That email's link may be off (**Link off**): open the email and click **Activate link**, or send a new email. A deleted quote's link shows *Quote not found*.
- **The customer can't sign on the quote link.** The link only shows the quote. Send a **Contract** for an e-signature.
- **The Print button does nothing.** Allow pop-ups for the site.
- **My email failed with a message about a variable.** The quote or deal has no value for that `{{…}}` variable yet; add it or remove the variable.

## Employee Quotes (Quotes List & Quote Page)

Create countertop quotes for customers, keep every revision, and see at a glance which quotes were emailed, viewed, signed or sold.

**Where to find it:** Employee view → sidebar **Quotes** (a top-level item, not inside the **CRM** section). The list opens at `/employee/quotes`. In the **Admin** view, the sidebar **Quotes** item opens the quote *settings* (Price Lists, Extras, Forms, Measurements, Tax Rates, Payment Terms, Email Templates) instead of the quote list; see the Admin Quotes settings section.

**Who can use it:** Every user with Employee or Admin access (sales reps, sales managers, office managers, owners). There are no position limits inside Quotes: anyone who can open the page can see, edit, send, sell and delete any quote of the company. Shop-only users and single-purpose portal users (Installer, Marketing, Walk-in) cannot open it.

**Related sections:** Sending, Printing and Selling Quotes (email, customer link, print/PDF, contract, Mark as Sold) · Quote Pricing, Tax, Discounts & Payment Terms · Customer Quote Page (what the customer sees) · the quote drawing tool (drawing counters, sinks, colors) · Admin Quotes settings.

---

### The Quotes list

#### Toolbar

| Control | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| **Create Quote** | Opens the **Add Quote** dialog. |
| **My Quotes** / **All Quotes** | Which quotes are listed. **My Quotes** = quotes where you are the salesperson (or quotes you created that have no salesperson). **All Quotes** = every quote of the company. Users with the **Sales Rep** position start on **All Quotes**; everyone else starts on **My Quotes**. Users with the **Sales Manager** position also find each sales rep's name in this list, to see only that rep's quotes. Your last choice is remembered on that browser. |
| **Search** box | Placeholder *Search name, customer, address, phone, email…*. Click the **X** to clear it. |

#### Columns

- **Quote Name** — click to open the quote. A green check mark before the name means the quote is **sold**.
- **Created** — date the quote was made.
- **Salesperson** — the quote's sales rep.
- **Price List** — the price list the quote is priced with.
- **Email Viewed** — the last time the customer opened a link from an emailed quote (— if never).
- **Revision** — **Draft** until the drawing is saved the first time, then **Rev 1**, **Rev 2**…

Click a column header (Quote Name, Created, Salesperson, Email Viewed) to sort. Click anywhere on a row to open the quote (Ctrl/middle-click the name to open it in a new tab). The list shows 20 quotes per page by default; page and page size are kept in the address, so the Back button returns you to the same page and search.

#### Searching

Every word you type must match something on the quote: quote name, quote number (for example `#1234`), customer name, job address, phone (digits are enough, at least 3), email, salesperson or price list. Two special words:

- **sold** — finds sold quotes.
- **signed** — finds quotes the customer accepted and signed but that are not marked sold yet.

Quotes whose **name** matches are listed first.

---

### Creating a quote

1. Click **Create Quote**.
2. In **Add Quote**:
   - **Customer** (required) — pick **Search by** (name, phone, email or company), then start typing and choose the customer. Use **Add Customer** to create a new customer if they are not in the system yet (after picking a customer the button reads **Edit Customer**; a red alert icon on it means the customer is missing email, address or phone).
   - **Quote name (optional)** — leave blank to use the customer's name.
   - **Price list** — preselected with the company's default list. Only active price lists that have a published revision are offered.
3. Click **Create Quote**. The quote is created and the **drawing tool** opens so you can draw the counters (see the quote drawing tool section).

If you forget the customer you see *Please add a customer*.

**What is filled in automatically:**

- **Salesperson** = you.
- **Address, phone and email** copied from the customer.
- **Expiration date** = today plus the price list's **Expiration Days** (30 days if the list has none).
- **Tax** = the price list's default tax rate; **payment terms** = the price list's default payment terms (else the company's first payment terms).
- Extras that the admin marked **Add to every new quote** are already on the quote.
- One area named **Area #1** and one color option.

A new quote is a **Draft** (no revision) until you save the drawing.

---

### The quote page

Open any quote from the list (or from a deal's **Quotes** tab). The page title shows **QUOTE** and the quote name. The arrow at the top left (**Back to quotes**) returns to the list.

**Header buttons** (details in Sending, Printing and Selling Quotes):

- **Mark as Sold** (or **Sold** once sold, or **Signed: pick option**)
- **Actions** (a menu): **Print**, **Email**, **Contract** and **Create invoice** (when the quote has a customer and prices; with several color options and none sold, it asks which option to invoice). See the Invoices section.

Success messages (green) and errors (red) appear just under the buttons. A yellow **Prices changed…** banner may appear when today's prices differ from the quote's (see the Quote Pricing section).

The page has these cards:

#### Quote Info

Shows **Quote Name**, **Expiration Date**, **Price List** (name and revision, e.g. *Standard (Rev. 3)*), **Salesperson**, **Notes** and **Payment Terms**. Empty fields are hidden. Click the payment terms text to edit them directly.

To edit, click the pencil (**Edit Quote Info**):

1. **Quote Name** (cannot be blank), **Salesperson** (users with the Sales Rep position; a new salesperson also becomes the customer's sales rep), **Notes**.
2. **Terms** — pencil opens **Edit Payment Terms**.
3. Click **Save**.

The dialog header also has a trash icon (**Delete quote**) and a copy icon (**Duplicate quote**).

Quote **Notes** are printed in a **Notes:** box on the built-in printed quote, so write them for the customer.

#### Customer & Address

Shows **Customer**, **Address**, **Phone**, **Phone 2**, **Email** and **Notes** (address notes).

- **Address** shows the driving distance from your company in miles (when Google can route it) and a map button (**Open directions in Google Maps**).
- **Customer name** is a link: it opens the customer's **deal** on top of the quote (the same Edit Deal window as on the Deals board). If the customer has several deals, **Choose a deal** asks which one. If there is none you see **No deal found** — *There is no open deal for this customer.* Closing the deal returns you to the quote.

To edit, click the pencil (**Edit Quote Address**):

- **Customer** — search by name, phone, email or address. Choosing another customer moves the quote to that customer and fills address, phone and email from them. Buttons next to the name: **Edit customer** (edit the customer record) and **Unlink customer**. A customer is required (*Choose a customer*). A customer shared by imported quotes that had no contact can't be edited (*Shared by imported quotes without a contact, so it can't be edited.*): **Create new customer** makes a real one for this quote.
- **Address** (with address suggestions), **Address 2**, **Phone**, **Phone 2**, **Email**, **Notes**.
- Click **Save**.

These are the quote's own job details (they can differ from the customer record), except **Phone 2**, which is saved on the customer.

#### Drawing

Shows the saved drawing with page breaks and seams. Edges have no symbols here: an unfinished edge is just drawn red (appliance edges yellow, mitered gray). A badge shows **Draft** or **Revision N**.

- **Edit drawing** — opens the drawing tool.
- **See all revisions** — opens **Quote Revision History** (Revision, Created, Created By, Notes). Click **View** on a row to look at that revision.
- While viewing an old revision: arrows (**Previous revision** / **Next revision**), *Revision X of Y*, **View Latest Revision**, and an **X** (**Close revisions**) to go back. The Quote Summary then shows one color option at a time.
- Small stone photos at the bottom right (*See a stone on your countertop*) paint the counters with that stone; click again to clear.

#### Quote Summary

Price list, total area (sq ft) and one row per color option with its total, deposits and warnings. See the Quote Pricing section for details.

#### Contracts and Email

These tables appear once a contract or an email has been sent from the quote. See Sending, Printing and Selling Quotes.

---

### Revising a quote

A quote keeps every saved version:

1. On the quote page click **Edit drawing**.
2. Make the changes (drawing, colors, prices) in the drawing tool.
3. Click **Save**, optionally type **Notes about this revision**, and save. Each save creates the next revision (Revision 1, 2, 3…).

The customer link and new emails always show the **latest saved** revision. The **Email** column on the quote page shows which revision each email carried. To go back to an older version, use **Revisions** → **Revert to Revision** inside the drawing tool, then save (this creates a new revision; nothing is overwritten).

---

### Duplicating a quote

1. Quote page → **Quote Info** pencil → copy icon (**Duplicate quote**).
2. In **Copy Quote Revision** set **Quote Name**, **Price List** and **Salesperson**.
3. Under **Sections To Duplicate**, tick **Address** and/or **Drawing** (both on by default).
4. Click **Save**. The new quote opens.

The copy is a new **Draft** for the same customer. It keeps the notes, tax, discounts, payment terms and expiration date. Unticking **Drawing** gives an empty drawing; unticking **Address** leaves address, phone, email and address notes empty. Copying onto a different price list re-prices the copy with that list (extras the new list does not offer are dropped; its "add to every new quote" extras are added).

---

### Deleting a quote

1. Open the quote → **Quote Info** pencil → trash icon (**Delete quote**).
2. The **Delete quote** dialog asks *Soft-delete "Quote name"?* → **Delete**.
3. Toast **Quote deleted**; you return to the list.

There is no delete button on the list rows, and no undelete button in the app. A deleted quote's customer link stops working (*Quote not found*).

---

### Quote statuses

| What you see | Meaning | How it gets there |
|--------------|---------|-------------------|
| **Draft** (Revision column / Drawing badge) | Drawing never saved. | New quote or a duplicate. |
| **Rev N** / **Revision N** | Saved at least once; active. | Each **Save** in the drawing tool. |
| **Signed** (search word) | Customer accepted and signed, not yet sold; the button still reads **Mark as Sold** with their option preselected. | Customer accepted the quote on the customer page before signing was taken off it. |
| **Signed: pick option** button | A contract was signed (deal already won) but the quote has several options and none was chosen. | Customer signed a contract sent from the quote. Click the button and pick the option. |
| Green check · **Sold** button | Sold; its deal is won. | **Mark as Sold**, or the customer signed a contract sent from the quote. |

**Undo sale** returns a sold quote to active.

---

### Quotes on a deal (Quotes tab)

Open a deal (CRM > Deals → customer name). The deal has four tabs: **Project**, **General**, **Files** and **Quotes**. The **Quotes** tab shows a count badge and lists **all quotes of the deal's customer** (*This customer's quotes.*):

- Quote name (green check = sold), **Draft** or **Rev N**.
- Created date · salesperson · price list.
- Click a quote to open its quote page. *No quotes yet.* when there are none.

There is no create button on this tab; create quotes from **Quotes** → **Create Quote** and pick the customer. Once a quote is linked to a deal (selling it links it), the deal's **History** also shows **Quote sent**, **Quote printed**, **Contract sent** and **Contract signed** rows; click the title to open the quote.

---

### Quotes imported from Moraware

Quotes brought over from Moraware CounterGo appear in the list like any other quote. They are priced on a copy of the Moraware price list named *"<list name> Moraware"*, keep the Moraware prices, and their first revision note reads *Imported from Moraware CounterGo quote #…*. Emails sent from Moraware are listed in the **Email** table with **Link off** (those links were Moraware's). Imported quotes with no customer email or phone sit under a shared customer named **Moraware import**. Customers created by the import have no deal, so clicking their name shows **No deal found**; marking such a quote sold creates a won deal.

---

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **How do I see one sales rep's quotes?** Click **All Quotes**, then type the rep's name in the search box: it matches the **Salesperson**. **My Quotes** lists your own.
- **Where is Quotes in the menu?** Employee view, sidebar **Quotes** (top-level). In Admin view the same item opens quote settings, not quotes; switch to Employee view to work on quotes.
- **I can't find a quote another rep made.** Switch **My Quotes** to **All Quotes**.
- **The Price list dropdown says "No price lists yet".** No active price list with a published revision exists. An admin sets them up in Admin > Quotes > Price Lists.
- **How do I change the price list, tax, discount or expiration date?** In the drawing tool's **Price Details** step (see Quote Pricing). Duplicating also lets you pick another price list.
- **How do I rename a quote or change the salesperson?** **Quote Info** pencil → **Quote Name** / **Salesperson** → **Save**.
- **The salesperson I want is not in the list.** Only users with the **Sales Rep** position are offered.
- **How do I move a quote to another customer?** **Customer & Address** pencil → choose the other customer → **Save**.
- **Can I convert a quote to a deal or job?** **Mark as Sold** marks the customer's deal won with the sold option's total (it creates a won deal if the customer has none). There is no separate job record.
- **Clicking the customer name says No deal found.** The customer has no deal; create one on CRM > Deals.
- **Can I get a deleted quote back?** Not from the app.

## SMS (Text Messages — CloudTalk & RingCentral)

**SMS** is where you text customers from the CRM: read and answer conversations, start new ones, attach pictures and documents, use templates and AI, schedule texts and run automatic follow-ups. Texts go through your company's phone provider, **CloudTalk** or **RingCentral**, from your own texting line.

**Where to find it:**

- Employee view: sidebar **CRM > SMS**.
- Admin view: switch to **Admin**, then sidebar **CRM > SMS** (view only, see below).
- A deal's **Project** tab: the **SMS** button next to a customer phone number opens the conversation inside the deal.

A red number next to **SMS** in the sidebar is how many conversations have unread texts.

---

### When the SMS item appears

| Company uses | You see **SMS** when | Notes |
|--------------|----------------------|-------|
| **RingCentral** (connected by a manager in **Admin > Company settings > Company → RingCentral → Connect RingCentral**) | Always | Without your own RingCentral line you can read but not send; a yellow bar says *Your account isn't linked to an SMS line yet — you can read SMS but not send. Ask an admin to link your account in user settings.* |
| **CloudTalk** (keys entered by a platform superuser) | Your account has a **CloudTalk agent ID** | Without an agent ID there is no **SMS** item and opening an SMS link sends you to the Dashboard. This also applies to admins. |
| **Granite Phone** (Telnyx, set up by a platform superuser with texting on) | An admin let you **call from** one of the company's numbers (**Admin > Company settings > Phone** → number → **Edit** → **People**) | You text from that number. See **Granite Phone (Telnyx)**. |

**Your texting line** is set on **My Account → Phone lines**: **CloudTalk agent ID** + **CloudTalk phone number**, or **RingCentral phone number** (the CRM finds your RingCentral user from the number). A manager can also set these in **Admin > Company settings > Users → Edit**.

**If the company has more than one:** a Granite Phone line comes first; then a saved RingCentral line; otherwise a CloudTalk agent ID; otherwise RingCentral.

---

### The conversation list

- Header **SMS**, the round pen button (**New conversation**) and the search box **Search by name, phone, or message…**
- Each row: customer name (or the phone number), *5 minutes ago*-style time, an arrow (↓ incoming, ↑ outgoing) and the last message. **Unlinked** = the number isn't tied to a customer. *Draft:* shows text you typed but didn't send.
- Unread conversations are bold with a blue number badge.
- More rows load as you scroll (**Load more**). The list refreshes by itself every 15 seconds.

**Which conversations you see:** your own — numbers you (your line) texted or called with, plus texts sent to your own number. Admins see everyone's in **Admin > CRM > SMS**.

Empty states: *No SMS conversations yet*, *No conversations match "…"* (**Clear search**), *Could not load conversations* (**Try again**), *Select a conversation*.

#### Mark as unread

1. Hover a read conversation in the list (on a computer).
2. Click the envelope on the right (**Mark as unread**). If it was open, it closes.

Opening a conversation marks it read again. Admin SMS has no Mark as unread and does not mark anything read.

#### New conversation

1. Click the pen button (**New conversation**).
2. Search **Search customer or supplier by name or phone…**
3. Click a customer, or a supplier (tagged **Supplier**). Entries marked *No phone on file* can't be picked.
4. No match? Type a full 10-digit number and click **Message (xxx) xxx-xxxx** — *No matching customer — start anyway*.

---

### Reading a conversation

**Header:** the customer's name (click to copy) and number, **Go to Deal** (tooltip **Open customer deal**; picks from **Choose a deal** if there are several), and the lightning button **Follow-up Flows**. A supplier shows **Supplier**; an unknown number shows **Unlinked** and **Link to customer**. In a deal, the arrow goes **Back to deal**.

**Messages:** customer texts on the left (gray), yours on the right (blue), grouped by day. Each shows its time; texts sent by another rep show *by <name>*. **Load older messages** at the top loads history. When you scroll up and new texts arrive, a blue button shows *N new messages* / **Jump to latest**.

- **Sending…** under a text while it goes out; **Failed. Retry** if it didn't — click to resend.
- Pictures and files show inside the bubble; click a picture to enlarge it (*Image unavailable* when it can't be loaded).
- A CloudTalk text with no readable content says *No preview available.* with **Open CloudTalk** (opens the CloudTalk phone panel and copies the number so you can find the pictures there; when the number can't be read: **CloudTalk opened** · *Open Messages and find this conversation.*).
- **Reactions:** hover a text and click the smiley (**React to message**). Pick one (👍 ❤️ 😂 😮 😢 🙏 🔥 ✨ 🎉 👏 😊 💯) or **More emotions**. Click a reaction under a text to remove it.

#### Link an unknown number to a customer

1. Click **Link to customer** in the header.
2. In **Link (xxx) xxx-xxxx to a customer**:
   - **Link existing**: search **Search by name or phone…** and click **Link**.
   - **Create new**: type **Customer name** (*Full name*); **Phone** is filled in. Click **Create customer**.

---

### Writing and sending a text

Type in **Type a reply…** and click **Send** (paper plane), or press **Ctrl/Cmd + Enter**. **Enter** alone starts a new line.

**Undo send:** a sent text shows in the conversation at once but waits 10 seconds before it goes out. A card *Sending… 10s* counts down (bottom left on a computer, above the box on a phone): **Undo** takes it back and puts the text back in the box; the arrow (**Send now**) sends it right away. Sending another message, opening another conversation or closing the composer sends it at once. A scheduled text (**Send later**) has no undo card.

**On a computer** the bar above the box has: **AI reply**, **✦** (**Improve message**), the paperclip (**Attach files**), the template icon (**Templates**, *Use SMS template*) and the smiley (**Insert emoji**). Next to **Send** is the clock (**Send later**).

**On phones and tablets** the box is compact: the **⋮** button at its left (**More actions**) holds **AI reply**, **Emoji**, **Upload from computer**, **From Stones**, **From Images**, **From Documents**, **Use Template** and **Improve message**. On phones **Improve message** is only in this menu, never next to **Send**. The clock and **Send** sit at the right.

Limits and checks:

- Up to **1,600 characters**; longer text can't be sent (Send stays greyed out).
- Unfilled `{{placeholders}}` block sending: **Placeholders detected**.
- Without a texting line the box is replaced by *Sending disabled — no SMS line linked*.
- Unsent text is kept as a draft for that conversation (in this browser).

#### AI tools

| Tool | What it does |
|------|--------------|
| **AI reply** | Opens **AI reply**: **Fast reply** (*Short reply to what they just said*), **Follow up** (*Check in and keep the conversation moving*) or **Custom** (*Tell AI exactly what to write* → **Generate**). **Use instructions** adds company instructions. Then **Review AI reply**: edit it, type a change and **Update draft**, or **Paste into input**. |
| **✦ Improve message** | Rewrites your text for clarity and tone (*Improving your message…*; an AI reply in progress shows *Writing a reply*). Select part of the text to improve only that part. |
| Typing suggestions | AI may show the rest of your sentence in gray. **Tab** accepts it; on touch screens tap the suggestion (**Tap to add**) or swipe right across the message box. Typing "our inventory" or "inventory link" offers **Insert inventory link**. Typing "measurements" or "online quote" offers **Insert quote link** (the customer quote page, where the customer sends you their sizes). |

**Improve message offer:** until you have used **Improve message** once, pressing **Send** may show the tip **Improve this message**. Click **Improve message**, or **Send without Improve**. On phones the **⋮** menu opens and the tip points at **Improve message** inside it.

---

### Attachments (pictures and documents)

When attachments are turned on (the default):

1. Click the paperclip (**Attach files**; phones: **⋮** menu). Choose **Upload from computer**, **From Stones**, **From Images** or **From Documents** (pickers confirm with **Add to the SMS**).
2. Or paste or drag files into the composer.
3. Click an image thumbnail to mark it up before sending (**Edit image**, below). **X** removes a file; a failed upload has **Retry upload**. Send waits for uploads and is blocked by failed ones (*Remove failed attachments to send*).

- Up to **10** attachments per text (*This text already has 10 attachments, the maximum.*).
- Types: pictures (JPEG, PNG, GIF, HEIC, WebP and similar) and documents (PDF, Word, Excel, TXT, CSV).
- RingCentral: if the files are too big for one text you'll see *RingCentral limits how much fits in one text, so these will be sent as N separate messages.*

If attachments are turned off, there is no paperclip and no attachment options; text, emoji, templates and AI still work.

**Edit image (mark up a picture before sending):** click an attached picture's thumbnail, in a text or in an email you are writing. The toolbar has **Brush**, **Line**, **Arrow**, **Rectangle**, **Ellipse**, **Text** (type on the picture; drag the bar above the text box, **Move text**, to move it) and **Crop** (drag a frame; **Reset crop** clears it). Pick a color from the dots or **Custom color** (*Drawing color*). **Undo** takes back the last mark, **Clear** (*Clear all*) removes them all. **Apply** replaces the attachment with the marked-up picture; **Cancel** keeps the original.

---

### SMS templates

1. Click the template icon (**Templates**; phones: **⋮** → **Use Template**).
2. Search (**Search...**) and click a template. It is added **after** what you already typed (it never replaces it). Customer and your own details fill in.
3. If it has custom placeholders, a toast says **Custom variables detected** — *Please fill in: {{…}}*. Replace them before sending.

- **Company** templates come from **Admin > CRM > Automations > SMS Templates** and can't be edited here.
- Your own templates: pencil to edit, trash to delete (**Delete template**).
- **Add a Template** opens **New template**: **Name** (*e.g. Follow up*), **Message** (*Type your template message…*) with **Insert Variable** and a *n / 1600* counter → **Create**.
- Recently used templates move to the top; drag to reorder; **Reset to Automatic Order** undoes it.

---

### Send later (scheduled texts)

1. Write the text, click the clock (**Send later**).
2. Pick the day and **Time**; optionally tick **Cancel if the customer messages first**.
3. Click **Schedule**. Toast: **SMS scheduled** (or **SMS was not scheduled**).

With the box empty, the clock shows a red dot when texts are scheduled; click it to see **Scheduled** with **Edit**, **Delete** (**Delete scheduled message**) and **Send now**. A scheduled text marked *Cancels if they message* is dropped if the customer texts first.

---

### Follow-up flows (automatic follow-ups)

A flow texts or emails a customer in steps until they reply. Click the lightning button **Follow-up Flows** in the conversation header (on a deal: **Automated Follow-up**). Without a connected texting line it can't be clicked (*Connect SMS to use automated messaging*).

1. The **Start a flow** panel lists **Generate with AI** (*Personalized SMS and email follow-ups*), **Company flows** and **Your flows** (*3 steps · 2d 1h total*). Click a flow to preview its steps (a step with no text or template shows *No message text*).
2. Click **Start flow**. Toast: **Follow-up started**. When a flow is already running, the button is **Switch flow**: it stops the running flow and starts this one (toast **Flow switched** · *"<name>" is running.*).
3. Or **Generate** under **Generate with AI** (*May take up to 30 seconds*; the panel shows the **Conversation**, *Recent SMS and email*, beside the messages; until then **AI follow-ups** says *Not generated yet*): review the **AI follow-ups**, edit text and send times, **Regenerate** or delete messages, then **Start flow**. If AI refuses (for example the customer already replied) you see **Why follow-ups were not generated**; **Generate anyway** is offered when allowed.

- **AI instruction** (the gear button on the **Generate with AI** row; a dot on it when one is set): one rule for your whole company that the AI follows every time it writes follow-ups, for example *Always mention we fabricate in Indianapolis. Do not offer a discount.* Up to 2,000 characters; **Save** (toast **AI instruction saved**); empty and save removes it. Any employee can change it, and it applies to everyone's AI follow-ups.
- **Editing AI follow-ups that are already scheduled:** while an AI flow runs, its row reads **Generated with AI** · **Running** · *Tap to view or edit scheduled messages*. Click it to change each message's send date and time, an email's subject, the text, or remove a message (trash, while more than one is pending), then **Save changes** (toast **Follow-up updated** · *Scheduled messages were saved.*). Messages already sent show *AI follow-up sent from this customer's conversation.* and can't be changed.
- While a flow runs, a strip above the composer shows the next message and time (blue), **Paused** (amber) or **Failed** (red, with **Dismiss**). AI flows have **Send now** (*Sending follow-up · The next message is going out now.*).
- Customer variables (the customer's name…) can't be filled in an SMS conversation that isn't linked to a customer: *Customer variables can't be filled until this number is linked to a customer.* Link it first (**Link to customer**).
- **Stop** (in the strip or the panel) asks **Stop flow** — *This cannot be undone.* There is no pause button.
- A flow **stops by itself** when the customer texts, calls, emails in, or really talks with you on a call.
- Flow texts go out 9:00 AM–6:00 PM and emails 8:30 AM–7:00 PM (Eastern), not on major holidays; AI steps never send on Sundays.
- **Manage flows** (panel footer) opens **Follow-up Flows** for your own flows: **New flow**, edit (pencil), delete (trash). Company flows are managed by admins in **Admin > CRM > Automations**.
- Without your own texting line only email-only flows are offered, and starting an SMS flow shows **Connect CloudTalk** / **Connect RingCentral** with **Open My Account**.

Full details: **Admin Automations** (flows and templates).

---

### Admin > SMS (view only)

- Every rep's conversations, with a rep filter (**All** or one rep) at the top of the list.
- A bar says *View only — open employee SMS to send messages*. No composer, no **New conversation**, no flows, no Mark as unread, and opening a conversation doesn't mark it read.
- The header shows the customer's sales rep.

---

### Calling

Phone calls (click-to-call, the **Phone** button in the sidebar footer, the phone panel) are described in **Phone Calls**. On a deal, the phone icon next to a number calls with RingCentral, opens the CloudTalk phone (number copied), or uses your device's dialer.

---

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **I don't see SMS in the sidebar.** The company has no CloudTalk/RingCentral connection, or (CloudTalk) your account has no **CloudTalk agent ID**. Add it on **My Account** or ask a manager.
- **"Sending disabled — no SMS line linked."** Save your texting line on **My Account** (CloudTalk agent ID and phone number, or RingCentral phone number).
- **I saved my RingCentral number but still can't send.** The number must match a number of your RingCentral user exactly; otherwise the CRM can't link it. Check it and save again.
- **Can I send pictures?** Yes, up to 10 pictures or documents per text, when attachments are turned on.
- **Enter doesn't send.** Use **Send** or **Ctrl/Cmd + Enter**.
- **Where is Improve message on my phone?** In the **⋮** (**More actions**) menu at the left of the text box.
- **A text shows "Failed. Retry".** Click it to resend. For RingCentral picture texts a **Message not sent** toast may explain why: *RingCentral refused the picture message. Your number may not have MMS turned on — ask your RingCentral admin to enable it.* or *An attachment could not be read. Remove it, add it again, and resend.*
- **How do I mark a text unread?** Hover the conversation in the list → envelope **Mark as unread**.
- **Why can't I send from Admin > SMS?** It is view-only; use **CRM > SMS** in the Employee view.
- **Who sent this text?** Texts from other reps show *by <name>* under the bubble.

## Employee Stones (Inventory & Selling Slabs)

Use **Stones** to browse your shop's stone catalog, check what is in stock, look at slab photos and sizes, and sell slabs to customers. A sale creates a transaction tied to the customer.

**Where to find it:** sidebar **Inventory > Stones** (Employee view). Admins see the same catalog under **Admin > Inventory > Stones**, where they can also add, edit and delete stones (see Admin Stones).

**Who can see it:** every employee who can open the Employee CRM. Employees only see stones that are set to **Display**; hidden stones appear only in the Admin catalog.

#### Who can do what

| Action | Who |
|--------|-----|
| Browse the catalog, filters, photos, slab lists | All employees |
| Change a slab's length × width on the slab list | All employees |
| **Sell Slab** button at the top of the catalog | All employees |
| **Sell** / **Edit** buttons on each slab row | Only users with the **Sales Representative** position |
| Add, edit or delete stones, slabs, photos | Admins only (**Admin > Inventory > Stones**) |

---

### Browsing the stone catalog

#### Toolbar

- **Table View** / **Grid View** — switches the layout (*Switch to Table View* / *Switch to Grid View*). Your choice is remembered for next time.
- **Sell Slab** — opens the sale form without picking a slab first (see *Selling a slab*).
- **Stone Search** (top right) — search stones by name (see below).

#### Which stones are listed and in what order

- Only stones set to **Display** are listed. Stones with no available slab are hidden unless **Show sold out** is on (stones marked **Regular Stock** always show).
- Stones are sorted A–Z: in-stock stones first, then out-of-stock ones.
- A stone that has no photo at all is not shown in the grid or table (this can happen to a color created with **Add New Color** in the sale form). Find it with **Stone Search**, or ask an admin to add a photo.

#### Grid cards

Each card shows the photo, the stone name and:

- **Available** — whole slabs free / whole slabs in the yard (e.g. `3 / 5`). Shows **Regular Stock** when the stone is regular stock and no whole slab is free, adds **(Regular stock)** after the count when it is regular stock, or shows **Remnants Only** when only leftover pieces are free.
- **Type** — the material (granite, quartz…).
- **Price** — retail price per sq ft, or **By slab $X sqft** when no retail price is set.
- **Bundle Location** and **Bundle** (`#number`) when the admin filled them in.
- A red **ON SALE** ribbon when the stone is marked **On Sale**, and a red **Out of Stock** banner when nothing is available and it is not regular stock.

Click the **photo** to open the photo viewer. Click the **card details** (a faint **Sell** appears on hover) or the card itself to open the stone's slab list.

#### Photo viewer

Opens over the page with the large photo and **Stone ID**, **Type**, **Size**, **Available**, **Price**, **Level**, **Finishing** and **Bundle**. When an admin has added install photos, an **Installed projects** row of thumbnails appears; click one to show it. Use the magnifier button (**Enable zoom mode**) to zoom into the stone. While the viewer is open the page address includes that stone, so copying the address reopens the same photo.

#### Table view

Sortable columns: **Image**, **Name**, **Type**, **Size**, **Available**, **Amount** (all slabs in the yard, sold or not), **Retail Price**, **Cost per Sqft**, **Bundle Location**, **Delivery Date**. Click the **image** for the photo viewer; click the **name** to open the slab list.

#### Stone Search

Type part of a stone name in **Stone Search**. Results show the name, **Price** (or **Price per slab**) and bundle number; the first 3 matches show, then **Show more (N more)**.

- Click a result to open its photo viewer.
- Click **Slabs** on a result to open its slab list.
- Employee search only finds displayed stones that have a free whole slab or are **Regular Stock** (sold-out and remnant-only stones are skipped).

#### Sidebar filters

While **Stones** is open, filters appear under it in the sidebar:

| Filter | What it does |
|--------|--------------|
| **Stone Types** | Your company's material types (pick several) |
| **Finishing** | **Polished**, **Leathered**, **Honed** |
| **Stone Colors** | Color tags (first 2 show; **Show more** / **Show less**) |
| **Stone Levels** | **Level 1** to **Level 7** price tiers (first 2 show; **Show more**) |
| **Show sold out** | Also list stones with no available slab |
| **Suppliers** | Click the heading to expand, then pick one supplier (click again to remove) |

**Clear** next to a group resets it. Within one group a stone can match any checked option; different groups combine.

---

### Opening a stone's slab list

Click a card, a table name, or **Slabs** in search. The **Slabs for [stone name]** dialog opens (with **· Bundle #N** when the stone has a bundle number). Each row is one slab or remnant in the yard; slabs already cut in the shop no longer appear.

| Row color | Meaning |
|-----------|---------|
| **White** | Available whole slab |
| **Yellow** | Remnant — the leftover piece of a slab that was sold partially |
| **Red** | Sold (on a sale) |

Each row shows a thumbnail (click to enlarge), the bundle number, the size (**length x width**) and, for Sales Representatives, a **Sell** button (available slabs) or **Edit** button (sold slabs). Slabs shared from another stone (linked by an admin) are listed in the same dialog, grouped by bundle.

A slab marked sold with no sale record says *Transaction data not available* (*This slab is marked as sold but has no transaction details.*, with its *Sale ID:*). **Hover a red or yellow row** to see the sale: **Sold to**, **Sold by**, **Sale date**, **Total Square Feet**, **Room Square Feet (room)**, **Sink**, **Notes to Sale**, **Notes to Slab**. Yellow remnants show **Partially sold to** / **Partially sold by** from the original sale.

Opening a slab link from a slab's QR label opens this dialog with that slab outlined in blue for a few seconds. **No Slabs available** means the stone has nothing in the yard.

#### Change a slab's size

1. Click the slab's **length x width** numbers.
2. Type the new length and width (inches).
3. Click **Save**. Toast: **Slab dimensions updated successfully**.

---

### Selling a slab (step by step)

**Start the sale** in one of two ways:

- **From a slab:** open the slab list and click **Sell** on a white or yellow row. The slab is already in Room 1 and the room's stone is filled in.
- **From the toolbar:** click **Sell Slab** at the top of the catalog. Room 1 starts empty — pick the stone and slabs yourself.

The **Sell Slab - Add Customer** dialog opens.

#### 1. Customer and seller

1. Choose **Search by** (**name**, **phone**, **email** or **company**) and type in **Customer** (*Start typing customer…*). Pick the customer from **Suggestions**.
2. No match? Click **Add Customer** to create one (what you typed becomes the name). After picking a customer, the button becomes **Edit Customer**; a red ! on it means **Missing customer info** (email, address or phone). Click **X** to change the customer.
3. **Project address same as billing address** is on by default. Turn it off to enter a different job address. It turns off automatically when the customer has a company name.
4. The seller dropdown (*Select a seller*) defaults to you; pick another sales rep if needed.
5. **Deal** (only when the customer has deals): *Which deal is this sale for?* — pick one of the customer's deals (name and list) or **Not part of a deal**. It is required then: *Pick the deal this sale is for*. The sale is linked to that deal.

#### 2. Rooms

Each sale has one or more rooms. For each room:

| Field | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| **Room** | **Kitchen**, **Bathroom**, **Outdoor**, **Island**, or **Other** (type your own name) |
| **Square Feet** | Required, greater than 0 (*Enter Sqft*) |
| **Stone** | *Search stone colors...* — pick the stone this room uses. **X** clears it (and removes the room's slabs). New rooms start with Room 1's stone. |

Pick the **Stone** first — the **Add Slab**, **Add Sink** and **Add Faucet** buttons only work once the room has a stone.

Below the room are three tabs:

**Slabs**
- **Add Slab** — opens **Add Slab**; choose from the free slabs of the room's stone (*Select a slab*). A yellow **Partial** tag marks remnants or slabs already partly sold; a purple **Leftover** tag marks leftover pieces. *No available slabs found for this stone* means nothing is free. The same slab can be used in another room.
- Each slab shows a **Full Slab Sold** switch and a badge:
  - **On** — red **Bundle N (Full)**: the whole slab is sold.
  - **Off** (the default) — yellow **Bundle N (Partial)**: part of the slab is sold and a remnant stays in stock.
  - Leftover slabs show a purple **Bundle N (Leftover)** badge.
- **X** removes a slab (only when the room has more than one).

**Sinks** — **Add Sink** lists sink models with a free unit (*Select a sink*; *No available sinks found*). The price starts at the sink's retail price and can be edited. **X** removes it.

**Faucets** — **Add Faucet** works the same way (*Select a faucet*).

**More rooms:** click **Add Room**. Remove Room 2 or later with the **X** next to the room title.

#### Stone not in the system? Add New Color

Next to the room's **Stone** search, click **+** to open **Add New Color**:

| Field | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| **Name*** | Required |
| **Price per sqft*** | Required, more than 0 |
| **Length** / **Width** | Optional |
| **Type** | Your company's stone types |
| **Leftover** | On by default (the **Leftover Stone** note): one slab is created automatically with a bundle number like `LO-20261019-A1B2`. Turn it off to enter **Bundle Numbers*** yourself (**Add Bundle** for more). |

Click **Add Stone**. The color is created (displayed, no photo) with its slab(s), selected in the room, and its slabs are added to the room.

#### 3. Notes and submit

1. Optionally type **Notes** (*Notes to Sale*).
2. Click **Submit**.

**What happens:**

- A sale (transaction) is created with today's date; it appears on **Transactions** with the status **Sold** (green) until slabs are cut. See **Transactions — Employee & Admin**.
- The slabs turn **red** on the slab list. Each partial slab leaves a yellow remnant in stock (same bundle number and size — click its size to correct it).
- Sinks and faucets are taken from stock.
- If the customer had no sales rep, the seller becomes their sales rep.
- Toast: **Sale completed successfully**. You return to the slab list (or the catalog when you started from **Sell Slab**).

**Errors you may see:** *Please add a customer*, *Pick the deal this sale is for*, *Square feet is required*, *At least one slab is required in each room*, or a message that a slab is already sold (someone else sold it first — pick another).

---

### Editing a sale

1. Open the stone's slab list and click **Edit** on a red (sold) slab.
2. The **Sell Slab - Add Customer** dialog opens with the sale loaded.
3. Change the customer, seller, rooms, slabs, sinks, faucets or notes.
4. Click **Submit**. Toast: **Sale updated successfully**.

Slabs you remove go back to inventory (with their sinks and faucets). Switching **Full Slab Sold** on removes the unsold remnant; switching it off creates one.

#### Unsell (cancel the sale)

1. In the edit dialog, click the red **Unsell** button.
2. **Unsell Sale** asks *Are you sure you want to cancel this sale?* — click **Confirm** (or **Cancel**).
3. The sale is marked cancelled, its slabs, sinks and faucets return to stock, and unsold remnants it created are removed (remnants another sale bought are kept). Toast: **Sale unsold**. You return to the catalog.

---

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **How do I add a room, or add, replace or remove a slab on a sale?** Open the stone's slab list → **Edit** on the sold (red) slab → change its rooms and slabs (**Add Room** for another room) → **Submit**. Admins can also do it in **Admin > Transactions** → the sale's details (**Add Room**, **Add Slab**).
- **I don't see Sell or Edit on the slab rows.** They show only for users with the **Sales Representative** position (set in **Admin > Company settings > Users**). Anyone can still start a sale with **Sell Slab** at the top of the catalog.
- **Add Slab / Add Sink does nothing.** Pick the room's **Stone** first.
- **A stone is missing from the catalog.** It may be sold out (turn on **Show sold out**), hidden by an admin (**Display** off), filtered out by a sidebar filter (**Clear** them), or have no photo (search for it).
- **A stone doesn't come up in Stone Search.** Employee search skips hidden stones and stones with no free whole slab (unless **Regular Stock**).
- **A slab disappeared from the list.** Slabs marked cut in the shop, or deleted by an admin, are no longer listed.
- **Why is there a yellow slab after my sale?** **Full Slab Sold** was off, so a remnant was kept. Edit the sale and turn it on if the whole slab was used.
- **How do I add or change stones, prices or photos?** That is done by an admin in **Admin > Inventory > Stones**.
- **A stone named "Onboarding Sample Granite" appears.** It is the guided tour's sample; it only shows during the tour and selling it saves nothing.
- **Where do I see the sale afterwards?** On **Transactions** in the sidebar. Shop workers mark slabs cut from their own **Transactions** page.

## eSignatures (Sending Documents for Signature)

Send a PDF to a customer to sign online, follow its status, and download the signed copy. Requests are sent from an email (any PDF attachment) or from a quote (**Contract**). The **eSignatures** page lists every request.

**Where to find it:** sidebar **Resources > eSignatures**, in the Employee portal and the Admin portal.

**Who can see and use it:**

- The **eSignatures** sidebar item and the **Request signature** options only appear when eSignatures is turned on for your company. A platform superuser turns it on.
- To **send** a document for signature, your user account also needs **Signatures access**. A platform superuser grants it per user. Without it, trying to send shows **Signatures access required**: *Ask your manager for access to signatures before you can send a document for signing.*
- **Employee > Resources > eSignatures** shows only the requests **you** sent.
- **Admin > Resources > eSignatures** shows the **whole company's** requests, with an extra **User** column for who sent each one. It is view-only: no cancel there.

---

### Sending a document from an email

Works in the email composers (**CRM > Emails** compose, a deal's or customer's email thread, the quote **Email** dialog). Only **PDF** files can be signed.

1. Start a new email to the customer.
2. Either:
   - Open the paperclip / attachment menu and choose **Request signature**, then pick a PDF from your computer; or
   - Attach a PDF first, then click **Sign** on the attachment tile.
3. The **Request signature** editor opens (see below). Set up fields, signer and reminders, then click **Add to email**.
4. The attachment tile now shows an **eSign** badge. Click it for **Edit signature fields** or **Remove signature request**.
5. Send the email.

**What the customer receives:** your email message on a branded card with a **View & Complete Document** button (or a **Review and sign [file]** button per document when there are several). The unsigned PDF is not attached. If you left the subject empty it becomes *Signature requested on "[document]"*; an empty body becomes *Please review and sign the document.*

---

### Sending a contract from a quote

1. Open the quote (sidebar **Quotes**, then open a quote).
2. Click **Actions** → **Contract** at the top of the quote.
3. If your company has more than one contract form, **Send Contract** opens: choose the **Contract form** and click **Continue**. With one form it starts right away. Contract forms are set up in **Admin > Quotes**, **Forms** tab. A company with no quote forms at all gets a built-in contract. If the company has forms but none of them is a contract, **Contract** is greyed out (*Add a contract form in Admin › Quotes › Forms*).
4. The contract PDF is built from the quote and opens in **Send Contract for Signature** (the contract must stay attached and marked for signature, or sending stops with **Signature required** · *<file> must be sent for signature.*). To is the quote's email (from **Edit Quote Address**), and the signer is whoever is in To. The subject is *Contract - [quote name]*, and there is a short default message. The contract is already marked for signing, with signature fields on its signature lines and reminders on.
5. The signer is whoever is first in **To** when you send. Change the recipient to change who signs.
6. Click **Send**.

The quote page then shows a **Contracts** section: **Document Name**, **Status**, **Sent Date**, **Signed Date**, **Sent To**, **Signer**. Click a document name to open it.

---

### The Request signature editor

The left side shows the PDF, with page arrows (**Page 1 / 3**) and zoom buttons (click the percentage to reset). The right side has four steps:

**1. Build the form**

- Pick a field type, then click the page to place it. Press **Esc** to stop placing.
  - **Signature**: the customer signs here.
  - **Date signed**: filled in automatically when they sign (*Filled on signing*).
  - **Text**: you fill it in, or leave it empty for the customer to fill.
  - **Check**: you tick a box on the PDF (prints ✓).
  - **Uncheck**: you clear a box that is already ticked on the PDF (prints ☐ over it).
- **Auto-detect fields** finds signature lines and blanks in the PDF and places fields for you (the AI labels each blank as a signature, date or text field: *Detecting…*, *Improving labels…*). If nothing is found: *No signature line or blanks found. Pick a field and click the page.* If the PDF can't be read: *Could not read this PDF. Place the fields manually.*
- Drag a placed field to move it, drag its corner to resize it (**Resize field**), or remove it (**Remove field**).

**2. Signer**

- **Signer name** and **Signer email**. Typing an email suggests matching contacts. In the email composer they default to the email's customer.

**3. Fields** (*N placed · N for customer*), grouped by page:

- **Text** fields: type text to print it on the PDF, or leave it as *Customer fills in*. Select a field to give it a **Label** (*Field label*) or pick **Fill from** (**Custom text** keeps your own text): Customer name, Company name, Billing address (full, line 1 or line 2), Email, Phone, Today's date, Your name or Your email. Options marked *(not on file)* have no value for this customer.
- **Date** fields: type a date or click **Today**, or leave empty (*Signer fills*).
- **Signature** fields: *Signer fills* by default. Click **Sign** to add **your own** signature (it is printed on the PDF; **Clear** removes it): type your name (*Type your name to sign*) and pick a style (**Classic**, **Elegant**, **Flowing**, **Casual** or **Handwritten**), or **Draw instead** (**Type instead** goes back), then **Use signature**.
- **Check** / **Uncheck** fields: the button (*Switch between ticked and empty*) switches between ticked and empty (**Prints ✓** / **Prints ☐**).
- Trash icon removes a field. At least one signature must be left for the customer: *Leave at least one signature for the customer to sign.*
- Until a file is picked the preview says *Select a PDF to preview*.
- Messages that stop **Add to email**: *Choose a PDF to request a signature.*, *Enter a valid signer email.*, *Add a signature field, or click Auto-detect.*, *Add at least one signature field.*; on a field: *Field is too small*, *Checkmark is empty*, *Value is too long* (the text does not fit the box).

**4. Reminders**

- On by default (the **Send reminders** switch): *If they have not signed, email them on day 3, 6 and 10.* Turn off for *No follow-up emails*. Reminder emails have the subject *Signature reminder: [document]*.

Click **Add to email** to confirm, or **Cancel**. A request can have up to 20 fields.

---

### What the signer sees

The customer clicks the button in the email and lands on **Review and sign**. Depending on your company's setup, the document opens either in Granite Manager's own signing page or in an embedded SignWell signing screen.

On Granite Manager's signing page:

1. **Click to start**, then **Next field** moves to each field (the header shows *N of N fields*). Each field says *This field is required.* or *This field is optional.*
2. Signature fields (*Type or draw your signature.*): **Type** your name (*Type your name to sign*, **Choose a style**) or **Draw**, then **Apply** (*By selecting Apply, I agree that this mark is my electronic signature.*). Date fields ask to choose a date (**Use today's date**). **Clear field** empties a field. Date signed fields are *Filled in automatically when you finish signing*.
3. When all required fields are done (*All required fields are complete. Confirm to sign*), **Finish** opens **Finish signing**: tick the consent box and click **Finish signing**.
4. The page shows **Document signed** with **Download signed document**.

The document viewer has **Show pages** / **Hide pages** (page thumbnails), **Previous page** / **Next page**, **Go to page** and **Fit to width**. *A field value does not fit on the PDF. Check it before finishing.* means a typed value is too long for its box. If the connection drops while finishing: *Connection interrupted. Reopen the page to check completion.* (**Check current status**, **Retry completion**).

- The **PDF** button in the header opens the document.
- **…** (More options) > **Decline document** opens **Decline to sign?** with an optional **Reason** (*Reason (optional)*), then **Confirm decline**. The sender is told, and the link can't be used to sign afterwards.
- A canceled or expired link shows **Link expired**: *This signing link has expired. Contact the sender for a new request.*
- A broken link shows *This signing link is not valid.*
- A declined document shows *This document was declined.*; one still being prepared shows **Not ready yet** (*This document is not ready for signing.*).

**Where else signature requests show:** the customer's **Documents & Signatures** page lists the signature requests sent to them from emails (*Signature requests sent from email will appear here.* when none). It has no tab in the Customer Information window: it opens from the **Open in Granite Manager** button of a signature email when the request has no deal.

---

### What happens after you send

- The sender gets an **email** when the customer **opens**, **signs** or **declines** the document. The subject reads like *Jordan Smith signed Contract - Smith Kitchen*, and the email's title is *Your Document Has Been Viewed*, *Your Document Has Been Signed* or *Your Document Was Declined*. Its **Open in Granite Manager** button opens the deal's **Project** tab, or the customer's documents if there is no deal. These updates come by email only, not in the notification bell.
- On the deal, **History** (All) shows **Contract sent** and **Contract signed** entries for quote contracts.
- In the email thread, the sent attachment shows its status: **Signature requested**, **Viewed**, **Signed**, **Declined** or **Expired**.
- The signed copy is saved in Granite Manager. Open it from **Resources > eSignatures** or from the quote's **Contracts** section.

---

### The eSignatures page

Shows *No signature requests yet* until something is sent.

**Toolbar:**

- **Status filter** (with counts): **All statuses**, **Awaiting Signature** (Draft, Sent or Viewed), **Signed**, **Viewed**, **Declined** (only listed when there are some), **Canceled**.
- **Search**: by name, email or document (*Search by name, email, or document*; admins can also search by user).

**Columns:** **Document** (name, with *Agreement · status · customer* under it), **Status**, **Customer**, **Email** (signer), **User** (admin page only; click to sort by user A–Z, again for Z–A, each user's newest first), **Sent** (click to sort newest/oldest first), **Signed** (date signed). On small screens some columns are hidden.

**Statuses:**

| Badge | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| **Sent** | Delivered, not opened yet |
| **Viewed** | The signer opened it |
| **Signed** | Completed (*1 of 1 completed*) |
| **Declined** | The signer declined |
| **Canceled** | You canceled the request, or it expired. The quote **Contracts** section also shows **Canceled**; email status shows **Expired**. |
| **Draft** | Not sent yet |

**Actions:**

- Click a row to open the document (the signed copy once signed, otherwise the document as sent).
- The **⋮** menu has **View**, **Download** and, on the Employee page, **Cancel request**.

---

### Canceling a request

1. **Resources > eSignatures** (Employee page) > row **⋮** > **Cancel request**, or on the quote page, **Contracts** row **⋮** > **Cancel contract**.
2. Confirm in **Cancel this signature request?** (*[Signer] will no longer be able to sign [document].*) with **Cancel request**, or **Keep it**. **Notify the customer by email** (ticked to start) also emails the signer that the request was canceled (toast *Request canceled · [Signer] was emailed.*, or *The email to [Signer] could not be sent.*). Untick it to cancel without telling them.

The status becomes **Canceled**, the signing link stops working, and no more reminders go out. You can only cancel requests **you** sent. Signed, declined or already canceled ones show **This request cannot be canceled** (*Already signed. Send a new contract to change it.* / *Already declined by the customer.* / *Already canceled.*). To change a signed contract, send a new one.

---

### Common questions

- **I don't see eSignatures in the sidebar.** eSignatures is not turned on for your company.
- **"Signatures access required" when I click Contract or Request signature.** Your account doesn't have Signatures access yet. Ask your manager; access is granted by the platform team.
- **Request signature is missing for my file.** Only PDF files can be signed.
- **Can I see what other reps sent?** Only on **Admin > Resources > eSignatures**, which needs Admin access.
- **Can an admin cancel someone else's request?** No. Only the person who sent it can cancel it, from their Employee eSignatures page.
- **Where do I download the signed contract?** **Resources > eSignatures** > row **⋮** > **Download**, or click the document in the quote's **Contracts** section.
- **The customer didn't get reminders.** Reminders only go out on days 3, 6 and 10 while the request is unsigned, and only if **Reminders** was on.

## Granite Phone app (iPhone and Android): calls, texts, contacts, CRM tabs and phone settings

**Granite Phone** is Granite Manager's own phone app for reps: business calls from the company's numbers (through Telnyx), texts, voicemail and call recordings, plus the CRM on the phone (contacts, deals, customers, quotes, stones, schedule, emails). Installers and template makers get a schedule-only version. It works for companies on **Granite Phone (Telnyx)**; an admin gives each person their numbers on **Admin > Company settings > Phone** (see *Granite Phone (Telnyx)*).

**Getting it:** while it is rolled out, the Granite Manager team gives your company the app to install (ask them for the install link). Sign in with your **Granite Manager email and password**. *Update required* means the app is older than the company's minimum version: tap **Update**.

**Related sections:** Granite Phone (Telnyx) admin page · Phone calls in the CRM · My Account (Signed-in devices, Recording voice) · My Schedule (installers and template technicians).

---

### First setup on a phone

After signing in, the app walks through what calls need, one step at a time: **Notifications**, **Microphone**, **Nearby devices (Bluetooth)**, **Full-screen call alerts**, **Keep the app awake** / **Unrestricted battery use** (on Samsung phones also add Granite Manager to **Never sleeping apps**: Settings › Battery › Background usage limits). Then two notices to accept with **I understand**: call recording (what your company records: *Callers hear "This call may be recorded" before your phone rings…*) and emergency calls (*Granite Manager can't call 911. Emergency numbers open your phone's dialer and use your carrier.*). Last, a **Test call** (**Call me**: the server calls the phone; **It rang** or **Try again**, or **Skip**), then **You're all set** → **Start calling**.

---

### The tabs and More

The bottom bar holds up to 5 tabs and a **More** button with the rest. A new install has **Phone**, **Text**, **Contacts**, **Schedule** and **Emails** on the bar, and **Deals**, **Customers**, **Stones**, **Suppliers**, **Images**, **Transactions** and **Quotes** in **More**. **More** → **Customize tabs**: drag a tab by **≡** (or **Move up** / **Move down**) above or below the **Navigation bar** line (2 to 5 tabs on the bar); **Reset** puts the default back. **Text** stays even while texting is off for the company (it then says *Texting isn't set up for your company yet*). Your picture at the top opens **My profile**: **My numbers** (the **Default** one marked), **My status** and **Settings**.

---

### Phone tab: Keypad, Calls, Voicemail, Recordings

- **Keypad** — type a number, or a name in **Name or number** (contacts and coworkers are suggested). **Paste a number**. **My caller ID** picks which of your numbers this call comes from (the default is set in **Settings › Default caller ID**).
- **Calls** (recent calls) — **All** / **Missed**, **Search calls**. Tap a call for actions (**Call**, **Text**, **Details**, **Add**); **Call details** lists every call with that number, plays recordings, and offers **Create contact** / **Add to existing** for an unknown number. *Possible spam* marks a call the carriers flagged. **Select calls** to delete several. **Total call time** shows your talk time **Today**, **This week** and **This month**.
- **Voicemail** — **All** / **Unread**, search; tap one to listen.
- **Recordings** — your recorded calls, with search.
- The **⋮** menu has **Call health check** and **Settings**.

**Calling:** tap a contact's or deal's **Call**, or dial on the keypad. Calls go out from your business number. With no data connection (or when the app can't connect), **Call via my cell** calls your own cell first: answer and press 1, and the customer sees your business number (set it up in **Settings › Cell fallback**). The app needs the microphone (*Granite Manager needs the microphone to make calls. Allow it in Settings.*).

**During a call:** **Mute** / **Unmute**, **Keypad** (tones for phone menus; **Hide keypad**), **Audio** (phone, speaker or Bluetooth), **Hold** / **Resume** (callers hear your hold music), **Add note** (*It goes on the deal as a note when the call ends*). **Recording** shows while the call is recorded. For a known customer the strip at the top has **Open deal**. A second call shows **Incoming call** with **Decline** and **Hold & answer**; with one on hold, **Swap** switches calls and **End** ends the one on hold. After a call: **Add note now**, **Call back**.

**Incoming calls** ring on every phone you are signed in on, as a full-screen call (**Answer** / **Decline**). Calls that don't ring you (Do not disturb, outside your hours) still show in **Calls**.

### Contacts and coworkers

**Contacts** lists the company's customers with a phone number: **Filter contacts** → **My customers** (customers you are the sales rep of) or **All contacts**; **Search contacts**. A contact card has **Call** and **Text** (asks which number when there are two) and the customer's details: **Contact**, **Project**, **Deals**, **History** (**All**, **Activities**, **Notes**, **Calls**, **Emails**) and **Projects**. **Coworkers** lists people at your company with a phone number.

**New contact** (the **+**): **First name**, **Last name**, **Company name**, **Phone number**, **Email**, **Address** → **Save**. It is saved to Granite Manager as a customer: *You'll be the sales rep, and an open deal is created for them.* **Add to contact** (from an unknown number) adds the number to an existing customer; a customer with two numbers asks to replace **phone 2**.

### Text (texts)

Texts with customers on your company numbers, newest first: **All** / **Unread**, **Search texts**, and **Lines** to show **All my lines** or one number. **New text** (**To: name or number**; US and Canadian numbers only). In a conversation: **Call**, **Mark as read** / **Mark as unread**, **Mute conversation**, **Add to favorites**, **Copy number**. The **+** in the composer adds **AI reply**, **Upload from phone**, **From Stones**, **From Images**, **From Documents**, **Use Template** and **Improve message**. **Send later** (hold **Send**) schedules a text: a quick time (**In 1 hour**, **This evening**, **Tomorrow morning**, **Tomorrow afternoon**, **Monday morning**) or **Pick date & time**, with **Cancel if they reply** (*Not sent when the customer writes first*). Scheduled texts show above the box as **N scheduled texts**; tap it to see them (*Cancels if they message* marks the ones that drop when the customer writes first): **Edit** changes the text, day and time (**Save**), **Delete** asks *Are you sure you want to delete this scheduled message?*, **Send now** sends it at once. **Undo send:** a sent text waits 10 seconds (*Sending… 10s* above the box) before it goes out; **Undo** puts it back in the box. Sending another text, leaving the conversation or switching away from the app sends it at once; a scheduled text has no undo. **Typing suggestions:** while you type, the AI may show the rest of the sentence in gray; tap the arrow at its end or swipe right across the box to add it. An empty box gets a suggested opener when the customer texted last, or you did more than 8 hours ago. Typing phrases like "our inventory" offers **Insert inventory link** (your public stone catalog); "measurements" or "online quote" offers **Insert quote link** (the customer quote page, where the customer sends their sizes); **×** hides it. A failed text shows **Tap to send again**. Texting needs the company's texting set up (Telnyx messaging and an approved texting registration).

### Emails

Your CRM mailbox (the same as **CRM > Emails**): **Folder:** **Inbox**, **Sent**, **Drafts** or **Trash**, **All** / **Unread**, **Search subject, text, or addresses**, **Select** to **Mark as read** / **Mark as unread** / **Delete** (**Undelete** and **Delete forever** in Trash). A conversation has **Reply**, **Reply all**, **Forward**, **Read by client** (the customer opened it), **Send later** (hold **Send**; scheduled replies show above the box as **N scheduled emails**, with **Edit**, **Delete** and **Send now** as for texts) and the **+** tools (attachments, templates, **AI reply**: **Fast reply**, **Follow up** or **Custom**). A reply waits 10 seconds with **Undo** before it goes out, and the reply box has the same typing suggestions and link offers as a text (an opener when the customer wrote last). **New email**: **To**, **Cc/Bcc**, **Subject**, message. Pictures can be drawn on before sending (**Draw on**).

An event opens **Event details**: time, address (tap for directions in Maps), customer, **Invoice #**, **People**, **History**, photos and **Comment**. Admins can look at it as an installer or template maker (**See the app as** → **Installer** / **Template maker**, **Standard view** to go back).

**Installers and template makers** get only **My Schedule**: their own jobs by **Day** or **Month**, **Directions**, **The day's route in Google Maps**, and each job's details, photos and comments. With location allowed *all the time*, jobs switch to **On my way** and **Arrived** by themselves (*Turn on location so your jobs switch to On my way and Arrived by themselves.*); the phone reports its place from 5 AM to 9 PM on days with a job that isn't **Completed**. The **On my way** button (which texts the customer) and **Completed** are on the web schedule (see *My Schedule*). They have no calling.

### Settings

**Calling**
- **Default caller ID** — the number customers see when you call them (*You can still pick another one on the keypad.*). *No numbers to call from: Ask your admin to give you a number.*
- **Availability and hours** — **My status**: **Available** or **Do not disturb** (**For 1 hour**, **Until tomorrow 8:00 AM**, **Until turned off**, or until a time you pick). While it is on your phones don't ring. **Working hours**: **Always available** (calls ring at any time) or **Calls ring only in the hours below** (each day's start and end, **Time zone**); *Outside these hours, calls go to the AI assistant or voicemail.* Calls that don't ring you still show in Recents.
- **Cell fallback** — **Your cell**: verify it (**Call me with a code**, type the 6-digit code you hear). **Ring my cell when I don't answer**: after about 15 seconds your cell rings; press 1 to take the call. Also used for **Call via my cell**.
- **Ring timeout** — how long your phones ring before the call goes to the AI assistant or voicemail (**Default** or a choice of seconds).
- **Incoming call rules** — **Forward all calls** (to **Voicemail** or **A phone number**; *Do not disturb wins over forwarding*), **Do not disturb**, **My work day** and your own rules. **Add rule**: **Name** (e.g. *After hours*), **Rule is on**, **When these callers call** (contacts or numbers; none = anyone), **At these times** (**Any time** or **Only at certain times**, **Starts** / **Ends**), **When they call** (which of your numbers; none = any), then **Ring my phones** (even outside your working hours), **Forward to a number** (US or Canada), **Send to voicemail** or **Play a message and hang up** (type what callers hear). The first matching rule that is on decides. On a line that rings several people, your rule only decides whether *your* phones ring.
- **Incoming call information** — **Incoming number**: show **The caller's own number** or **The company number they dialed**, and **If number is blocked or unknown show my number instead**. **Play announcement** before connecting (the line called and who is calling): **Direct calls** and **Shared line calls**, **Include line name in announcement**. **Require my PIN to answer call** (for calls rung to your cell: it asks for your 4-digit PIN instead of "press 1"; **Change PIN**).
- **Hold music** — what callers hear while on hold: a built-in track (**Play** to listen), **Upload your own** (MP3 or WAV; use only music you have the rights to), or **None** (*Callers hear silence*).

**Company** (admins only) — **Spam and blocked numbers**, *for everyone in the company*: **Spam call handling** (*Rings as usual and shows as possible spam*, *Gets the action for blocked calls* or *Goes to voicemail without ringing anyone*; spam = a call whose caller ID failed the carriers' check or that Telnyx's call screening marks as spam), **Blocked numbers or area codes**, **Block calls with no caller ID**, **Action for blocked calls** (*Callers hear the announcement, then the call ends*, *The call is rejected at once*, or *Callers can leave a voicemail; nothing rings*; **Announcement** text), and **Trusted numbers** (never blocked, not even as spam). Tap **SAVE**: *Saved. It applies to the next call.*

**Other settings**
- **Call health check** — checks notifications, full-screen alerts, microphone, battery, background and connection, with **Fix** for each problem, and **Place a test call** (*Our server calls this phone and plays a short message*). *Your company doesn't take calls in Granite Manager…* means calling is off for the company.
- **Report a problem** — *Tell us what went wrong and about when it happened* → **Send**.
- **Test notifications** — pick one (**Added an Activity**, **Added a Note**, **Activity Reminder**, **Installation Reminder**, **New lead**, **Lead assigned to you**, **Online quote finished**, **Maintenance due today**…) and tap **Start**: it arrives in a few seconds as the real one would.
- **Signed-in devices** — every phone signed in to your account; **Sign out this phone** stops it from ringing for your calls.
- **About** (version, privacy policy, terms, **Email support**) and **Sign out** (*Calls stop ringing on this phone until you sign in again. Your call history is kept.*).

The app also receives the CRM's alerts as phone notifications (new emails and texts, deal activity, reminders, new leads, missed calls) instead of Telegram.

### Common questions

- **How do I turn on Do not disturb?** Settings › **Availability and hours** › **Do not disturb** (for an hour, until tomorrow morning, until turned off, or until a time). Or tap your picture › **My status**.
- **How do I forward my calls?** Settings › **Incoming call rules** › **Forward all calls** → **A phone number** (or **Voicemail**). For some callers or times only, **Add rule**.
- **My phone doesn't ring.** Run Settings › **Call health check** and fix what it lists (on Samsung: **Never sleeping apps** and **Unrestricted** battery). Check **Do not disturb** and your **Working hours**, and that an admin ticked **Rings** for you on the number.
- **How do I change the number customers see?** Settings › **Default caller ID**, or **My caller ID** on the keypad for one call.
- **How do I block a number?** Admins: Settings › **Spam and blocked numbers** › **Blocked numbers or area codes** → **SAVE**.
- **Can I call 911?** Not through Granite Manager: emergency numbers open your phone's own dialer.
- **I have no data.** Use **Call via my cell** (set up your cell in **Cell fallback** first).

## Header, Layout, Tours & Report a Bug

This section covers the top bar (header) on Employee and Admin pages, how the screen is laid out on a computer and on a phone, the **Todo List**, guided tours and **New** labels, and **Report a Bug**.

### The header (top bar)

**On a computer**, from left to right:

- **Company logo** — click it to go to the home page. The logo and its height are set in **Admin > Company settings > Company** (Manager position with Admin access). With no logo uploaded, the spot stays empty.
- **Admin** / **Employee** — switches between the Admin and Employee views. Shown to users with Admin access, the **Super Admin** position, or platform superusers. Regular employees don't have it.
- **Customer** / **Employee** — opens the customer showroom view of your inventory (the link you can share with customers); on the showroom it reads **Employee** and takes you back.
- **Company selector** (placeholder **Switch Company**) — only for **Super Admins** assigned to more than one company.
- **View as** selector — only for platform superusers (Granite Manager staff).
- **Bell** (notifications) and **Todo List** — on the right.

**On a phone**, the top bar shows the logo, the bell, **Todo List** and the **☰** menu button. The **Admin**/**Employee**, **Customer**/**Employee**, **Users** and company selector controls are at the top of the **☰** menu instead. While a CloudTalk SMS conversation is open on a phone, the top bar is hidden so the conversation gets the full screen.

#### Switching between Admin and Employee

1. Click **Admin** in the header (on a phone: **☰** → **Admin** at the top of the menu).
2. You land on the same kind of page on the other side when one exists: Customers, Stones, Sinks, Faucets, Suppliers, Supports, Documents, Images, Instructions, eSignatures, Deals, Transactions, Emails, SMS, Schedule, Quotes and Report a Bug. From any other page you land on the home page of that view: **Dashboard** for Employee, **Stones** for Admin.
3. Click **Employee** to go back.

A quote, its drawing or the quotes list switches to the other side's **Quotes** page.

#### Customer button (showroom view)

1. On any Employee or Admin page click **Customer**. The customer showroom opens in the same tab, on its **Stones** page (keeping your filters). If you were looking at one stone, the showroom opens that stone.
2. Copy the address from the browser's address bar and send it to the customer. It needs no login.
3. Click **Employee** in the header to return to the staff view (the same stone, if one was open).

On a phone, **Customer** is at the top of the **☰** menu.

#### Switching company (Super Admins)

1. Open the company selector in the header (on a phone: top of the **☰** menu).
2. Pick the company. The page reloads and everything you see is now that company's data.

If it fails you see **Error — Could not switch company**. Platform superusers on an Admin page also get a **Users** button at the top of the phone menu.

#### View as (platform superusers only)

The **View as** selector shows the screens a position sees: **Superuser** (your normal view), **Installer**, **Template**, **Marketing** or **Check-in**. Picking one opens that portal's home page. Only the screens change; your own access stays the same. Pick **Superuser** to return. The selector is also in the header of those portals, next to **Logout**.

#### Other headers

- **Shop, installer, template, marketing and walk-in portals** show a simpler header: logo, company name and a **Logout** button.

### Todo List

A personal to-do list, private to you, saved to your account. It opens from the **Todo List** button in the header, on computers and phones.
