### Guided tours, New labels and walkthroughs

There are two kinds of help built into the app.

| | **Tours** (new features) | **Guided walkthrough** |
|---|---|---|
| What | Short tours of one feature (your dashboard, sales goal, automated follow-up, Improve message). Some ask you to do the real thing. | A step-by-step tour of each area (Stones, Customers, Deals, Emails, SMS, Suppliers, Instructions, Special Order, Checklists, Transactions, Chat, AI Design, Todo List, Notifications, My Account, plus Admin and Company areas for admins) |
| Points | Yes (**+N points**) | No |
| Who | Only when your company's **Onboarding** feature is turned on by Granite Manager | Everyone on Employee/Admin pages; shop accounts get shop screens |
| Where to start | Automatically, or **Dashboard** → **Onboarding** widget → **Tours** | **Dashboard** → **Onboarding** widget → **Guided walkthrough** (shop accounts: **My Account**) |

#### The tours and their points

| Tour | Points | Where | What you do |
|------|--------|-------|-------------|
| **Your dashboard** | 5 | Dashboard | See your month at a glance and where **Edit** lets you shape the page. |
| **Arrange your dashboard** | 10 | Dashboard (*Press Edit*) | In edit mode, move a widget and see where **Add widget** puts more. |
| **Add dashboard widgets** | 10 | Dashboard (*Press Add widget*) | Choose one or more widgets and add them together (step *Put them on*). |
| **Set your sales goal** | 10 | Dashboard (*Add the Sales goal widget*) | Set the monthly sales goal your progress is measured against (step *Set your goal*). |
| **Open automated follow-up** | 10 | Deals (*Open a deal*) | Open the automated texts and emails that stop when the customer replies (step *Open the follow-ups*). |
| **Draft a follow-up** | 10 | Deals (*Press Generate*) | Generate editable messages from the customer conversation, without sending them (step *Draft one*). |
| **Set up your texting line** | 10 | My Account | Save your own texting line so automated follow-up works on deals. |
| **Improve message** | 5 | A deal's Email or SMS draft | Improve a draft for clarity and tone before sending it. Starting it from the Onboarding widget opens **Try Improve message**: a rough practice draft (*Draft to improve*) to fix with **✦ Improve**. |
| **Black theme** | 10 | My Account | Switch the app to the black theme (step *Try the black theme*). |
| **Add email name** | 10 | My Account | Set the name people see in **From**. |
| **Add email signature** | 10 | My Account | Add the signature on your outgoing email. |
| **Connect Telegram** | 10 | Dashboard | Connect Telegram for leads and notifications. |

The three follow-up tours appear only when the company has automated follow-up tours on and a texting provider; **Set up your texting line** only while you have no texting line of your own, the other two once you have one. The text in brackets is what reveals a tour that waits behind a click. **Set your sales goal** shows up 24 hours after you first met one of the other Dashboard tours. Some tours also complete, with their points, when you do the thing without the tour: setting your sales goal, switching to the black theme and improving a message (a sales goal set or a message improved before these tours existed counts too).

#### How a tour starts

- **Automatically**, the first time you open the page it belongs to, unless you finished or closed it before. Some tours unlock a day after related ones.
- From the Dashboard's **Onboarding** widget: click a row under **Tours**. If the tour's first control isn't on screen yet, a small note at the bottom tells you what to do (for example **Arrange your dashboard: Press Edit**). Click **✕** (**Hide hint**) to hide it.
- From a **New** announcement: when a new feature becomes available to you, a window with a **New** tag, a short description and **+N points when you finish** may appear once. Click its button (for example **Try it**) to start, or **✕** to close it. Closed announcements don't come back, but the tour stays in the Onboarding widget.
- **New labels:** a blue **New** label next to a sidebar item (currently **Dashboard**) means a tour is waiting on that page. It goes away when you finish or close the tours there.

#### During a tour

- The page dims and one control is highlighted with a card next to it. On a phone the card sits at the bottom of the screen.
- Information cards show **Next**; the last one shows **Finish**.
- **Your turn** cards ask you to do the real action, such as dragging a widget or clicking a button. They have no Next: the tour moves on when you do it. Some show a button that saves what you typed, such as **Done** or **Save**.
- Click **✕** or press Esc to close a tour. A closed tour counts as skipped and won't start by itself again; start it from the **Onboarding** widget.
- Sample items used by tours (for example a sample stone or sample to-do) are demos. Changes to them are not saved, and they disappear when the tour ends.

#### When you finish a tour

A card shows a check mark, **+N points** (or **Completed before.**), the tour name, how many tours of that group you've done (for example **2 of 4 Dashboard tours**) and your **Total** points. Depending on your company it offers **See your points** (opens the Dashboard leaderboard; only when the Leaderboard feature is on), **Next tour** or **Start skipped tour**. The card closes by itself after a few seconds.

#### Improve message offer

While tours are on and you haven't tried **Improve message**, pressing **Send** on an Email or SMS draft first shows a card pointing at **Improve message** (the ✦ button). On a computer it is next to **Send**; on a phone the composer's **…** menu opens and highlights **Improve message** there.

- Click **Improve message** to have the draft rewritten for clarity and tone, then send it yourself.
- Click **Send without Improve** to send the draft as it is.

From the Onboarding widget, the **Improve message** row opens **Try Improve message**: a rough sample draft you can improve with the ✦ button (**Not now** closes it). Improving it completes the task.

#### Guided walkthrough

1. **Dashboard** → **Onboarding** widget → unfold **Guided walkthrough · N of M** and click an area (each row shows its number of steps). The areas: Stones, Customers, Deals, Emails, SMS, Suppliers, Instructions, Teach Mode, Special Order, Checklists, Transactions, Chat, AI Design, Todo List, Notifications and My Account; for admins also Statistics, Admin Stones, Admin Deals, Admin Emails, Manage Suppliers, Manage Images, Manage Instructions, Teach Mode, Admin Transactions, Customer Surveys and User Activities; for Managers Create Users and Company settings. Shop accounts get Transactions, Samples, Maintenance, Chat and My Account.
2. Use **Next** and **Back** (a counter shows **N of M**), or press Enter, or click the dimmed area, to move on. The last step shows **Done**.
3. Finishing one area continues with the next unfinished area automatically.
4. Click **✕** to stop. Walkthroughs then stay off until you start one again from the list.
5. **Restart** (next to the heading) resets walkthrough progress.

When every area is done you land on **My Account** with **You finished onboarding**. Give an **Overall rating** (stars), optional **Comments** (*What worked well? What was confusing?*), then **Submit feedback** (*Thanks for your onboarding feedback.*), or **Skip**.

### Report a Bug

Tell the Granite Manager team about a problem.

**Where:** Employee view → sidebar **Report a Bug** (a top-level item near the bottom). Admins switch to **Employee** first, or click **Admin** while on the page; the same form opens. Available to anyone with Employee or Admin access. Shop, installer, marketing and walk-in accounts don't have it.

1. Open **Report a Bug**. The page is titled **Bug Report Form**.
2. In **What happened?**, describe the problem: what you clicked, what you expected and what happened. This is required (up to 5,000 characters). Put a short summary on the first line; it becomes the report's title.
3. Optionally add files under **Attachments (optional)**: screenshots, photos or other files. Several can be added.
4. Click **Submit**.

- **Bug report sent** — saved and emailed to the Granite Manager team. Replies come to your email address.
- **Bug report saved. Email notification failed.** — saved anyway; the team still sees it.
- **Failed to save bug report** (or another error) — nothing was saved; try again.

The form clears after a successful submit. Reports are listed for platform superusers in **Superuser Dashboard > Bug reports**. You can't see past reports yourself.

## How the application is organized

The app is split into **portals** (separate URL areas). Each portal has its own sidebar and features. After sign-in, users land in the portal that matches their role and positions.

| Portal | Base URL | Typical users |
|--------|----------|---------------|
| **Employee** | `/employee/*` | Sales reps, office staff, estimators, fabricators |
| **Admin** | `/admin/*` | Owners, managers, inventory admins |
| **Shop** | `/shop/*` | Shop-floor workers (Transactions, Samples, Maintenance, My Account) |
| **Installer checklist** | `/installers/:companyId/checklist` | Installers (Installer position) |
| **Template schedule** | `/templates/:companyId/schedule` | Template technicians (Template Guy position) |
| **Customer (showroom)** | `/customer/:companyId/*` | Customers browsing stones, sinks, faucets; kiosk display |
| **Contractors** | `/contractors/:companyId/*` | Contractor-facing stone catalog |
| **Marketing** | `/external/marketing/:companyId/*` | Outside marketing team (leads only) |

**Customer-facing links** (no login): the quote portal link a customer gets for a quote, the **online quote** (`/customer/:companyId/quote`, where customers draw their own countertops and send them in), the e-signature page for signing documents, and the post-install survey.

**Granite Phone app** (iPhone and Android): business calls and texts from the company's numbers plus the CRM on the phone; installers and template technicians get their own schedule in it.

## Invoices (create invoices from quotes, Resources > Invoices, QuickBooks invoices on customers)

Granite Manager makes invoices in two ways:

- **With QuickBooks** (QuickBooks turned on for the company and connected): **Create invoice** on a quote creates a **QuickBooks** invoice, and each customer's QuickBooks invoices show on the customer, where you open the PDF, email it and edit it (by hand or with AI); changes are saved back to QuickBooks.
- **Without QuickBooks**: Granite Manager's own invoices, in **Resources > Invoices**: create them there or from a quote, email them to the customer as a PDF, mark them paid or void them.

**Requirements for the QuickBooks parts:** QuickBooks must be **turned on** for your company (done by the Granite Manager team) **and connected** by your company (Admin > Company settings > Company → **Connect QuickBooks**). See **QuickBooks** for connecting. If either is missing, the QuickBooks section does not appear on customers and quotes invoice through Granite Manager's own invoices.

**Who can use it:** every employee and admin of the company. *"Connected. Everyone in this company can see QuickBooks invoices on customer info."*

---

### Creating an invoice from a quote

1. Open the quote → **Actions** → **Create invoice** (sold or not). With several color options and none sold, pick the option to invoice; a sold quote invoices its sold option.
2. The invoice editor opens filled in from that option: its lines, the customer, the project address and the quote's tax.
3. **Company with QuickBooks** — the QuickBooks editor (*Check the line items, addresses, and memo, then create it in QuickBooks.*): **Txn date**, **Due date**, **Class** (a dropdown of your QuickBooks classes), **CC** and **BCC** for the invoice email, billing and shipping address, line items (**Product or service** from your QuickBooks products and services, **Description**, **Qty**, **Unit**), customer memo and private note. Nothing reaches QuickBooks until you click:
   - **Create in QuickBooks** — toast **Invoice created** (*Invoice # … is in QuickBooks.*).
   - **Create and send** — creates it, then opens the email to the customer with the QuickBooks PDF attached (*Opening email…*).
   - The draft learns from your company: the changes your team keeps making to new invoices (never amounts) are applied when it opens, and so are the **Invoice instructions for AI** (below). Lines it left out are listed as *Left out: …* with **Add back**.
4. **Company without QuickBooks** — the Granite Manager invoice editor (*From quote "…". Saved in Granite Manager and emailed to the customer as a PDF.*), the same as **New invoice** below. The invoice then appears in **Resources > Invoices**.

#### Invoice instructions for AI (QuickBooks companies)

**Admin > Company settings > Company** → **QuickBooks** card → **Invoice instructions for AI**: *Create invoice already learns from your invoices. Tell it what it should always do, e.g. "Use Package $11999 only when the quote has cabinets, otherwise Sales. Leave out Fabrication when there are cabinets." Prices are never changed.* Type the rules (up to 4,000 characters, **How should your invoices look?**) → **Save instructions**. Toast **Instructions saved** (*New invoices follow N rules.*), or **Instructions removed** when emptied. **What the AI understood** lists each rule as it will apply it, followed by anything it could not understand.

---

### Resources > Invoices (Granite Manager's own invoices)

**Where:** sidebar **Resources > Invoices**, in the Employee and Admin portals. Everyone in the company sees every invoice.

- **Search by number, name, email or address**, and the status buttons **All**, **Draft**, **Sent**, **Paid**, **Void**.
- Columns: **#**, **Date**, **Bill to**, **Project**, **Due** (*On receipt* when there is no due date), **Total**, **Status**. Click a column title to sort; click a row to open the invoice.
- The row's **⋯** (**Invoice actions**) menu: **Open**, **View PDF**, **Email to customer**, **Mark paid** (or **Mark unpaid** on a paid one), **Void** (or **Restore** on a void one, back to Sent or Draft).
- *No invoices yet. Create one here, or from a quote's Actions menu.*

**New invoice** (or **Open**):

1. **Customer** — search and pick a customer (locked on an invoice made from a quote).
2. **Invoice #** (the next number is filled in when left empty), **Date**, **Due** (empty: due on receipt).
3. **Bill to** (name), **Email** (*Where the invoice is sent*) and **Project address**.
4. Lines: **Description**, quantity and rate per line; **Add line** adds a priced line, **Add note** a text line with no price; the trash removes one (**Remove line**).
5. **Message to the customer** (printed on the invoice) and **Private note** (*Only your team sees this*).
6. Subtotal, **Tax ($)** (an amount, not a percent) and **Total**.
7. **Save draft** (new) / **Save**, or **Save and send**: saves, then opens the email to the customer with the invoice PDF attached (subject *<Company> Invoice #N*).

**Statuses:** **Draft** (not sent), **Sent** (emailed; sending a draft marks it sent), **Paid** (marked by hand: Granite Manager does not take payments), **Void** (cancelled; can't be emailed). *The email went out, but the invoice is still a draft* means the email was sent but marking it sent failed: mark it from the list.

---

### Where to find a customer's invoices

1. Go to **CRM > Customers** (Employee or Admin view) and click the customer (or use **Find Customer**).
2. The **Customer Information** dialog opens on the **Company info** tab.
3. Find the **QuickBooks** section (right-hand column on wide screens, above **AI Activity Search** and **Activity**; it stacks below the contact details on narrow screens and phones).

There is no separate **Invoices** tab anymore — old links to a customer's invoices tab open **Company info**.

### Loading invoices

1. The section says *Load invoices from QuickBooks when you need them.* Click **Get invoices**.
2. *Loading invoices…* shows while QuickBooks answers.
3. The list appears, newest first.

After the first load, your browser remembers the list for that customer: next time it shows right away and refreshes from QuickBooks in the background.

**How the customer is matched:** the first time, Granite Manager looks for the QuickBooks customer with the same **email**, then the same **name**, and links them. From then on that QuickBooks customer is used.

#### What the list shows

Wide screens show a table; narrow screens and phones show a compact list with the same information.

| Column | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| **Invoice** | QuickBooks invoice number |
| **Date** | Invoice date |
| **Project** | Shown only when an invoice has one: the invoice's shipping address, or the lines after **Project Address:** in its billing address |
| **Total** | Invoice total |
| **Balance** | Amount still owed (compact list: "$X due") |
| **Status** | **Paid** (green, nothing owed), **Partial** (amber, part paid), **Open** (blue, nothing paid) |

Row actions (pencil = **Edit invoice**, envelope = **Email invoice**) appear when you hover the row with a mouse; on touch screens they are always visible.

#### Messages instead of a list

| Message | Meaning / what to do |
|---------|----------------------|
| **QuickBooks is not connected for this company.** + **Connect in Company settings** | The connection is missing or expired. A Manager with Admin access reconnects it (see **QuickBooks**) |
| **No QuickBooks invoices found for this customer.** | No QuickBooks customer matched this customer's email or name, or they have no invoices. Check the customer's email/name in QuickBooks and in Granite Manager |
| **Failed to load invoices from QuickBooks.** | QuickBooks did not answer or returned an error. Try again later |

### Opening, printing or downloading an invoice

1. Click the invoice row (anywhere except the action icons).
2. A spinner shows next to the number while the PDF downloads from QuickBooks.
3. The official QuickBooks PDF opens in a new browser tab — print or save it from there.

If it fails you see **Could not open invoice** with the reason.

### Emailing an invoice to the customer

1. Click the **envelope** icon on the invoice row.
2. The **Send Email** dialog opens with:
   - **To:** the customer's primary email (or their first email on file).
   - **Subject:** `[Your company name] Invoice` (just **Invoice** if the company has no name).
   - The invoice PDF attached as `Invoice-[number].pdf`.
3. Write your message and send it like any customer email. The email is linked to the customer's first deal.

If the PDF can't be fetched you see **Could not email invoice**.

---

### Editing an invoice

1. Click the **pencil** icon on the invoice row.
2. The **Edit invoice [number]** dialog opens (*Edit line items, addresses, and memo, then save to QuickBooks.*).
3. Change any of:
   - **Customer memo** (message printed on the invoice) and **Private note** (internal).
   - **Txn date** (invoice date) and **Due date**.
   - **Billing address** and **Shipping address** (**Line 1**, **Line 2**, **City**, **State**, **Postal**).
   - **Line items** — **Product or service** (pick from products already used on this invoice, or **-** for a description-only line), **Description**, **Qty**, **Unit** (unit price). **Amount** is calculated as Qty × Unit. The trash icon removes a line. **Add line** adds a new sales line (disabled when the invoice has no products to reuse — toast **Cannot add line**). Subtotal, discount and tax lines are shown greyed and can't be edited. **Total** above the table is the invoice total as QuickBooks last saved it; it updates after you save.
4. Finish with one of:
   - **Save to QuickBooks** — saves. Toast **Invoice updated** — *Changes were saved to QuickBooks.*
   - **Save and send** — saves, then opens the **Send Email** dialog with the updated PDF attached.
   - **Reset** — puts the form back to what QuickBooks had.
   - **Cancel** — closes without saving.

If saving fails you see **Could not save invoice** with QuickBooks' reason (for example when someone changed the invoice in QuickBooks meanwhile — reopen and try again).

#### Edit with AI

1. In the editor click **Edit with AI**. The current invoice PDF is shown full-screen.
2. Type what to change in **Describe the change…** (for example "change the due date to the 30th" or "add a line for sink cutout $150") and press Enter or click **Propose**.
3. A preview shows the **official QuickBooks PDF** of the proposed invoice and a count such as "2 changes · official QuickBooks PDF" (or **No differences detected.**).
4. Choose:
   - **Apply to form** — keeps the change and returns to the form (toast **Applied to form** — *QuickBooks already has this preview. Save again only if you make more edits.*). The preview is already saved in QuickBooks.
   - **Back to AI** — throws the proposal away (QuickBooks is put back the way it was) so you can try another instruction.
   - **Back** (on the AI screen) — returns to the form.

To build the preview, the proposal is saved to QuickBooks temporarily; closing or going **Back to AI** restores the original. If that restore fails you see **Could not discard preview changes** — *QuickBooks may still have the proposed preview. Try again.*

An older admin page titled **Invoices**. It is **not in the sidebar**; it opens only by typing the address, and only for admins.

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **How do I edit an invoice?** **CRM > Customers** → open the customer → **Company info** → **QuickBooks** section → **Get invoices** → the **pencil** on the invoice row → change it in **Edit invoice** → save to QuickBooks.
- **How do I create an invoice?** From a quote: **Actions** → **Create invoice** (a QuickBooks invoice when QuickBooks is connected, else a Granite Manager invoice). Without a quote: **Resources > Invoices** → **New invoice** (Granite Manager invoice), or in QuickBooks Online.
- **I don't see a QuickBooks section on the customer.** QuickBooks is not turned on for your company or not connected. A Manager with Admin access connects it in **Admin > Company settings > Company**; turning the feature on is done by the Granite Manager team.
- **"No QuickBooks invoices found for this customer."** The customer's email/name doesn't match a QuickBooks customer, or there are no invoices yet.
- **Can I record a payment here?** For QuickBooks invoices, no: payments are recorded in QuickBooks; **Balance** and **Status** update from there. A Granite Manager invoice can be marked **Paid** in **Resources > Invoices** (no payment is taken).
- **Can I delete an invoice?** No, only in QuickBooks.
- **Is the deal Amount an invoice?** No. The deal **Amount** is a pipeline number on the deal board. Real invoices are in QuickBooks and shown here.
- **The invoice list looks out of date.** It refreshes from QuickBooks each time you open the customer; wait a moment after it appears.

## Marketing portal (`/external/marketing/:companyId`)

The Marketing portal is a separate workspace for your marketing team or outside marketing agency. Marketing users see the company's leads and walk-ins, how those leads are doing (status, lost/invalid reasons, deals by stage), and can add, edit and delete leads. They cannot open the Employee CRM or Admin pages.

**Where to find it:** Users with the **Marketing** position land on it automatically when they sign in, at `/external/marketing/<company ID>/leads`. Page title: **Marketing**. There is no sidebar; the header shows the company logo, company name and **Logout**.

**Who can see it:** Users with the **Marketing** position for that company, and platform superusers.

---

### Giving someone Marketing access

1. Go to **Admin > Company settings > Users** (needs Admin access plus the Manager position).
2. Find the user and choose **Actions → Edit**.
3. Turn on the **Marketing** position.
4. Under **External Marketing Companies**, switch on each company this user may see. This section appears in the Edit dialog once **Marketing** is selected.
5. Save.

When they sign in, they go straight to the Marketing leads page and are kept inside the portal. If they have more than one company, a **Company** dropdown at the top switches between them.

---

### Leads page

#### Top controls

- **Company** dropdown (only when the user has more than one company).
- **Add Lead** button.
- Date range: **Select start date**, **Select end date**, then **Apply**. **Clear** removes the dates. With no dates, everything is shown. Leads are filtered by the date they came in.
- View tabs:
  - **Leads** — customers whose source is Leads (website, Facebook and other lead forms, and leads added here).
  - **Walk-ins** — visitors who signed in on the walk-in check-in form.
  - **Total** — both together.
- Channel tabs: **All**, plus **Facebook** and **Website** on the **Leads** view only.
  - **Facebook** — referral source facebook or facebook form.
  - **Website** — referral source website, webform or wordpress form.

All counts and tables below follow the chosen view, channel and dates.

#### Summary cards

| Card | What it shows |
|------|---------------|
| **Invalid by Channel** | Pie chart and table (**Channel**, **Leads**) of leads marked invalid: **Facebook**, **Website** (with % of the two) and **Total** |
| **Invalid Reasons** | Bars with count and % per reason: Too expensive, Out of area, Never responded, Wrong number, email, etc., Accident submission, Looking for unrelated service, Bought somewhere else, Stopped responding, Gave up on the project. Counts leads marked invalid with that reason or whose deal was lost for it. |
| **Deals by Stage** | Open deals of these customers per pipeline stage: **Stage**, **Deals**, **Total Amount** |

Leads are marked invalid, and deals marked lost, by the sales team in the CRM. The Marketing portal only reports them.

#### Leads table

Newest first, 50 rows per page (**Prev** / **Next**, **Page x / y**).

| Column | Meaning |

#### Find customer

The **Find customer or company** box searches this company's customers. Click a name to open **Customer Information**, or use the edit and delete icons next to a result. **Show more** loads more results.

### Customer Information dialog

Opens from a table row or a search result. It is read-only.

- **Project:** answers from the lead form when present, such as Location, Remodal type, Project size, Contact time, Tear out, Improve offer, Sink, When start, Backsplash, Kitchen stove, Your message, Notes, QBO ID, Campaign, Ad set, Ad name.

### Adding a lead

1. Click **Add Lead**. The **Add lead** dialog opens.
2. Fill in:
   - **Name*** (required) — placeholder **Name of the lead**.
   - **Email** — **Add email** adds more addresses (the first is the main one).
   - **Phone 1** — **Add a phone** shows **Phone 2**.
   - **Message** — what the lead wrote (**Message of the lead**).
   - **Project Address** — type at least 3 characters and pick a suggestion.
   - **Referral Source** (required) — pick from your list. The last option, **Manage Sources**, edits the list.
   - **File** — optional picture.
3. Click **Add Lead**. Toast: **Lead added**.

**What happens:**

- A customer is created with source **Leads** and created-by **Marketing team**, with no sales rep yet.
- The lead goes through the company's normal lead alerts: Sales Managers who connected Telegram get the alert to assign it to a sales rep.
- The lead appears in the staff CRM (**CRM > Customers**, **Leads** tab) and in this portal's table.

**Errors:**

- **Name is required** / **Referral source is required** / **Select a valid referral source.**
- **<email> is already saved on <customer>** — that email belongs to another customer. Use a different email or ask the sales team to update the existing customer.

There is no duplicate check on phone numbers when adding a lead here.

#### Managing referral sources

Choose **Manage Sources** in the **Referral Source** dropdown to open **Manage Referral Sources**:

- **Add** — type a name in **New referral source** and click **Add**. Names are 1–255 characters and must be unique (**This referral source already exists.**).
- **Edit** (pencil) — rename, then **Save** or **Cancel**.
- **Delete** (trash) — confirm in **Delete Referral Source**. Existing leads keep their source; it just leaves the dropdown.
- **Close** returns to the form.

2. The **Edit Lead: <name>** dialog opens with **Name***, **Email** (+ **Add email**), **Phone 1** (+ **Add a phone**), **Message** and **Project Address**.
3. Click **Update Lead**. Toast: **Lead updated**.

The referral source and file cannot be changed after the lead is added.

---

### Deleting a lead

1. Click ⋮ → **Delete** (or the delete icon in the search results).
2. **Delete lead**: **Are you sure you want to delete this lead and all associated deals?**
3. Click **Confirm** (or **Cancel**). Toast: **Lead deleted**.

### Common questions

- **Why can't the marketing user open the CRM?** The Marketing position keeps the user inside the Marketing portal. Give them a separate account if they need CRM access.
- **Why don't I see the Company dropdown?** The user has only one company. Add more under **External Marketing Companies** in **Admin > Company settings > Users → Edit**.

## My Account & Telegram

**My Account** is your own profile page: name, phone, login email and password, your phone lines (CloudTalk or RingCentral), the name and signature on your emails, the theme, the AI personal assistant switch (if you have it), **Logout** and your signed-in phones. Telegram alerts are connected from the **Dashboard** (Employee) or from **My Account** (Shop).

**Where to find it:**

- Employee view: sidebar **My Account**. (Admins: switch to **Employee** first; the Admin sidebar has no My Account.)
- Shop portal: sidebar **My Account**.

**Who has it:** every Employee-portal user and every Shop user. Each person can only edit their own account. A manager can edit anyone's account in **Admin > Company settings > Users → Edit**.

---

### Employee My Account

The page is split into sections. A side menu lists them (on a phone it is a row of buttons across the top); click one to jump to it, and the menu highlights the section you are reading. Top to bottom:

**Personal information** (*Your name and how you sign in.*)

| Field | What it is |
|-------|------------|
| **Name** | Your name everywhere in the CRM (deal cards, assignments, Users Activity, surveys). Required (*Name is required*). |
| **Phone** | Your own phone (*Your phone number*). At least 10 digits. Fills the "Employee phone number" template variable. |
| **Email** | Your login email (*Your email address*). Must be valid and not used by another account (*This email belongs to another account*). Emails you send go from this address when it is on the company's mail domain. |
| **Password** | *Leave empty to keep current password.* A new password needs at least 8 characters. |

**Email signature** (*How your email looks to customers.*)

| Field | What it is |
|-------|------------|
| **Email Name** | *The name recipients see in the From field when you send email from the CRM.* (*Your email name*) |
| **Email Signature** | Added under every email you send from the CRM. *Format it like Gmail — bold, italic, fonts, and a logo image.* Toolbar: bold, italic, underline, text color, highlight, link, image, clear formatting. Not shown to users with the **Shop Manager** or **Shop Worker** position. |

**Phone lines** (*The lines you call and text customers from.*): only when the company uses Granite Phone, RingCentral or CloudTalk, with a block per provider.

| Field | What it is |
|-------|------------|
| **RingCentral phone number** | Only if the company uses RingCentral. Your RingCentral number, numbers only (*RingCentral phone must be numbers only*), at least 10 digits (*Your RingCentral line (optional)*). |
| **CloudTalk agent ID** | Only if the company uses CloudTalk. Numbers only (*From CloudTalk (optional)*). Links your texts and calls to you. |
| **CloudTalk phone number** | Only if the company uses CloudTalk. Your CloudTalk line, numbers only (*CloudTalk phone must be numbers only*), at least 10 digits (*Your CloudTalk line (optional)*). Texts go out from it. |
| **Granite Manager phone number** | Only if the company calls through Granite Phone. Your Granite Phone numbers, greyed out (*No number yet* when you have none): *Only an admin can assign or remove your numbers* (**Admin > Company settings > Phone**, the number's **Edit** → **Can call from it**). |
| **Recording voice** switch | Only if the company calls through Granite Phone. Saves as soon as you switch it (toast **Recording voice is on** / **Recording voice is off**). On (the default): *Says “This call is being recorded.” to both sides when your call starts recording.* Off: your outgoing calls, Call via my cell calls and the **Record** button are still recorded, without the voice (toast **Recording voice is off**), and the warning *Some states require telling the other side that a call is recorded. Tell them yourself on those calls.* Incoming calls keep *This call may be recorded*. |

**Save Changes** (under Phone lines) saves these three sections together (the **Recording voice** switch saves on its own).

**Other** (*These save as soon as you change them.*)

- **Theme**: light or black (*Black is easier on the eyes. Applies to this browser.*). The switch says *Switch to the black theme* / *Switch to the light theme*.
- **AI personal assistant** switch, only for users who have the AI assistant: *Transcribes your calls, keeps track of what you promise customers, writes the messages that keep your promises, and reminds you.* Off means it stops reading your calls, texts and emails (**AI assistant is off**); turn it back on any time (**AI assistant is on** · *It reads your calls, texts and emails again.*). See **Promises** under *Employee portal*.
- **Sign out**: the red **Logout** button (*Log out of Granite Manager in this browser.*).

**Signed-in devices** (at the bottom): the phones signed in to the Granite Phone app with your account. Each phone has a sign-out button (*Sign out …?*): that phone stops ringing for your calls and deletes its saved contacts the next time it connects. With none: *No phones are signed in with your account.*

#### Saving changes

1. Change any field.
2. Click **Save Changes** (or press **Enter** in a field).
3. Toast: **Success — Your account was updated**. Errors show in red under the form (for example *We couldn't save that. Please try again*).

What happens when you save:

- **New password:** you stay signed in here, but you are signed out on every other device and browser.
- **RingCentral number:** the CRM looks the number up in RingCentral and links your RingCentral user automatically. If the number isn't found there, your line isn't linked and you can't text or call through RingCentral; check the number and save again.
- **Changing provider keeps your texts:** whenever your RingCentral number is saved, your texts from your other providers (those you sent, those under any agent ID or extension you had, and those on any number you had, with their pictures and read state) are copied to RingCentral, so **CRM > SMS** and the deal's activity still show them. The same happens when you get a Granite Phone line, and when an admin saves your line on **Admin > Company settings > Users > Edit**. IDs and numbers you had before are remembered even after they are cleared. If you text through more than one provider, each text shows once in your inbox.
- **First Email Name or Email Signature:** completes that onboarding setup task (with its points).

### Your phone lines (CloudTalk / RingCentral)

Your line in **Phone lines** decides whether you can send texts in **CRM > SMS**, start SMS follow-up flows and use the in-CRM phone.

- **CloudTalk:** fill **both** **CloudTalk agent ID** and **CloudTalk phone number**. Without the agent ID the **SMS** item doesn't appear. If you save only the number, the setup tour reminds you: *Add your CloudTalk agent ID too, then press Save*.
- **RingCentral:** fill **RingCentral phone number**. The company must first be connected (a manager: **Admin > Company settings > Company → RingCentral → Connect RingCentral**, then log in with the RingCentral account).
- **Both providers:** if you have a RingCentral line, SMS and calls use RingCentral; otherwise CloudTalk.

#### Finding your CloudTalk agent ID

You need **CloudTalk Admin** access to look it up. If you don't have it, ask your company's CloudTalk Admin for your Agent ID.

1. Log in at cloudtalk.io with CloudTalk Admin access.
2. Open **Users** (older CloudTalk versions: **Agents**).
3. Search for your name or email and click your user to open the edit page.
4. Your **Agent ID** is the number at the very end of the address in the browser bar.
5. In the CRM: **My Account** → **CloudTalk agent ID** → paste → **Save Changes**.

#### Finding your CloudTalk phone number

In CloudTalk (Admin access): **Dashboard > Numbers**. Enter it in **CloudTalk phone number** as digits only.

The **CloudTalk agent ID** and the **CloudTalk phone number** are separate fields: the phone number is the line your texts go out from; the agent ID ties texts and calls to you.

### Telegram

There are two Telegram bots: the **leads bot** (new-lead alerts; Sales Managers get each new lead to assign) and the **notifications bot** (new customer emails, deal activities, notes and reminders). Text messages are not sent to Telegram.

#### Employees: connect from the Dashboard

Employee **My Account** has no Telegram button.

1. Open **Dashboard** (first item in the Employee sidebar).
2. In the **Telegram** card, click **Connect Telegram** (*Connect Telegram to receive lead alerts and CRM notifications. You will authorize each bot once.*).
3. Approve the login in Telegram. On a company web address you may pass a **Connect Telegram** linking page first; afterwards you come back automatically.
4. The first approval links the leads bot. If the card is still there, click **Connect Telegram** again to link the notifications bot.
5. When both are linked the card disappears.

If the card says *Telegram linking is not configured*, ask your administrator.

#### Choosing which alerts go to Telegram

Bell icon in the header → gear (**Notification settings**) → **Telegram alerts**: switch **Emails** and **Activities** on or off. Both are on by default and save at once. If the notifications bot isn't linked, the panel says to connect it first.

More: **Employee Dashboard** (Telegram card) and **Notifications** (bell, desktop notifications, Telegram alerts).

#### Shop accounts: connect on My Account

1. Open **My Account** in the Shop portal.
2. Under **Telegram**: *Connect the notifications bot to get maintenance and shop alerts in Telegram.* Click **Connect notifications bot** and approve in Telegram.
3. When linked, **Telegram** shows **Done** and a card invites you to *Join the Granite Manager updates channel for product news and announcements.* (**Join @granite_manager**).

### Shop My Account

- **Telegram** block (see above).
- **Personal Information:** **Name**, **Phone**, **Email**, **Password** (same rules as Employee). No texting line, email name or signature.
- **Save Changes** (toast **Your account was updated**) and **Logout**.
- *Learning progress — N points* and the onboarding checklist show while you have onboarding progress.

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **How do I change my password?** **My Account** → **Password** → type a new one (8+ characters) → **Save Changes**. Leave it empty to keep the old one. Other devices are signed out.
- **Forgot my password and can't sign in?** Click **Forgot password?** on the login page, or ask a manager.
- **How do I change my name?** **My Account** → **Name** → **Save Changes**. A manager can also rename you in **Admin > Company settings > Users**.
- **Where do I connect Telegram?** Employees: the **Telegram** card on the **Dashboard**. Shop: **My Account → Connect notifications bot**. If the Dashboard card is gone, both bots are already connected.
- **The bell says to connect the notifications bot "in My Account".** For employees the button is on the **Dashboard** Telegram card.
- **I don't see the CloudTalk / RingCentral fields.** Your company hasn't connected that provider.
- **I don't see Email Signature.** It is hidden for users with the Shop Manager or Shop Worker position.
- **My emails show the wrong sender name.** Set **Email Name** and save.
- **Where do I set my email signature?** **My Account → Email Signature → Save Changes**. It is added to every email you send from the CRM.
- **SMS says "Sending disabled — no SMS line linked".** Fill your line under **My Account → Phone lines** and click **Save Changes**.

## Notifications

Granite Manager tells you about new customer emails, changes on your deals, reminders, missed calls and texts in several places: the **bell** in the top header, red count badges in the sidebar, optional **desktop notifications** on your computer, and optional **Telegram** messages.

**Who has it:** everyone who signs in to the Employee or Admin side. The bell is in the header on every Employee and Admin page. Shop-only accounts, installers, marketing and walk-in accounts do not have the bell.

---

### Kinds of notifications, and how to turn each off

| Kind | What it is | How to turn it off |
|---|---|---|
| **Bell** (in the header) | The list of new emails, deal activity, reminders, missed calls and billing notices, with a red count | It can't be turned off. Remove items with the **X** or **Clear all** (see *Clearing notifications*). |
| **Desktop notifications** | Pop-ups from your browser on a computer, also for new SMS | Bell → gear (**Notification settings**) → **Turn off desktop alerts**. Per browser and computer. While they are off, new items show as a small pop-up message inside the app instead. |
| **Telegram alerts** | Messages from the notifications bot (emails, deal activity, reminders) and the leads bot (new leads) | Bell → gear → **Telegram alerts** → switch off **Emails** and/or **Activities**. There is no switch for the leads bot or to unlink Telegram; to stop all messages, block the bot in Telegram. |
| **Granite Phone app** | Phone notifications from the Granite Phone app; users signed in to the app get these instead of Telegram | Turn off notifications for the app in your phone's settings, or sign the phone out (**My Account** → **Signed-in devices** → **Sign out**). |
| **Phone ringing** | The browser phone (**Phone** button in the sidebar footer) rings for incoming calls | Turn the phone off on this computer (see **Phone Calls**). |
| **Sidebar badges** | Red counts of unread conversations on **CRM > Emails** and **CRM > SMS** | They can't be turned off; reading the conversations clears them. |
| **Reminders to customers** | Appointment texts and emails sent to customers | Admins: **Admin > Schedule** → **Customer notifications** → switch the flow off. For one event, remove the flow in the event's **Notifications** (see *Schedule customer notifications*). |

Emails Granite Manager sends you (for example **Lead assigned**, a signed quote, e-signature updates) have no off switch.

---

### The notification bell

**Where:** the bell icon at the top right of the header, just left of the **Todo List** button. On phones it is in the top bar between the logo and the **Todo List** button (the ☰ menu is to the right).

- A **red number** on the bell = notifications that arrived since you last closed the bell panel on this device (shows **99+** above 99).
- Click the bell to open the **Notifications** panel. Closing the panel resets the red number to zero. Newer items also have a small **blue dot** until you close the panel.
- The list refreshes about once a minute and every time you come back to the browser tab.

#### What the panel shows

- Items are grouped under **Today**, **Yesterday** and **Earlier**, newest first.
- Each row shows an icon, the customer name (or the contact), the name of the coworker who made the change (after a dot), the time (**now**, **5m**, **3h**, **2d**, or a date) and a one-line description.
- Filter tabs **All**, **Emails**, **Activities**, **Calls** appear at the top with counts, only when there are at least two kinds of notifications in the list.
- Empty list: **You have no notifications.** Empty filter: **Nothing here.**

#### Notification types

| Type (heading) | When it appears | Who gets it | Clicking it opens |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Email** (envelope icon, subject as text) | An unread incoming email from the last 14 days — one row per conversation. Customer emails sent to you or on one of your deals, and coworkers' emails addressed to you. | The person the email is for / the deal owner | The email conversation (inside the deal if the email is linked to a deal, otherwise in **CRM > Emails**) |
| **Added / Edited / Deleted an Activity** | A coworker adds, edits or deletes an activity on a deal | The deal's owner and the customer's sales rep (never the person who made the change) | The deal (**Project** tab) |
| **Added / Edited / Deleted a Note** | A coworker adds, edits or deletes a deal note (including notes saved from a deal questionnaire) | Same as above | The deal |
| **Added / Deleted a Comment** | A coworker comments on a deal note, or deletes a comment | Same as above | The deal |
| **Activity Reminder** (alarm clock) | At the deadline of an open activity whose deadline has a **time** (date-only deadlines get no reminder) | The deal's owner (or the person who created the activity if the deal has no owner) | The deal |
| **In-Home Estimate Reminder**, **Installation Reminder**, **Template Appointment Reminder** | For estimate, installation and template appointments booked for a customer on the schedule: the day before at 5 PM (store time) and 1 hour before. Text reads like "Installation tomorrow with John Smith at … Address: …" | The customer's sales rep (or whoever booked it) — the customer needs a deal | The deal |
| **Quote Signed** | A customer signs a quote in the online quote portal. Text: "*Customer* signed *Quote*: *option*" | The quote's sales rep (or its creator). They also get an email. | The deal |
| **Scheduled Message Sent** / **Scheduled Message Failed** | A text or email you scheduled with send-later went out, or failed (e.g. "Scheduled SMS sent: "…""). Only for messages tied to a deal. | The person who scheduled it | The deal |
| **Missed CloudTalk call** / **CloudTalk voicemail** (red phone) | An incoming call on your CloudTalk line in the last 3 days that was not answered, or left a voicemail. Text: **Missed call** or **New voicemail**. | Users with a **CloudTalk agent ID** on their account | The SMS conversation with that phone number in **CRM > SMS** |
| **Payment required** (purple card) | The company's Granite Manager subscription payment failed. Has an **Update Payment Method** button. | Users with the **Manager** position | **Update Payment Method** opens Billing |

Not in the bell: new incoming **SMS** (use the sidebar **SMS** badge and desktop notifications), eSignature status changes (opened/signed/declined — those are emailed to the sender), and RingCentral calls.

An activity reminder stays in the bell until you dismiss it or complete the activity; deleting or renaming the activity removes or replaces it.

---

### Clearing notifications

#### Open one
Click a row to go to it. This also clears it: an email conversation is **marked as read**, an activity notification is marked done.

#### Remove one (X)
1. Hover the row (on phones the **X** is always visible).
2. Click the **X** at the top right of the row.
3. A **Notification removed** message appears with **Undo** for 5 seconds. Click **Undo** to bring it back.

- For **email** rows the X only hides the email from the bell — it **stays unread** in **CRM > Emails**, and the conversation comes back to the bell when a newer message arrives in it.
- For missed **calls**, removing hides the call in this browser tab only; it may show again in a new tab or after the browser restarts (calls drop off on their own after 3 days).

#### Clear all
Click **Clear all** at the top of the panel (shown when there is anything in the list). This dismisses every activity, reminder and billing notification, hides all email rows (emails stay unread), and hides the missed calls.

---

### Desktop notifications (pop-ups on your computer)

Desktop notifications show a pop-up from your browser in the corner of your screen, even when the Granite Manager tab is in the background. They cover new emails, deal activity and reminders, missed calls, billing notices, and **new SMS** ("**New SMS from** *name*"; SMS pop-ups need SMS set up for your account — a CloudTalk agent ID or a RingCentral line).

**Available on computers only** (not on phones), in browsers that support notifications. They are a per-browser, per-computer setting.

#### Turn them on
1. Click the bell.
2. Click **Enable desktop notifications** (blue link under the header).
3. When the browser asks, click **Allow**.
4. On a Mac you may see: *On macOS, you may also need to allow notifications for your browser in System Settings → Notifications.* Do that if no pop-ups appear.

#### How they work
- Keep at least one Granite Manager tab open (it can be minimized or in the background). Nothing arrives when the browser is closed.
- New items are checked about once a minute; at most 5 pop-ups show at once.
- Clicking a pop-up brings the Granite Manager tab to the front and opens the email, deal or SMS conversation.
- A pop-up shows the item's title (or *New email*, *CloudTalk call*, *New notification*) and its text; an item with no text says *You have a new CRM notification.*
- Desktop notifications play no sound of their own; any sound comes from your computer's notification settings. (The only sound is the browser phone ringing for an incoming call.)
- When desktop notifications are **off**, new items still appear as a small pop-up message inside the app (computers only, while the tab is open).

#### Turn them off
1. Click the bell.
2. Click the gear icon (**Notification settings**).
3. Click **Turn off desktop alerts**.

---

### Telegram alerts

You can also get alerts in the Telegram app. There are two bots:

- **Leads bot** — new-lead alerts. Users with the **Sales Manager** position get each new lead, usually with "Choose a salesperson." and one button per sales rep (showing that rep's leads this month); tapping a name assigns the lead and creates the deal. The rep then gets "You were assigned a lead. Click here:" with a link (or an email **Lead assigned** if they have not connected Telegram).
- **Notifications bot** — CRM alerts: new incoming emails (customer, subject, short preview, **📬 Open Email** button) and deal activity, notes, comments, activity reminders and appointment reminders (**📂 Open Deal** button). Text messages (SMS) are **not** sent to Telegram.

#### Connect Telegram (Employee)
1. Go to sidebar **Dashboard**.
2. In the **Telegram** card, click **Connect Telegram**. ("Connect Telegram to receive lead alerts and CRM notifications. You will authorize each bot once.")
3. Approve the login in Telegram (on a company web address you may pass through a Granite Manager linking page first). The page reloads.
4. If the card is still there, click **Connect Telegram** again to authorize the second bot. The card disappears when both bots are connected.

If Telegram later reports the link no longer works (for example you blocked the bot), Granite Manager forgets it and the **Telegram** card returns so you can connect again.

Shop accounts connect only the notifications bot on **My Account** (**Connect notifications bot**) and get a 9 AM "🔧 Maintenance due today" digest of equipment checks due.

#### Choose which alerts go to Telegram
1. Click the bell → gear icon (**Notification settings**).
2. Under **Telegram alerts**, switch **Emails** and/or **Activities** on or off. Both are on by default and save immediately.

If the notifications bot is not connected, this section says to connect it first. If a switch does not save you will see **Could not save notification preference** — try again.

---

### Sidebar unread badges

- **CRM > Emails** — red number = unread email conversations. Only shown when your company has email set up (the **Emails** item exists). Updates about once a minute and when you open or leave a conversation.
- **CRM > SMS** — red number = unread text conversations. Only shown when SMS (CloudTalk or RingCentral) is set up for you.
- Opening a conversation marks it read. To mark one unread again: in **CRM > Emails** use the envelope on an **Inbox** row (**Mark as unread**); in **CRM > SMS** hover a read row and click the envelope (**Mark as unread**).

---

### Reminders that go to customers

Appointment texts and emails sent **to customers** are not staff notifications. Admins set them up in **Admin > Schedule** under **Customer notifications**.

---

### Notifications tour

The **Notifications** onboarding tour opens the bell and shows sample notifications for a sample customer. The samples disappear when the tour ends.

---

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **Why is the bell empty but Emails still shows a red number?** You removed those emails from the bell with the **X** or **Clear all** — that hides them but keeps them unread. Open them in **CRM > Emails**.
- **The red number on the bell won't go away.** Open the bell and close it again; the number counts only items newer than the last time you closed the panel.
- **I don't get notifications for my own changes.** Correct — activity, note and comment notifications go to the deal owner and sales rep, never to the person who made the change.
- **I don't see missed calls.** Missed calls come only from CloudTalk, and only if your account has a **CloudTalk agent ID** (**My Account**). RingCentral calls are not listed.
- **No activity reminder appeared.** The activity needs a deadline with a time (not just a date) and must still be open. Reminders go to the deal's owner.
- **No appointment reminder.** Only estimate, installation and template appointments booked for a customer who has a deal get rep reminders, and only if the reminder time had not already passed when it was booked.
- **No "Enable desktop notifications" link.** You are on a phone, your browser does not support notifications, or they are already on (open the gear to see **Turn off desktop alerts**).
- **I clicked Enable but nothing happens / no pop-ups.** Your browser has blocked notifications for this site. Allow them in the browser's site settings (lock icon in the address bar → Notifications → Allow), reload, and click **Enable desktop notifications** again. On a Mac also allow your browser in System Settings → Notifications.
- **Pop-ups stopped when I closed the browser.** They only work while a Granite Manager tab is open.
- **Do I get SMS in Telegram?** No. SMS alerts come as desktop notifications and the sidebar **SMS** badge.
- **How do I stop Telegram alerts for emails?** Bell → gear → turn off **Emails** under **Telegram alerts**.
- **Who gets "Payment required"?** Users with the **Manager** position, when the company's subscription payment fails.

## Phone Calls (CloudTalk & RingCentral)

Granite Manager can place and receive phone calls right inside the CRM through your company's phone provider, **CloudTalk** or **RingCentral**. The phone runs in a small floating **phone panel** that you turn on per computer from the sidebar footer. Call history, recordings and AI transcripts show up on each deal and customer.

**Where to find it:** at the bottom of the sidebar (the footer, just above **Chat**), on Employee and Admin pages: the **Phone off** / **Phone** button. On phones, open the sidebar menu and scroll to the bottom.

Texting is covered separately in **Employee SMS**. Reps' call counts are in **Users Activity**. Calls through Granite Manager's own phone service (**Granite Phone**, on Telnyx) are covered in **Granite Phone (Telnyx)**.

---

### Who sees the Phone button

Only one phone appears for each user: CloudTalk, RingCentral or Granite Phone. A Granite Phone line takes the place of the other two (see **Granite Phone (Telnyx)**).

| Provider | Company needs | You need (on **My Account**) |
|----------|---------------|------------------------------|
| **CloudTalk** | CloudTalk connected for the company (CloudTalk Access Key and Secret, entered by a platform superuser on the company) | Both **CloudTalk agent ID** and **CloudTalk phone number** |
| **RingCentral** | RingCentral connected in **Admin > Company settings > Company** (**RingCentral** card, **Connect RingCentral**) | **RingCentral phone number** |

- The button only shows on Employee and Admin pages. It is not in the Shop portal, the customer showroom, or other portals.
- **iPhone / iPad with CloudTalk:** the button is hidden on Employee pages because the CloudTalk browser phone does not work on iOS (see **iPhone, iPad and Android**).
- **CRM > SMS** needs only the CloudTalk agent ID, but the Phone button needs the agent ID **and** the CloudTalk phone number. If SMS shows up but Phone doesn't, the phone number is usually what's missing.

#### Setting up your line

1. Open **My Account** (Employee sidebar).
2. In the **Phone lines** section, fill in your provider's fields:
   - CloudTalk: **CloudTalk agent ID** (numbers only) and **CloudTalk phone number** (at least 10 digits). How to find the agent ID is explained in **My Account & Telegram**.
   - RingCentral: **RingCentral phone number**, which is your own RingCentral line (at least 10 digits). The CRM matches it to your RingCentral extension. If it can't, you see *We couldn't find this number in RingCentral. Check it and try again*.
3. Click **Save Changes**. The **Phone off** button appears in the sidebar footer.

A user with the **Manager** position (and Admin access) can set the same fields for anyone: **Admin > Company settings > Users**, then **Edit** on the user.

Fill in only the provider you actually use. If both a CloudTalk line and a RingCentral line are filled in, calls from deals go through RingCentral, and the sidebar **Phone** button may not open a panel.

---

### Turning the phone on and off on this computer

The phone is **off** by default on each computer and browser. While it is off, the browser phone isn't loaded and doesn't use your microphone. Calls ring your other CloudTalk or RingCentral devices (mobile app, desk phone) instead.

#### Turn it on

1. Click **Phone off** (crossed-out phone icon) in the sidebar footer.
2. The first time, the browser asks for permission to use the microphone. Click **Allow**.
3. The phone turns on and the phone panel opens. The button now reads **Phone**; clicking it shows or hides the panel (*Show or hide phone panel*).
4. If the panel asks you to sign in, use your own CloudTalk or RingCentral login, not your Granite Manager password.

If the microphone is blocked or missing, the phone stays off and a red message appears: **Microphone needed to call**, *Allow the microphone for this site (the icon in the address bar), then try again.*

#### Show or hide the panel

- Click **Phone** to show or hide the panel. Hiding the panel does **not** turn the phone off. Calls still come in, and a call in progress keeps going.
- The **X** (**Close phone panel**) in the panel's top bar also hides it.

#### Turn it off

- Click the small **power** button next to **Phone** (tooltip **Turn off on this computer**), or the power icon in the panel's top bar (**Turn off phone on this computer**).
- The button goes back to **Phone off**. Calls stop ringing on this computer and ring your other devices.
- Turning the phone off during a call ends that call.

When the sidebar is collapsed to icons, only the phone icon shows. Hover or pin the sidebar to see the power button, or use the power icon on the panel.

The on/off choice is remembered **per computer and browser**. Turn it on separately on each computer you use. On a shared computer, turn it off when you leave.

#### The phone panel

- It floats above the page, in the bottom-right corner by default.
- **Move it:** drag the top bar (**Drag to move**). The position is remembered in this browser. The panel can't be resized.
- On small screens (phones, short windows) it fills the screen.
- You can keep using the CRM while it is open. Clicking inside the panel doesn't close an open deal or dialog.
- Everything inside the panel (dial pad, answer and decline, mute, hold, transfer, keypad, the provider's own settings) belongs to **CloudTalk** or **RingCentral**. The CRM doesn't add its own call buttons, so the exact controls are the provider's.

---

### Making a call

#### From the dial pad

1. Click **Phone** (or **Phone off** to turn it on first).
2. Type or paste the number into the dialer in the panel and start the call there.

#### From a deal (click-to-call)

1. Go to **CRM > Deals** and click the customer name to open the deal.
2. On the **Project** tab, find **Phone** (and **Phone 2** if set). Each number has a copy control, an **SMS** button (when you have a texting line), and a **phone icon**.
3. Click the phone icon. What happens depends on your setup. Only one call icon is shown, chosen in this order: your RingCentral line, then your CloudTalk agent, then your device's own dialer.

| Your setup | What the phone icon does |
|------------|---------------------------|
| **RingCentral**, on a computer | Opens the phone panel and **dials the number right away** (tooltip *Calls this number with the RingCentral phone*). If the phone was off, it turns on (microphone prompt the first time) and dials as soon as it loads. |
| **RingCentral**, on a phone or tablet | Hands the call to the **RingCentral app**. If the app doesn't open: **RingCentral app did not open**, *Install the RingCentral app on this phone, then try again.* |
| **CloudTalk** (not iPhone/iPad) | **Copies the number** and opens the phone panel (tooltip *Copies the number and opens the CloudTalk phone*). A message says **Number copied**, *Paste into the CloudTalk dialer (Ctrl/Cmd+V), then call.* Paste into the dialer and start the call. CloudTalk's panel can't receive a number from the CRM, so this paste step is needed. |
| **No CloudTalk/RingCentral line**, or **CloudTalk on iPhone/iPad** | A normal phone link: your device's own dialer opens (on a computer, whatever app handles phone links). The call goes out from that device's number, not through CloudTalk. |

- If the copy fails, you see **Could not copy the number**. Copy it by hand, then paste it into the dialer.
- The plain dialer icon is grayed out with *No valid phone number on file* when the number isn't a valid 10-digit number. The CloudTalk and RingCentral icons are hidden when the number can't be read as a phone number.
- The phone icon is on the **Employee** deal's **Project** tab (also when you open a deal from **Quotes**). The Admin deal view, the Customers list and the customer page have no call icon. To call from there, open the phone panel and dial.

The browser checks microphone access before each click-to-call. If it is blocked, you see **Microphone needed to call**.

---

### Receiving calls

1. Keep the phone **on** in this browser. The panel can stay hidden.
2. When a call rings, the panel **opens automatically**.
3. Answer or decline with the controls in the panel.

**CloudTalk: the customer opens automatically.** When you **answer** an incoming call and the caller is a known customer, the CRM opens that customer's page. The match uses the customer's **Phone** or **Phone 2**, or a CloudTalk contact linked to the customer. This happens once per call, and only for incoming calls. Outgoing calls never switch the page. RingCentral calls don't open the customer automatically.

**Missed calls and voicemail (CloudTalk):** missed incoming calls and new voicemails from the last 3 days appear in the **notifications bell** in the header.

- They are titled **Missed CloudTalk call** or **CloudTalk voicemail**, with **Missed call** or **New voicemail** under the caller's name or number.
- Filter them with **Calls**. Clicking one opens the SMS conversation with that number.
- Removing a call notification hides it in this browser only.
- RingCentral missed calls don't appear in the bell.

#### During a call

- You can move to other CRM pages, and the call continues. You can also hide the panel and bring it back with **Phone**.
- **Don't** reload the page, turn the phone off, or open the customer showroom view (**Customer** button) in the same tab. The phone only runs on Employee and Admin pages, so leaving or reloading ends the call.
- Each open CRM tab on this computer loads its own phone once it is on. Turning it off in one tab takes effect in the other tabs after they reload.

---

### Call history, recordings and transcripts

Calls aren't typed into the CRM. They are read live from CloudTalk or RingCentral and matched to the customer's **Phone** and **Phone 2**. Calls by any rep on the company account appear.

| Where | What calls show |
|-------|-----------------|
| Open deal, activity panel, **History** | Calls with the deal's customer **since the deal was created** |
| **CRM > Customers**, open a customer, **Activity** section | **All** calls with the customer's numbers |

In **History**, calls appear under **All** and under **Actions (N)**. Each row shows:

- **Outgoing** or **Incoming**, with a colored icon: blue for an answered outgoing call, gray for an outgoing call with no answer, green for an answered incoming call, red for a missed incoming call, and amber for a voicemail.
- The talk time (mm:ss), or **No answer** / **Voicemail**.
- The date and time, plus **By [rep name]** when someone other than you handled it.

**Recorded calls** have a **⋮** (**Call actions**) menu:

- **Voice call** shows a player (play/pause, waveform, time). **Hide voice call** closes it. *Recording no longer available* means the provider no longer has the audio.
- **Transcribe** creates an AI transcript. It then toggles between **Show text** and **Hide text**. A call with an AI summary has **AI note** (click to read it; **Hide AI note** folds it).
- **On deals only:** **Add note** turns the call into a short AI summary note on the deal (**Note added**, *Call summary saved as a note*). If the call had no project details you see **Nothing to save**. **Add Activity** creates follow-up tasks from what was said, with deadlines when mentioned (**Activity added** · *Follow-up action saved to the deal*, or **Activities added** · *N follow-up tasks saved to the deal*). If nothing specific was found, it adds a general follow-up task. On desktop these are buttons on the row. On phones they are in the **⋮** menu.

When a call ends in the phone panel, the open deal or customer refreshes its call list automatically within a few seconds. Provider call logs can lag slightly behind.

On the customer page, **AI Activity Search** has an **Include phone calls (slower)** checkbox so the AI also reads transcripts of the customer's last two recorded calls.

---

### How calls count as activity

- **Not saved automatically** as deal activities or notes. Use **Add note** or **Add Activity** on the call row.
- **Admin > Users Activity:** CloudTalk calls appear in each rep's activity dialog as **Made a call**, **Received a call** or **Missed a call**. This needs the rep's **CloudTalk agent ID**. RingCentral calls don't appear there. See **Users Activity**.
- **Calls & SMS points** (when the company leaderboard is on): outgoing CloudTalk and RingCentral calls earn call points. See **Users Activity**.
- **Dashboard > Call coach** needs a CloudTalk agent ID and CloudTalk phone number. See **Employee Dashboard**.
- An SMS follow-up flow stops when the customer calls in on CloudTalk after the flow started. See **Employee SMS**.

---

### iPhone, iPad and Android

- **iPhone/iPad + CloudTalk:** the browser phone doesn't work on iOS.
  - On Employee pages there is no **Phone** button.
  - On Admin pages the panel shows *Calls on iPhone use CloudTalk Go* with a **Download CloudTalk Go** link.
  - The deal phone icon opens the iPhone's own dialer.
  - To call through your CloudTalk line on an iPhone, use the CloudTalk Go app.
- **iPhone/iPad/Android + RingCentral:** the deal phone icon opens the **RingCentral app**. The sidebar **Phone** button still opens the browser panel, but a browser call on a phone can drop when the screen locks. Use the app for calls on the go.
- **Android + CloudTalk:** the **Phone** button and panel work, and the panel fills the screen.

---

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **Do calls count as activity?** Not on the deal: calls are not saved as activities or notes (use **Add note** or **Add Activity** on the call row). CloudTalk calls show in **Admin > Users Activity** (needs the rep's **CloudTalk agent ID**), and outgoing calls earn call points when the leaderboard is on.
- **I don't see the Phone button.** Check that your provider's line is saved on **My Account**. For CloudTalk you need both the agent ID and the CloudTalk phone number; for RingCentral, the RingCentral phone number. Also check that the company has the provider connected, and that you are on an Employee or Admin page. On an iPhone/iPad with CloudTalk, Employee pages never show it.
- **It says Phone off.** That's normal: the phone is off by default on each computer. Click it to turn it on.
- **"Microphone needed to call".** The browser blocked the microphone, or no microphone is connected. Click the icon in the address bar, allow **Microphone** for the site, plug in a headset if needed, then click **Phone off** or the call icon again.
- **Calls ring my mobile app or desk phone, not the CRM.** The phone is off in this browser, or the CRM isn't open. Turn it on and keep a CRM tab open.
- **No sound, or the customer can't hear me.** Check the microphone permission above. The CRM has no audio settings of its own, so pick your speaker and microphone in your computer's sound settings, or in the provider's settings inside the panel if it offers them. Make sure the browser tab isn't muted.
- **I clicked the call icon, the number was copied, but nothing opened (CloudTalk).** Add your **CloudTalk phone number** on **My Account**. The panel needs both the agent ID and the phone number.
- **The phone icon on the deal opens my computer's calling app.** You have no CloudTalk or RingCentral line on **My Account**, so the icon is a plain phone link.
- **Why didn't my number get dialed automatically?** Only RingCentral dials automatically. With CloudTalk, paste the copied number into the dialer (Ctrl/Cmd+V).
- **A call is missing from the deal.** Deal history only shows calls since the deal was created, and only for the customer's **Phone** / **Phone 2**. Calls from a number not on the customer record don't show. Check the customer page for older calls.
- **I can't play a recording.** Only recorded calls have **Voice call**. *Recording no longer available* means the provider no longer has it.
- **The call dropped when I changed pages.** Moving between CRM pages keeps the call. Reloading, turning the phone off, or leaving Employee/Admin pages in that tab ends it.
- **RingCentral shows Disconnected on the Company page.** A Manager clicks **Reconnect** in **Admin > Company settings > Company**. Calls, texts and contact sync stop until then.

## QuickBooks Online (connect, disconnect, what syncs)

Granite Manager can connect to your company's **QuickBooks Online** account. Once connected, QuickBooks invoices show on customers, sales by class show on Statistics, reps see their QuickBooks sales on the Dashboard, and installers can open invoices. Granite Manager reads from QuickBooks; the only thing it writes back is an invoice you edit and save yourself.

---

### Before you start: two switches

1. **QuickBooks turned on for the company** — a company setting controlled by the Granite Manager team (platform superuser: Companies → edit company → **QuickBooks** — *Invoices, QuickBooks connect, and sales widgets*). When it is off, the QuickBooks card, the QuickBooks section on customers and the **Sales by Class** widget do not appear at all.
2. **QuickBooks connected** — your company signs in to QuickBooks once (steps below). If the Granite Manager QuickBooks app isn't set up for your company yet, the card says *QuickBooks connect isn't set up yet. Ask a superuser to enable it for all companies.*

**Who can connect / disconnect:** a user with **Admin** access **and** the **Manager** position (they are the ones who see **Admin > Company settings > Company**). Platform superusers can do it for any company.

---

### Connecting QuickBooks

1. Switch to the **Admin** view.
2. Open **Company settings > Company** in the sidebar.
3. Find the **QuickBooks** card (right side of the page). It says *Click below and log in with your QuickBooks Online account to connect it.*
4. Click **Connect QuickBooks**.
5. You are sent to Intuit (QuickBooks). Sign in with a QuickBooks user that has access to your company file, pick the company if asked, and approve the connection.
6. QuickBooks sends you back to **Admin > Company settings > Company** with the toast **Quickbooks connected successfully**. The card now says *Connected. Everyone in this company can see QuickBooks invoices on customer info.*

If it fails you see **Could not finish the QuickBooks connection. Try again.** (or **Could not start the QuickBooks connection. Please try again.**). If you were signed out, you are sent to the login page first.

The **Connect QuickBooks Online** page (*Link your QuickBooks Online company to Granite Manager to view invoices on customer records.*) can also appear during this flow. It shows **Connect QuickBooks** / **Reconnect QuickBooks** and a **Company settings** button (**Go to Company settings**); if connecting isn't available it says *QuickBooks connect is not set up for your company yet. Ask a superuser to enable it.*

### Reconnecting

Use **Reconnect** on the QuickBooks card when invoices stop loading ("QuickBooks is not connected for this company."), when you switched to a different QuickBooks company, or after disconnecting. It runs the same sign-in as above.

### Disconnecting

**From Granite Manager:**

1. **Admin > Company settings > Company** → QuickBooks card.
2. Click **Disconnect**. Toast: **QuickBooks disconnected**.

**From QuickBooks** (Intuit's app management): QuickBooks opens a Granite Manager page titled **QuickBooks disconnected** — *QuickBooks Online is no longer connected to Granite Manager for this company (or was already disconnected). Invoice data from QuickBooks will no longer appear until you reconnect.* It lists how to reconnect (*Sign in to Granite Manager.* → *Open Admin, then Company settings.* → **Connect QuickBooks**) and has **Connect QuickBooks** and **Sign in** buttons.

After disconnecting: the QuickBooks section on customers and the dashboard QuickBooks sales disappear or show "not connected"; nothing in QuickBooks is deleted, and customer links are remembered for when you reconnect.

---

### What syncs (and what doesn't)

| Where in Granite Manager | What comes from QuickBooks | Who sees it |
|--------------------------|----------------------------|-------------|
| **Customer Information** → **QuickBooks** section (**Get invoices**) | The customer's invoices: number, date, project address, total, balance, **Paid** / **Partial** / **Open**; PDF; email with PDF attached; edit and **Save to QuickBooks** | All employees and admins (turned on + connected) |
| **Admin > CRM > Statistic** → **Sales by Class** widget | QuickBooks "Sales by Class" report (accrual) for the chosen dates | Admins (turned on) |
| **Employee Dashboard** → sales goal widget (**QuickBooks sales**, **View by customer**) | Your sales this month from QuickBooks classes named after you | Each rep (turned on + connected) |
| **Schedule** → **Installations** event → invoice picker | The customer's outstanding / all invoices; the chosen one is **Shown to installers** | Staff creating installation events (connected) |
| **Installer app** → **Invoices** tab | Search a customer, open their invoice PDFs | Installers (connected) |

**Matching customers:** the first time a customer's invoices are loaded, Granite Manager finds the QuickBooks customer with the same **email**, then the same **name**, and remembers the link.

**Not synced:**

- Granite Manager customers, deals, quotes and slab sales are **not** sent to QuickBooks. Creating a customer or a sale here does not create anything in QuickBooks. The one exception is **Create invoice** on a quote, which creates a QuickBooks invoice when you click **Create in QuickBooks** (see **Invoices**).
- New invoices are created in QuickBooks, not in Granite Manager.
- Payments are recorded in QuickBooks; Granite Manager only shows the balance.
- Invoice data refreshes when you open it (there is no background sync schedule).

The only write-back: editing an invoice (**Edit invoice** → **Save to QuickBooks** / **Save and send**, or **Edit with AI** → **Apply to form**) changes that invoice in QuickBooks. See **Invoices**.

---

### Common questions / troubleshooting

- **I don't see the QuickBooks card on Company settings.** QuickBooks isn't turned on for your company — ask the Granite Manager team. If you don't see **Company settings** at all, you need Admin access plus the **Manager** position.
- **The card says "QuickBooks connect isn't set up yet."** The Granite Manager team still has to set up the QuickBooks app for your company.
- **Customers say "QuickBooks is not connected for this company."** The connection was removed or expired. A Manager with Admin access clicks **Reconnect** (or **Connect QuickBooks**). The **Connect in Company settings** button on the customer goes to that page.
- **Dashboard card says "Please notify your manager that QuickBooks is disconnected."** Same fix: reconnect in **Admin > Company settings > Company**.
- **Invoices load for some customers but not others.** The customer's email or name in Granite Manager doesn't match a QuickBooks customer. Make them match (e.g. add the same email) and click **Get invoices** again.
- **Will connecting change anything in my QuickBooks?** No. Nothing is written to QuickBooks unless someone saves an invoice edit.
- **Can sales reps connect QuickBooks?** The **Connect QuickBooks**, **Reconnect** and **Disconnect** buttons are only on **Admin > Company settings > Company**, which needs Admin access and the Manager position. Ask a manager.
- **We changed QuickBooks companies.** Click **Reconnect** and pick the new company during sign-in.

## Quote Drawing — Color & Edge, Areas, Color Options & Slab Layout (Step 5)

Step 5 of the quote drawing tool is where you pick the stone (product and color) and edge profiles, split the job into areas (Kitchen, Island, Master Bath…), offer the customer several color options, price special-order colors from supplier price lists, and lay the pieces out on slabs with seams.

**Where:** sidebar **Quotes** → open a quote → **Edit drawing** → step **5 Color & Edge**. Available to users with Employee or Admin access. Products, colors, edge profiles and prices come from the quote's price list (**Admin > Quotes > Price Lists**, admins only).

---

### Page layout

One section per **area**, each with:
